text: Update: I've been playing this game for years and I adore almost everything this game offers. More recently I've felt that the mini games have been a let down. I'm tired of the explorer trails being so repetitive. They used to offer a much wider selection of mini games: the submarine and the ladder game were my favourites! Now I find I'm bored of the same thing. The main game itself is still brilliant, but I used to enjoy the variety of side games too. Please bring those back!

Once a good game. My partner introduced it to me. She's been playing it for years. in the time I've been playing it's gone from a fun game with some challenge to a frustrating hard game with levels that you are stuck on for days unless you pay for extras. Now they have removed the team chat, taking the social aspect from it. Any communication with the dev goes through an AI chat it and goes nowhere. Save your sanity and skip.

Removed ability for UK players to use chat feature. How am I supposed to communicate with my team. played this game for many years, lately it's become more of a 'pay to win' game. Too many side games/quests. As if the increased team numbers wasn't bad enough to start with. Looks like I'll be no longer playing. What a disappointment. 5stars down to one star from me! My old review from 7yrs ago... Very addictive game. lots of fun creating aquariums as well as doing the matching game too.

the latest update means I can't chat to my team (What's the point of being in a team then?), the adventure game doesn't allow me to click the blue bottles or the coin bags, or click on treasure gates to find the key. the animation is so slow there's no point playing a race game anymore and when I'm out of moves, the animation is overly large, annoying and slow. I've been toying with uninstalling for a while and this might just have made the decision for me.

Latest update..I hate the new 'improvements'! Too few moves for level makes it so difficult to advance now, can be stuck on the same level for days and that's a normal level not a super hard! Team mates don't play as much now for the same reason so no extra lives. The premium fish also ridiculous cost so that also stops advancement, very poor Playrix I hope you roll back these changes, as a player who stupidly spent a lot of real money on this game does not mean I am willing to pay more!

you've ruined the game! you've reduced the power ups... every other level is hard or super hard and even the normal levels are taking 4 or 5 tries to complete... I spent 2 days on the same level... finally beat it to get stuck again straight away... I always buy the passes and spend more money on Gems.... not anymore.. it's become boring and frustrating... you've updated the game and absolutely ruined it. its getting even worse....

They are getting far too greedy. I regularly bought the season pass when it was £5.99. It's now £8.99 with less benefits. I've worked out that I've paid £239.75 in to this game and I'm now completely done with it. The easy levels are now hard which forces you in to having to purchase to move on with the game. You can guarantee you'll get your power up back then be hit with a super hard level straight after and you lose your power up again. You've ruined a good game with your greed. Uninstalled

this was a fantastic little game with in app purchase. I always buy the 8.99 pass for the month. for the past 4-6 weeks levels are impossible to play without having to buy gems. the team events on the weekend never has the whole team in so you can not work together to get rewards. I am hoping that it's just bugs in the system they are working on and have not done what all other apps have done gone greedy. my whole team is having the same issues they need to fix this ASAP. Its lost fun

I am uninstalling this game. I absolutely love the fishdom part, matching and building the aquarium. But I hate being forced to participate in games I don't want to play, such as the Shackleton challenge etc. You can't get out of it. There's no way of saying "no thanks" or "maybe later". The screen goes dark, an arrow annoyingly flashes and you either quit or join in. But if you quit it's still there flashing at you when you go back. At least give people the option to say "no thanks"

I consider myself to be quite skilful at similar games.. Never before have I come across a game that has become more geared around trying to get players to buy extra lives/ diamonds, etc. Some of the so-called normal levels are ridiculously difficult , and you can be on a level for days on end. And as soon as you get the double lightening, you just know that a ridiculously hard level will follow within a couple of games. very frustrating game. I'm going to uninstall it

DO NOT PLAY THIS GAME. I have played this game for a few years and it is no longer fun. It is devised to make you spend money to finish levels or you lose all your benefits you have collected in game play. I got to level 12000 but it's time to leave. I contacted 'support' for help with an issue but they couldn't be less helpful or bothered.

been playing a couple of years this time and 3 yrs before that (had a break for a while).. it's a great game for relaxing and a game that can be played without spending any money...totally free The in-game rewards can be really helpful when playing a hard level...I'm on level 8835 only 10.000 (approx) levels to go and I will get there. awesome game ... and finally......... NO ADS.!!

I have been playing this game for 6 years now. it used to be a lot of fun, the game play isn't as interactive. The cost of energy for small tasks insane and a lot of the fun quirky objects you could collect along the way no longer exist. Game challenges now include you purchasing whereas that was never a prerequisite. £8.99 for a challenges pass which was half that not so long ago. Bring back the other mini challenges where you could move tiles and make things. Too expensive now.

Its just Too Hard. The game sucks you in and makes it so hard to complete levels, you end up buying bonus bits to beat the level. Then to get stuck on the next one. some levels are impossible to complete without upgrades. the fact you have 3 different thing to do is good, and being part of a team is helpful.

Got sucked in by an ad that showed this game as getting a fish through a maze with a number of obstacles to get passed... This is not that! The game itself is a simple match three, with the bonus of designing an aquarium with the coins you win (or buy). Pedestrian, but fine in itself. However I've uninstalled because I don't like being misled. Playrix do this with their other games too, very bad form guys. You should stand behind the games you've actually designed.

I have now deleted this game. After spending fruitless hours trying to get through the hardest levels just getting beaten again and again. The game decides whether you can complete it or not. Life is hard enough as it is, banging our heads on a brick wall to get through. We don't need a game to do the same to us. Lighten up Fishdom, let us feel that we can win something !!

They moved the goalposts. All walkthroughs online have 30 moves. Last update brought that down to 15 meaning not enough possibility for winning boosters/diamonds so the only way to complete the level is to buy a pass with real money or be stuck for weeks. It's not as advertised and is a bit of a con. I complained about it and about losing 2 special aquariums because it was impossible to complete all the tasks in time and they just said "we will pass it on to the developers". Not good enough!

It's an ok, fairly charming puzzle game that's basically candy crush but with fish and you build up an aquarium slowly. I'm unhappy that there's no level where you save the fish from different problems, as all of the advertisements portrayed. I'd seen the advertisements a few times and eventually thought I'd try it out but sadly it's a case of false advertising.

I want to have a choice in whether I have an update or not, you force them to stop the game and sometimes I don't have the speed to download fast as I'm on Data not WiFi. It's just annoying to wait 20 minutes to play while it's updating. I have to edit this review I thought it had loaded, it didn't, I uninstalled to see if loading that way may be faster no! It is forever stuck on Pending 😣. I can reload Fishdom.

I really like playing this game. But when you have to wait 30 to 60 mins for a life after you use 5 is just absolutely ridiculous. The ad is different from what the game actually is. So that's a downfall in itself. Instead of rewarding us with gems ect we have to purchase them which is just out of order. Developers need to re-think the way they have designed this game.

If you like basic matching games then it's not too bad. But you know the ads? The ones where you gradually eat bigger and bigger fish? Looked like a fun concept? Well I'm on level 100 now and that has come up one single time. Like I said it's alright as a matching game, although a bit basic. But if you're here based on the ads you've seen then just leave it.

GAME NOT AS ADVERTISED!! It shows a fish and a shark trapped in two different sections and you have to work out which rods to pull in which order to release the fish......NO. It's a match 3 game with a fish tank which you can decorate with the money you win. As match 3 games go, it's bog standard power ups etc but the aquarium stuff is just too childish for me. I was looking forward to playing a puzzle game and this is NOT A PUZZLE GAME.

First, I really like the many aquariums, adventures and match 3 puzzles. I have spent some money to get energy for the adventures when I get stuck on a hard puzzle. Second, I am disappointed that the fish eating everything and growing game is not anywhere In Fishdome. They should change the app picture and ads. I kept this game on my phone because I liked that plot, but I have yet to encounter it.

This game is very frustrating the programing is set up to get money out of you. I have noticed several things , Firstly I will be on a roll with free time or bonuses, if I get a phone call or text I need to take, when I go back to game I've been stripped of all the bonuses I gained. also if I use a triangle bonus it will usually take the color that us most needed. but if you are on a hard level never will it take the color that will win the level. this had happened again and again.

I've been playing this game since it hit Big Fish on PC in 2008. The game itself plays basically the same but now it's inundated with microtransactions and cards and teams and other dumb stuff which has totally ruined it. Even the fish in my aquariums are telling me to buy, buy, buy. They used to be fun. Now they're just salesmen. Absolutely ridiculous. No thanks. I miss the days where you bought a game once and the devs weren't trying to nickel & dime you every time you try and play.

honestly a pretty good game. basic but pretty good. I downloaded it to earn premium currency for another game and so far this is the only game I've actually completed all the offers for. there's no ads at all, the gameplay is just basic matching (the puzzle levels end after like 100 levels thankfully bc I don't like them) there were definitely some tricky levels but there's a lot of power ups/endless lives that help you make fast progress.

None of the ads I've seen display that it's yet another matching game. It's not a bad matching game, but there are unfortunately other games that offer the same gameplay only better. The power ups are pretty weak and the best one ,2 lightings, is completely random so you can't even strategize where they appear.The advertisements show a numbers game that appears occasionally as a mini game, on a much simpler scale. -2 stars for misleading ads and underwhelming gameplay, +1 star for having no ads.

Be aware on level 1233 it's a challenge level the game will freeze and you will not be able to back out of the game without losing all of your power ups and a life I just experienced this and tried talking to customer service if you call that customer service. And they've done nothing to restore it. Even though it's the games fault.

Wish you can save your unlimited lives/time Stop with the mini adventure game and bring back the mini matching game!!!!!! I want the mini merge game back!!! *update. Please bring back the mini merge game. Love this game. *upset about the update not having the mini matching game, and having the journey game instead. That one isn't enjoyable, and I don't understand why it's the mini game again when you usually go back and forth between the two.

Doesn't play as shown in the ad. Why? That game would be really fun. The bonus game never really changes and it's about moving levers to get the fish food to the fish. It's very simple and boring, since it never gets harder. The main game is better and the adventure & side games are fun. Still don't understand why they don't advertise the real game. The hard levels require you to purchase credits to get farther, but there's a lot of free play with this game.

Been playing for 2 years. Now it's turned into a money grab. I used to get a reliable gem every time I fed my fish. Now, lucky if I get one a day. power-ups disappear randomly during play. "Deals" pop up during timed bonus play, delaying your chances to benefit from bonuses. Forced claim of prizes is another new glitch. Customer service is NOT responsive. I've spent far too much $$. I would quit if I wasn't on a team; considering to delete the app. Too frustrating, not enough enjoyment.

The game forced me to update right in the middle of playing and there was no option to postpone it. I had active boosters and unlimited lives running, but while the game was updating, all of that bonus time expired. I lost my rewards for no reason. Please don't force updates during gameplay, or at least pause active timers until the update is complete. It was really annoying

I like the game ,however when there is a new update ,cards you have collected before the updates, it all vanishes and one has to start all over again and then to buy coins , it's quite pricey , thinking of the cost of leaving from where I come from , not the best.. so for the updates. please consider all the levels and gift cards acquired .

I love playing Fishdom because it is fun, relaxing, and entertaining. The graphics and puzzles are enjoyable, and I like decorating the aquariums. However, the game requires updates too often, sometimes every few days or every month. These updates use a lot of internet data and storage space, and sometimes the game does not work properly without updating. I kindly request the developers to reduce unnecessary updates and make the game smoother for all players.

Update: This game needs serious error improvement. I don't like the things disappearing randomly. While playing in a timed event. it wouldn't allow payment. insufficient funds Google play shows one balance. Fishdom shows $1 in Google Play. Since the recent update, bombs aren't as effective. What formerly took one move to finish. It leaves one block. Today, I ran out of diamonds in the middle of one hour of unlimited help. I spent too much money for too many errors.

I've had this get for a long time. I used to LOVE this game. the mingames would change every so often and there were always lots of ways to earn extra powerups to use in the main game itself. but over the years it's changed a lot and now there are way less options for getting them. Definitely makes you want to pay more often in order to be able to advance levels. I also really miss the matching mini game. now its only the quests, which makes you do a new tutorial every time it changes the story

This used to be a fun game. Graphics are great and good diversity in levels. But, with the latest updates players are leaving. Levels are now not just super hard but impossible to beat without using diamonds. Ok, not such a big deal but you now get fewer diamonds for the same $. This game is no longer focused on player experience and with that, making money. It is now just a money grab. And some players get booster activities while others don't. Support is lacking at best.

once you get past the beginner levels, you essentially have to pay to play. levels, even the green ones, are too difficult to pass without using multiple tools, gems for continued play, etc. I've only had this game a week and it's become too frustrating to play since lives take a very long time to renew and you have to have hundreds of tools or gems to continue to pass level after level. not worth it.

There is no actual game hear. this is a computer program that decides if you have spent enough time or money to pass the stages. The actual game mode that got me to download isn't even hear! the app picture shows a different game entirely. this is just a cheap and nasty rip off of candy crush! do not waste your time if downloading this from the advertisement!

the only good thing is that there aren't ads. once you've been playing for a while the levels become so ridiculously hard that it is no longer relaxing only frustrating. unless of course you "buy" extra moves or boosters. also when you would win a level, suddenly the boosters or the game play doesn't work as it should. wouldn't recommend.

I enjoy the game very much especially some of the upgrades. However if I buy a pack of 250 rubies, it will ensure i use the rubies so fast, expect me to buy more rubies 5 minutes later. Which is counterintuitive for them. At that point I can't afford to buy anymore (unless I don't pay my bills) and have to stop playing for several days therefore I'm no longer spending money in the game. I know the point of the game is to make money but better to get a little bit consistently than none at all

I've been playing this game since it came out, and I used to love it because it was somewhat relaxing. But now it is more stressful, It's very clear when the game is cheating so you get stuck and you've been forced to buy more diamonds everything is more expensive and the Royal challenge are super boring and repetitive and hard to pass. I'm really tempted to delete the game again.

it's adorable but it's certainly for a child...isn't quite hard enough BUT I love it anyways!! I am only in the early levels as well - and the short little fish eating puzzles were quite exciting on the ads but turns out there isn't just a bunch of levels where u eat a bunch of fish..it's mostly just match 3+ levels :/

Be very careful. I've played this game for a long time and am up to date with all the levels. They have a lot of challenges and extra games u play to win more things. Only problem is they have started putting their own "bots/fake players) into your challenges. This way u keep playing and dont win the challenges. I still pay the monthly pass, as I know 99% of the people that make this game want us to win. Hopefully the 1% that are ruining this game are fired, so the game is fair once and for all.

Simple but cool little game. Rating lost a star because I'm finding that lately the difficult stages are so hard that I could go more than a week without winning a stage, which is boring and frustrating. They also changed their boosters recently and the new ones aren't terribly helpful, and you hardly ever win any, so are forced to buy them...which is obviously the reason why.

I love the fact that there was actual thought put into this game, like there are no ads, at least when I play, then all the levels are fun. how they interduce new things to the player is awesome and the fact there's a lot of ways you can use coins and get coins are SO SO fun and cool. I love that you can decorate the starting area to, 5 out of 5 game to try it now.

I can't send 7 of my teammates any cards because they don't appear in the list for sending cards. This negatively affects every teammate by preventing a large percentage of our players from completing bonus games and winning tools to help the team in events. This has been going on for weeks with little to no response from support. There has been no compensation to allow for the disruption of this feature.

After this recent update. Im done. And Ive played for years. They've now made levels even more difficult and lowered the rewards. Not worth playing anymore and Ive spent quite a bit of money on this game. When you make a game this difficult, with little to no payout, what do you think is going to happen?

LIKE A GAMBLING ADDICTION. What a corrupt game. The moment you spend money, they will not let yet you progress unless you spend more. After $200 plus in a month. then I took away my automatic visa card payment method. I've been playing this game for 10 yrs and my addiction got real bad as it is rare to pass a game without points. And they hardly ever give you any hammers,cannons etc. They cost heaps to buy. DONT START THIS GAME, EVER.

I am playing this game for years and i use to love it. even purchased few season event but as the game is giving updates which is making it worse. now without paying you will never get a unique or rare fish which was the whole point of the game to engage, to complete the task. Previously they use to have season events. edit 1- why their is no more new event fish to collect which was the whole point of the game i use to enjoy. edit 2- Now they have removed the seasonal tanks with rare fishes.

Fun to play. enjoy the smoothness and the graphics. I did uninstall the game for a long while then re-download it. which made me remember why I removed it. Unless you spend money, it is next to impossible to pass levels and I created a team then got removed as the leader which made me mad because I created the team. So found a team, took me a couple of trys. Joined the team and Im not allowed to participate in the team challenges. Not quite sure if im going to completely uninstall for good.

Fun colorful, beautiful game.Downsides is if you want to advance you'd have to spend money for purple diamonds and power ups. $500 in 4 months, it added up real quick. My biggest problem with the game is the inability to save the unlimited lives for later when I have time to play a whole hour. Another annoying feature is when unlimited lives expire during game play it takes a life. The levels are getting harder and harder.

I'm giving it a one-star because of support. I've contacted support too many times of not being able to receive cards because they are not seen by other team members. Only resonse is from AI, and it's a known issue. There are 7 members of my team that are unseen to send cards to. I lost 180 gems and my super booster trying to get enough cards to finish hit the target this last weekend without team help. Please respond with an actual member from the development team

Just what I was looking for! When I'm in too good of a mood, I just replay the same 19 move level that really takes around 30, over and over again! And Playrix is so nice, they offer to sell you an extra 35 moves every time you fail! I keep a crumpled up piece of paper next to me to throw across the room instead of my phone, this way the game can ruin my mood but not my phone!

I would totally give this game 5 stars. I absolutely love it. but since the newest update it doesn't seem to work right. on the journey part of the game im literally stuck. it will. ot let me go anywhere. I've gone over inch and haven't missed anything. once this is fixed I would give a 5 star

POOR CUSTOMER SUPPORT. when there is an issue only an ai bot responds and then when they say they're going to transfer to a live agent, it can take anywhere from 5 minutes and never. NEVER REIMBURSE or COMPENSATE for the game having glitches and when you lose out daily challenges and rewards.

UPDATE (07/02/26) The mini games are gone and the prices have gotten ridiculously high The games have gotten so hard many people are saying they can't pass them without buying the play pass and extra diamonds/boosters Very interactive very fun so so cute it's not even fun anymore just keeps getting more and more expensive, it used to be my favorite game. It's never featured in Google Play

Inconsistencies with gaming events where beta testing is done selectively with players causing different events even for the players in the same group/team. When feedback of bugs are reported, the AI typical response is redundant as nothing is done for resolution. Nothing improves and every week we constantly experience gaming issues. No attempts by developers to rectify issues as main focus is to force players to pay to win. Game is now designed to be difficult when you do not make purchases.

I've been playing this game for over a decade but recently at least once a month I've noticed that the game makes you download for over an hour and then it takes several hours before you can access any of the extras or any of your other aquariums it's very aggravating and it eats up your battery for the day. I downloaded the update over 2 days ago and I still can't even play the map quest or open up any of my other aquariums I may just delete this game after a decade of playing.

So, it's a game designed to make playrix more than billionaire, as they are right now. Is a frustrating game for those that don't want to spend a lot of money, paying monthly at least 30 pounds...After 16000 levels, without paying loads for gems, you can't pass any "easy" level. Annoying and disgusting🤬🤬🤬 after the last update,they restrained the team's chat and if you lose a level several times, you have 5 moves instead of 35.

I understand removing open text chat for UK compliance, but it has completely killed the team spirit. It feels terrible not being able to say thank you to teammates who send cards. Playrix, PLEASE add a pre-set menu of emojis or quick-phrases (like "Thank you!", a waving hand 👋, or a party popper 🎉 for milestones). It would let us be polite and participate safely without open text chat!

i used to love this game and was even willing to spend money to purchase the pass, power ups etc but as time goes on they are getting greedy and stupid. update 2026- once again they are ridiculous. the in-app support is completely useless. it took 2 months for them to reply, they keep insisting that they gave the rewards but they didnt, the problem is still not resolved. i regret giving them a second chance and spending money. others be warned DO NOT PLAY.

I have been playing for a long time, great game. however a few days ago I lost ability to see or send messages. I now get a message saying I'm am not in right region or something. hard to be a helpful member of my group if I can't communicate. I'm in UK. What's happened, please fix.

Been playing this game 7 years it never gets boring free to play but can purchase to speed through levels if want but think that defects object of game, join a team you get lives and win diamonds 💎 highly recommend game is constantly being updated with new games within the game.

I think fishdom has put the final nail in the coffin by shutting down chat. Their excuse is for safety but it's obviously to stop players exchanging cards. We can no longer communicate as a team, so what's the point? Such a shame that greed, once again, has stopped a good game being fun. I will occasionally play but I will never ever pay to play.

terrible, game was fun, seems like some update came along and made the game super difficult, like you gonna be playing the same level for a week trying to beat it, and the only way to get past a level is to buy diamonds, they say itz a free play game which it is but you still gotta pay, there is no way to get past these levels without paying, so im done ✔️ my team is not even active anymore because if whatever changes were made, this is very sad. greed kills the world,
Sometimes friends and teammates are not showing to send cards. please let me know the issue and how to fix. the app has been Uninstaller and reinstalled. when we do this, the other doesnt show.

Since the algorithm has been drastically altered, it is rarely possible to pass a level first time. Super lightnings are invariably lost as soon as they're received, and collecting the cards has been made extremely difficult. Requests for lives are few and far between. I could go on, but seriously, this is a real p×ss take. Our team are all complaining about it. Get your act together Playrix, this is a shambles 👎🏼👎🏼👎🏼

I love Fishdom, however, nowadays whenever something new is introduced it takes away from the previous charm of the game. With every new update, the prizes are being reduced. I am highly disappointed especially today, so many bonuses have been removed that it just makes me not want to play anymore. I hope someone can do something about it. Edit: The new updates in the game 'Alchemy Week' has made in-game purchase mandatory to complete the side quest. Wow!! Greedy much!

what used to be a fun, enjoyable game has become so annoying to play after recent updates. I spend hours and often days trying to clear a single level, and as soon as I clear 10 levels to get the super lightening, I immediately lose it unless I spend money. This game is no longer fun or enjoyable. Also, support doesn't respond and just closes conversations. If I could give a negative star rating I would. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY ON THIS GAME! THE MORE YOU SPEND, THE MORE IMPOSSIBLE THEY MAKE IT.

THERE'S NO ADS!! that being said... they have to make money somehow, which they do with levels you can't beat without buying powerups or extra diamonds to buy additional moves. so be aware of this fact before you decide to play. now the game is fun and i enjoyed the time on it but advancing in the higher levels won't happen unless you spend money. and this fact is proven as I have been stuck on the level 789 for over a week and a half. sadly this will be the second playrix game I'm uninstalling.

It's impossible to continue playing without spending money. They have priced themself out of business! This game used to be more fun than Candy Crush & you got to have fish tanks! Now, there are so many side challenges, cards & games that you have to play in order to get your tools for the original game! It's almost impossible to achieve any of the required goals anyway! It is all about getting you to spend money! They have killed the fun & left you feeling inadequate at achieving any goals! Sad

Fishdom has become too frustrating at high levels. Many levels feel almost impossible to complete without boosters, extra moves, bombs, or diamonds. A difficult level is fine, but it should still feel fair and realistically passable through normal gameplay and skill. Support cannot confirm whether every level is technically passable without boosters, and there seems to be no official information about this. This makes the game feel more like pressure to spend money than a fair puzzle game.

I used to enjoy this game from so many years. But now it's becoming so boring because after spending a lot of time and using the boosters also u can't pass the level. Normal levels also difficult to pass. I think i will stop playing... As the game became nice, time pass game to so annoying and boring game... the new mini game mine quest is sooo boring... pls change

You have to make almost double the coins to get through just one aquarium.\nIt does take forever, it's not a bad game.But when you have the right amount of coins and you buy what you need for the aquarium and then you're still sixty thousand short , doesn't make sense

The game has changed to pop up purchasing more lives with diamonds. It has now made me unintentionally purchase more lives using my diamonds. I have several free time boosters available that I haven't used yet so why would I need to purchase more lives. I have reached out twice in the chat to resolve this with no response.

YOU TAKE MONEY (FROM THOSE THAT PAY) BUT TAKE AWAY THE FREEDOM TO CHAT WITH TEAM MATES WHAT'S NEXT?The latest update is rubbish you are taking the fun out of the game, making levels harder, you give a profile icon but take away sending to fb friends what next? update: team chest from 6000 levels to 8000 levels to win all three and now, what else are you going to do to stop us enjoying playing so many are leaving with these so called updates

Just like every other Playrix game after level 1600 the levels become near impossible to win without spending money. Too many levels in a row that cannot be passed in 10 or less trys become no fun and I end up deleting the game. I play to relax, not be endlessly frustrated. Any level that takes 20+ trys to pass is cause for deletion for me.

I love this game it's very addicting and very challenging at times but yes they push on buying their gems to play but I just ignore it n continue playing it. sorry I had to lower my score to a 2 stars due to the lastest update I no longer get the part of the game I loved which was smashing threw the game collecting energy and , so what happened to it? it's stays at 2 stars until I see it back. I might uninstall it at this point. bummer!

This is the only game I kept on my phone. I play it to relax but latley I struggle with most of the levels. You can't even start a new fishtank without a certain amount of stars and I use to play often. Use to love it alot, but officially is going to uninstall this game after a few years of playing and I will not pay just to play a game.

First, the ad they use to get you to download the app. Is not there much then not at all. I want the save the fish now it is just blowing things up. You pick a item to help win the level and they put it right were it does no good. Such as a bomb right were if they didn't put it there one move and you would have a bomb anyway. Most of the time they put it were you cannot make any other moves until you use it. they fixed the save the fish for a few weeks then disappeared again.

when you make your puzzles so impossible to beat at level 39 unless you spend real $, well then you my friends can get bent. pay to exist, not even a pay to play, because then you would have a chance. 30 minutes, that's how much of my life I will never get back after playing this, with nothing positive. just be honest in the description. free to exist, because there is no chance unless you pay. you got my once, never again. deleted with no looking back.

Prior to the update you could go in and out of a level in order to get a favorable drop or piece placement in order to beat the level. After the update, that would cost you a life and any booster that you may have chosen to use. Oh and get this......it all comes after jacking their in game purchases by 40%.

To start. 99% of the critical reviews are completley accurate.This game is completely fixed. After a bit you find the strategies to beat it, but eventually the game always makes you lose to incourage spending your money. The game becomes heavily reliable on power ups to "improve" your chances. These power ups are barely helpful and don't seem to actually help you beat the games. You can only play one game at a time and you never choose the game. I'm at level 103, for 2 days of casual playing.

Came to level 41, now it asking me to buy "get more lives"? Guess, it's an internal application error, since it is a free game? Or I could wait to get the next life for free... But you cannot pass the level 41 without additional extras. And that are things you need to buy again... Time to uninstall it. However, I must admit, it is a good game... I would buy it one off, but here the game engine would just squeeze money out of my pocket. No, thank you! Overall, 3 stars are okay.

Eventually, the game gets so hard, and changes the rules without giving notice, that you will need to spend money every day to pass levels. So, play for a while, DON'T PAY, and then walk away before you are spending 1 or 3 dollars a day. I blew through all my game credits, like $10, and cannot beat the current level. It adds up fast. I paid a few dollars here and there but this game is not worth what i predict would be $10-$20 a month. No way.

Yeah so I decided to try the game after watching it in ads and the mini games caught my attention. I thought that I would play the fish eating the other fish and defeating the bigger ones, and so forth... But after I downloaded it and started to play it, I found out that I don't get to play hardly any mini games. Instead, like all these other games (Royal Match, Gardenscapes, and so forth), I mostly get those puzzles, where I have to match things. It's just as lame as the other games!

This game is pretty one dimensional. The main game to get coins for new fish for the aquarium is LAME!. I hate it and would probably uninstall if not for my 2yr old son that likes watching the fish swim around. Also, it's false advertising since the mini games you see on the ads are NOTHING like the actual game experience. If you like games that are repetitive in nature, then you might like this, but it's not for me. Planet fish was the best phone fish game imo. Wish it would come back.

I like the game. It's fun. I'm just sick of the pay to play/win game structure. Make a game skill based and charge for the game. I'd be more than happy to pay for it. All this "buying lives" to play and buying power ups to help clear levels and compete against other players is old and I just won't play a game like that. So I will be uninstalling this. Graphics are clean, controls are simple, Game play you get 5 "lives" to clear a board. after that you have to by more or wait for a timer to play.

Sadly after installing it in the 4 years I've been away from it, just moments after I've logged in, my old tank was there and was asked to join a team. Meh, not wanting to join a team, you gave me no option to decide. Then, when it says 'great' and an arrow moving up and down you've asked that we tap. And that's the problem, I tapped alllllll over my phone and it did nothing. I even closed it up and restarted it, 3 or 4 times to then say right, this thing is frozen & it sucks, coz I cant play!

Fun game until you get to near level 100, then break out the wallet to get any further. Several levels are impassable until you spend all your boosts gained through other levels. Then you hit the pay to pass levels. If these game designers would make the game more passable with some better rewards or special characters that are cheaper, more people would be more likely to spend two or three bucks more often than one hundred bucks once. All that said, have fun for a while then uninstall.

False Advertising! Otherwise okay... I keep seeing ads for this game on other apps that promise key-moving puzzles where you have to get the water to the fish without letting the lava near the fish or the water, but I have tried out this game on different occasions and this is a match-3 game. Nowhere is there puzzles like the ones advertised, i'm surprised the game and the company making it have not gotten into trouble for false advertising. The game is okay, but False Advertising is NOT OKAY!!!

Downloaded based on an ad in another free game. The ad was not representative of the actual game (this is a Candy Crush-style game, not solving spatial puzzles like the ad). Cute game but, unlike the free game where I saw it advertised, Fishdom is ad-free - which means you don't get very far into the game before purchases must be made to move on. I actually liked the game enough that I'd watch ads to play it for free, but it's not worth being nickel & dimed repeatedly.

This game is ok. The puzzles are challenging enough most of the time. But when the squid is introduced, the game gets really stupid. You see a way to get a power up but no, you have to wait for the stupid squid to move first and then it's gone. Oops you didn't save the squid in time, now you lose. If you don't mind frustrating puzzles, this is for you. So, so.

I have played this game for years. Very disappointed and pretty much over it. With each update, comes more glitches. Matches don't create the bonuses accurately. I don't mind spending a little $ to play a game I enjoy. But this has just become a drain. Lessen the number of days of the gold pass. I used to get it, when it was for 30 days. Now everytime it is a different duration. I am on the hunt for something else, because this just isn't it anymore with all the glitches that work in their favor

Its cute how you can name your fish and decorate an aquarium, however, I wouldn't exactly describe this game as free. I made it level 35 or 36 (don't remember which), but because I ran out of explosives in the previous challenge, the game made it absolutely impossible to solve this level without purchasing explosives with real money. Had fun for about 30 mins, after that I realized its just a waste of time.

Started playing it for fetch points. It's nothing like the ads. Why do games do that? Anyway, I enjoyed the game for a while, but it's getting too frustrating trying to beat "super hard" levels. Inevitably, I run out of moves when all is needed to complete is one or two more moves. Conveniently you can purchase gems to trade for more moves at that point, which I've done a couple times. Which is stupid, considering I tried the game for points that amount to roughly the same amount.

Recently, your in app purchases has changed from monthly for the levels to about 12 days. My issue is that now I have been stuck at a level for about a week so far, it happens, but after 7 days of not advancing from the same level, there are more than several levels I didn't get to reach and after paying the same amount you charge for a month, will be lost. I have been paying regularly but now I will not anymore. What would be the point?

The game lures you in with the little fish becoming bigger and bigger by eating other fish. Then you find out that that's only after a certain (unspecified) level. It also requires frequent updates that use more and more memory until, it seems, the only thing left on your phone will be Fishdom. It was fun for a while, but not really worth it for another match 3 game.

I am beyond disappointed. The advertisement is a blatant lie. I wanted to save the little fish but no. It's some match 3 game like Gardenscape or Homescape (also made by this developer). I should have known. They use false & deceptive advertising for all the other games of theirs that I've tried. I did give the game a shot. It's boring and once you get into higher levels, it becomes impossible without putting money in or tons of lives per level. I do not recommend & I am uninstalling.

It's a fun game and I get they have to make money. But in their zeal to push you to spend $$$, they basically crippled the game. You quickly run into levels that have impossibly low moves and you can't complete it, no matter how many time you try. Only way is to use gems (for more moves) or special items, which they give small amount to start. Once depleted, you'll run into more impossible levels and you will be forced to spend $$ to get more. Rinse & repeat. That's the game in a nutshell.

Nice game that helps you burning some time, but there's an issue with the free game time that you receive. You are beating levels/tasks and as a price, you will get some free time to play. The problem is that there's no option to redeem the price when you want, but only right away. And if not, you can't play the game until you redeem it It's so annoying and unfair, as I'm finding myself many times loosing that because I don't have time to play 1 hour non stop in the morning. Please fix it!!!

I loved the old fishdom graphics. When you did the last update it changed the look of the game pieces, ie; the G, pearls, sea shells ect. Why change something that is working? If it's not broken, don't fix it. We got used to the graphics/game pieces, have looked like, for years now. It's hard to play with the game peices looking way fake & hard to look at. I really hope you can change it back. I tried to play and I just can't. Fishdom was a favorite game of mine. I used to play everyday.

Not what I was expecting, installed the game because an add showed something resolving puzzles, instead I found an old sliding game and no mental effort is needed for it. Don't get me wrong, game seems fun (for certain public), it's well designed and graphically nice, and as in most games, to make it easier you have to spend real money, so is not for me.

I've been playing Fishdom for years now, probably since it's creation. I loved it! I, along with many other long time players, are now seriously thinking of deleting it and finding another game to play. Fishdom developers have been changing everything players loved about the game. It is no longer fun and exciting. They have made the levels too difficult to beat without multiple boosters and then made it harder to earn boosters. The only real option now, if you want to win, is to purchase them.

I gave three stars because At level 20 (The Hard Level) you have to purchase things to help you successfully pass and go to the next level. I understand the need to make money buuuuut this is starting to get annoying...I don't want to purchase anything! Which means I guess I should uninstall the game. I really like the game, its enjoyable and I love fish lol I played the level literally 9 times and get down to one nugget and since I dont have enough gems or coins I lose a life... Sucks! 🤨

It's pretty fun but it can be tough, and takes away from the enjoyment getting repeatedly beaten when your lives are low. It takes forever to get more lives, and of course there's the ever present options (pressure) to purchase things. I'm less likely to pay if I feel like the game is being unfair. At times I swipe things one way and they go the other way, costing me a move. Decorating the tanks is fun but tedious due to slow earning.

It's a big lie. It's only a match3 game, no other mini games. I'm at level 62 and there are still NO MINI GAMES! All the match3 games are very boring and difficult at the same time. You can't choose the difficulty levels, so when you're stuck at "super hard", you need to pay to play. All Playrix games (Homescapes, Manor Matters, Gardenscapes, Township are pay to play and match3 games. They lie in the advertisements. Don't download them! Also: it was very difficult to find the review option.

Fun at the start, terrible later. So starting out its easy and get all these power ups. But the moment you stop playing and the timers expire, you lose all the power ups except what you save. Then later you get levels that unless the RNG gods are with you, you can't beat unless you use tons of power ups and if not have to pay to win. Not including the 5 games before having to wait on a timer to play more which is 30 minutes for one recharge. Pay to win game and super disappointing later on.

Ive never gotten the fish coins for watching a video..three times this has happened. I also don't like that some of the levels (like the Moon One) only allow a very small number of fish...AND you have those "back to back" bonuses of an hour or two to play for free...I'm NOT going to play this game for three hours straight! The hard levels are ridiculous...and why can I only put a certain number of fish in each tank?

Beautiful visuals, top marks to the artists - however, I was unfortunately left disappointed very quickly. I had this game relentlessly advertised at me while playing other games, and found myself quite intrigued by the puzzles that were (exclusively) presented during the ads. I eventually decided to install the game and start working on those puzzles - only to discover that the actual gameplay was completely unrelated to the advertised gameplay. Guys, do yourselves a favor and show honest ads

I gave 2 stars because I love this game with so much of my being, but I also hate it. I love it because of the little praises the fish give, I enjoy the decorating, and the few mini games I've actually seen I like. However I hate that levels (level 508) give only 10-12 moves. And they only give you 5 lives! There's almost no way of being able to win most levels unless you get lucky or have bombs. And there is almost no mini games! This game is just plain annoying now and I'm about to uninstall.

Fun game. Not quite the game like the ads on FB though. It is pay for play, so I'm getting ready to uninstall. It doesn't give freebies to play. Would be nice if the items you place in the tanks gave some tokens along the way. Also, an occasional mini game during the wait would be ok. Entire game locks you out if you do not pay. It's frustrating to wait 25 or more minutes to play. Time to look for another. Cute but too many hurry ups to wait. Made it to Level 82 in a few days...

This is a cute game, but the ads I saw aren't very representative of what the gameplay actually is. Based on the ads, I was expecting it to be a Spore-like game where your fish must eat bigger and bigger fish to eventually become the biggest, but that's... actually just a mini-game that occasionally shows up in-between levels. The actual game is a match-3 game. Rating 4 stars because it's good for what it is as far as I can tell, and the fish are cute. Just not my cup of tea or what I expected.

Ok. I've been playing this game for years. I have spent quite a bit of money too, I'm not happy to say. The last several times I've bought diamonds, though to continue the game, once I purchase, it kicks me back to the start page and the game I was on disappears! I have lost at least 3 games this way! I really enjoy this game, but it's getting worse! I should have a much higher score and record but for whatever reason it messes me up! Also, I will be about to win it all and then it stops!! Grrrr

Nice game but.. At first few levels. You get diamonds that you can use to help you get through them. Later they go into the "pig" and you have to buy it with real money. Very quickly levels become so hard that you have to spend days on them and most likely you won't beat them anyway or you start spending more money buying "help items", or just stop playing and uninstall the game. That's what I did.

This was my absolute favorite game...until recently. Currently it is saying I need to update, but it's just been spinning all day. Will probably end up telling me I need to pay to update. Echoing previous reviews..paying more and receiving less in the form of bonues and power ups. I have spent quite a bit of money on this game...now I can barely pass a level if I don't buy extra power ups which used to come with the seasonal bonuses. Not anymore. you gotta pass too many levels to reach the next

I used to love this game, but now after I play several levels, there are no more. you get a message saying more levels coming soon and you have to play some treasure chest thing for which you get pretty much nothing! When playing the treasure chest levels, you do not get coins for left over bombs, lightning etc. and the seahorse show goes away, too. And you have to beat a specific number of levels to even get any coins etc. Unfortunately, I'm about done with fishdom!!

I can handle the adds, but this game is too expensive to play. The puzzles game, matching items game is addictive, fish in the tank are cute - But this money grabs too much! If i could pay a $10 a month membership and save a lot of money. Had to uninstall, disapointed. / Example, you earn jems in the tile matching game - and when the piggy bank is full, you pay $5 to access your gems. But everything is so expensive, they won't last long.

Not a bad game. But deceptive, and almost requires you to purchase stuff to proceed at a certain point (play to win). The most annoying part is that you only play the fish growth game you see in the ads maybe 3 times at the beginning, then it's just another match-the-pieces game for 95% of it...they purposely do that to make it seem like it's the game they advertised but it's not. If they actually included the fish growth game beyond the very beginning I might change my rating.

I have played this game since 2018. I enjoyed it immensly. However it has now turned into a crash grab. I used to pay for the Golden ticket around once a month. It was well worth it & I didn't mind paying 8 dollars or so for a month's power ups. However after I bought the last one I see it's only for 6 days. I have seen alot of similar complaints about a 6 day Golden ticket. Sadly I will probably be like many players & delete this game. They are just asking for too much money. 😡🤬😢

False Advertising. The advertisement I saw for the game has nothing to do with the gameplay. I'm assuming you guys make Gardenscapes as well based on the ad vs actual gameplay. Weird thing to do considering both games have good reviews and tons of downloads. I'm guessing the ads I saw are more appealing to the 18-35 demographic, which is why you did that. I won't support misleading advertisements, regardless of the game. Whack.

This is not like the ads. They really should just put a level that is exactly like the ads every 5 levels. It's ridiculous that they have 1 level near the start that is similar, and the rest of the game is Matchington Mansion but with fish bowls instead of mansions. It is actually quite a fun game with very cute fish and decorations for their fish bowls. It is just an absolute shame the ads and the game are so completely different. Really, please just add levels that are like the ads. 🙏

Although I enjoy the game, I do t know how long I will stick with. I'm on level 214. The hard and super hard levels, as well as some of the normal levels are so difficult that I have to spend 3 and sometimes 4 days to complete a level. in addition. it's the same ad over and over again to gain an extra gem. how many times do I need yo see an ad for Innovage?

I saw an advert for this in another game. In the ad you were a fish being chased by a shark and you had to choose objects to try and defeat the shark amd escape. It was fun, so I installed the game. However, there is no chase or strategy in the game. The game is just another version of CandyCrush! BORING! A complete lie! Why are the adverts allowed to be completely false?!

Nothing like the ads, you build aquariums. Seems like fun but gers boring pretty quick. I deleted the app but then saw the cool ad, where you eat smaller fish to get bigger and then eat bigger fish smaller than you. This game doesn't do that at all. So I don't know what the ad has to do with thus app at all. You simply build your aquariums, clean them, feed your fish, then come back later to maintain them.

Save your $$. This is a "free" game, but its really pay to play. Go purchase a game that doesn't make you exchange coins for lives!! (I rec. Angry birds, Best fiends, Chuzzle) I uninstalled this game bc over a year, this game cost me more than I paid for any of my Xbox games. There were times I was stuck for days or weeks. The $5, $10, or $20 gem packages add up quickly. At higher levels, the game cheats. It accidentally, on purpose, falls in un-winable patterns.

My four year old son wanted this game because of the "save the fish" ads we were seeing. I enjoy the match 3 games and he enjoys filling up his fish tanks, but he keeps asking me when do we get to save the fish??? As far as I can tell, there's no puzzles for saving the fish. Just annoying ads showing a game that doesn't exist. Meanwhile, the game play quality is good and I enjoy everything else about it. Just wish we were getting what we were shown!

This is a great game, but only if you spend a bunch of money, other wise you get stuck on many levels for days. The rewards that you get are not fair either, they dont give out enough coins or power ups for beating the harder levels. When I realized how much I had spent on buying items to get out of the level that I had been stuck at for days, I was blown away... This game is a trap to get your money.!

I now have to be wary of every game that has character level-up minigames and in-app purchases now. The minigames, while OK, are short, rare and hidden behind match-3 puzzles, terrariums, microtransactions and VIP reward paths. And like every in-game currency app, the game constantly reminds you of your familiars (fish), and throws "bundles" and "competitions" at you every 3-5mins. I've yet to meet a game that only gives you just 1 thing to focus on, that isn't a purchase.

Honestly a fun puzzle game that I really enjoy, however, it's only playable if you can spend money on it. I refuse to spend real money to finish levels, so I end up spending days on a single level till luck comes my way with the daily free items/jems. I'll probably be uninstalling this game soon. Wish I could play more, but it's simply just not for people who want to play for free. ): I'd be happy to sit through adds, but oh well.

A money grab. Too few moves to complete levels, way too stingey with gems, lives take too long to refill....I could go on and on with how frustrating this game is. I wish I had never started and never gave them any of my money. Games do not get easier when stuck on a level. I have been stuck for days on a single level. And their help desk does not answer your questions if it is not specific. Other people on YouTube show way more lives then anything I've ever gotten. Time for a new game

This game is extremely fun during the introduction, but quickly turns into a money grabbing scheme. You can't play any of the games unless you have lives, which take 20 minutes or more to regenerate and you max out at five unless you purchase them. Everything else in the game is similar. The beginning introduces you to all the fun aspects, then as soon as you get the hang of it, everything costs real money. What a shame, this game is really fun.

Officially made it to level 500, and there have been enough "little fish vs big fish" to count on one hand. That's the reason I wanted to play in the first place, and it's obvious I'll never play a level as advertised. The main game itself is just okay. Graphics are cute, and the game play is decent enough. But as other players have said, once you get to the "super hard" levels, you can literally be stuck on it for days until you randomly get a pattern in your favor.

It's just okay. Same ole trick. The biggest irritation for me is the trickery. If you've seen the ads which compelled you to download... It's the mini games which look cool... But you'll seldom see them. They are far and between. It's just another game with false advertisement. Really disappointed. Good luck waiting for the mini game you downloaded it for. You won't see it. If you like being suckered... This is your dumb downed version of bejeweled and games alike

Editing my review from 3 years ago. I originally gave 5 stars now it just sucks. It's definitely a P2P game now. I'm past level 3000 and if I spend money my levels will be "super hard, challenge, hard, regular, super hard" just so that I have to use what I just bought. Then you'll be stuck on a "normal" level for 24 hours after your bonuses are gone. If you buy the bi weekly bonuses you'll have to spend even more money to beat the levels to get the chest at the end. I used to love this game 😔

I kept seeing this app's ad on another game I was playing. The ad showed that it was a puzzle type game. After I downloaded it & played it for a little while I figured out that it wasn't like the ad showed, at all. It just one of those candy crush type games that you have to match similar items in a certain amount of moves. The ad is very deceiving, had I known what it truly was I would never have downloaded it, so be warned. I am deleting this app, hope this was helpful to who ever reads this.

I agree with the other reviews. The increasing difficulty just ruins the fun. And the challenge levels are pretty much impossible unless you have a ton of ammo. Also since you don't have a choice whether to play them or not you shouldn't lose anything if you don't beat them. I thoroughly enjoyed this game the first few thousand levels(5 stars all the way), but the more I play the less and less stars I would give. I understand the difficulty should increase but not to the point of impossibility.

Too expensive! Some levels are extremely difficult. And before you know it, you're making in app purchases. Not getting a lot back for your money and you spent a fortune. It's a fun game but it will trap you in to spend money. What they need to do is give a little bit more chances in the hard, difficult levels. How are you supposed to eliminate 75 pieces that need to be blown up with only fifteen turns! BS UNINSTALLED!

My review today is not about the game in general.. the game is great. I really do not like the recent upgrade for the Gold pass.. I feel like we are getting ripped off. I'm paying the same money for less options and only if I pass a level. Most of the time I try to beat the challenges for coins to open the chest. It's the only way I can pass some of the levels

Typical "candy crush" type of game. Started off fun. I was looking forward to the mini games, but they are missing in action. The mini games are the reason I installed the game on my device. Furthermore, I refuse to spend real money for fake money or to beat levels. Don't think I will keep the game. But, on the other hand, it kills time, the idea of building the aquariums to your liking is kinds neat

I love this game but like all the other players raising the cost of playing, the level of difficulty, the length of time to complete a level, how quickly the gold pass game ends and the rising costs I am so unhappy, even frustrated with playing the game. Sometimes when you're on a difficult level, which is almost all of them, you can see the coloured balls etc fall as if it's rigged. Your response is to contact support inside the app, that does ZERO. They say they'll send to the developers. Done

I had high hopes for this game when I found it in the app store. I own almost every Playrix game on the PC and they are all amazing (4 elements 3 please). This game did not disappoint I love that you get to collect lots of different fish and have several tanks to decorate. The levels are challenging but not to the point of being frustrating like many other similar games I've tried. 5/5

False advertising. they show a puzzle game which is nowhere in the game. I read the comments after to see what was going on, and this problem has been brought up several times, which they said they would bring up to the development team, but they still haven't fixed it. Super unethical, so I'd recommend not downloading it. They need to either include puzzle levels or take the advertisement down, instead if just commenting like oh, yeah, we'll take care of it

The game isn"t what"s advertised. That game looked like fun. It showed helping fish get through a series of obstacles. So I installed it. But it is just matching 3 or more pieces with powerups like candy crush. Don"t install if you want the game advertised. This isn't it. I was hoping it was a level thing. I'm on level 19 now. But reading the reviews to find out what level, I've learned that there isn"t one. One reviewer played over 400 levels.

When I tried to play today, it said to update the game now and recieve a gift. So I updated it. When update was finished I tried to play again.. it still says: update and recieve a gift. And this message wont disappear. Thanks for the gift, being such a waste of my time. Mini games come almost never and they were the reason for me downloading the game in the first place. I agree with others who say that the decorations and fishes are way too expensive, progress is slow and you get stuck for days

Still waiting for the part where I "rescue" the fish as that was the entire reason I downloaded the game. That said, the game is rather addicting as well as challenging. Try not to let the game pressure you into spending too much money. Though, I do wish there was an easier way to earn more gem. One "watch this ad for ONE gem" every other day isn't particularly helpful. Also, maybe it's just my phone, but the game seems to like to move pieces in different directions than I chose.

I agree with what the others have been saying. This game has become a buy diamonds or can't pass levels game. Boring!!! This no longer makes the game free to play. If you don't change this soon, I am deleting the game and moving on. I refuse to have to spend money every second level to pass it, since there are so few moves that it is impossible to pass without using extra bombs etc. Listen to what we are trying to tell you.

The fishdom game is fun on a 7th grade level, but I really dislike the sudden-death purchase requirements. There's no warning, just suddenly, while you're trying to blow up something, you find you have no more moves left and you must purchase more (for real cash) to finish the game. Nevertheless, once you find out the nastier bits needing cash to fix them, it is fun and the 'pilotfish' (my term, since he pilots us from place to place) is perfect. His comments and requests are asorable.

This game is super fun, but I will reiterate the two main points that the other reviewers have stated. One, it is a total money grab. It is very difficult to get through some levels without making a purchase. (Developers, just because you keep saying that it's designed to be played without purchasing doesn't make it so. Perhaps you should listen to your users). Two, I am well past level 700 and have yet to see the minigame with the big crowd of fish that you have to eat your way through.

Last few updates has nerfed my progress. Played for years and about to uninstall it. The game is totally random and weight on is added to randomness to get what you need in the moment. The more you play the more likely you get that thing you need. However, same level now for a week and progress came to a screeching halt which has never been the case in 7100 levels. They want you to buy the power ups, but I refuse.

Misrepresented in ad's. Billed as a puzzle game, but it's really a match game. On the upside; there are puzzles just like the ones that are advertised. They're just mini games that you get to play after completing a match challenge. If you like match games as well as puzzles, this app may be for you. Me? I feel like I was lied to, to get me to install it. Uninstalled. Asks the players for real money for perks, lives, and other things to clear levels. Someone's gotta Pay the bills I guess.

fun game, colorful and creative. I like the puzzles and the story line, cleaning the tank, decorating and adding accessories, feeding the fish. been playing a week or so, got a pretty high score and was 2nd place in the first 2 terdimants. got to level 91, a super hard level, used all my resources, spent more money on gems for more moves, cant beat it. disappointing too, cuz I really like this game. u have like 20 moves, have to destroy 107 blocks, there all locked, impossible😕

This is game is horrible. It's not even as advertised and what I wanted to play in the first place. There's no eating other fish. It's not even fun. It's infuriating if anything. Levels can be hard but not straight up impossible. I spent an hour trying to beat one singular level and used all the powerups in existence yet still it was unbeatable. Why do I need powerups every single level?? This game just wasted my time. Uninstalling without the slightest bit of a doubt.

This game started off being really fun. I especially liked the greenhouse mission part of the game. I am giving this one star because at a certain point you cannot proceed any further without investing A LOT of money. You can play a lot of levels before it gets really bad. Once you get to the most fun parts of the game is when it becomes clear you aren't getting any further without a substantial payment. It really ruins an otherwise fun game. Corporate greed strikes again.

False Advertising! Was looking forward to playing the cool looking lava, shark, pin pulling game to protect the fish as it swam! Instead, after giving in to all the advertisements and downloading the app. I find that this is no different than a Candy Crush style game! What a waste of time. How frustrating. I even read about how others were "tricked" into downloading the same game only to be disappointed that it is not as advertised. 😭 Shame on you!

Your ad implied you had changed the game format. I grew tired of the match 3 game a long time ago & uninstalled it. But I gave it another shot because the "new game" looked like fun. Nope! Same old match 3. Someone said it's a mini-game, but I didn't stick around long enough to find out. Fishdom Solitaire is using the same tactics & the same exact ad. This time I checked screenshots & comments before downloading. Y'all won't fool me again. Bye bye!

I used to enjoy the game a lot, then it seemed you had to spend more and more, or you got stuck at a level. Jokes is I had to change my review because I recently stopped playing because I was spending too much on BS. Always having to pay for something you have already earned, ie the "fishy bank" I wish I could get half the money I spent back and I wouldn't think this and other similar games are such a waste of time and money. Do yourself a favour, stop playing this game and others like it.

I really liked this game, it's fun to play and looks great. I let my younger children play the game because it helped them with math. The problem is the gems are used up so quickly and then you can't play anymore. You shouldn't have to use gems in order to play the level. I understand using the gems during a level to maybe purchase new cards or to enhance the level, but not to simply play it. I'm uninstalling it because with the way it is now, it's frustrating to continue to play.

One more game where what's shown in the ad (and thus the decision to download it) is misleading. What's shown in the ad is a "minigame" that occurs every once in a while. But the main game is a tile matching game like candy crush. Not a fun game, and even if it was I would still uninstall out of principle. If your game isn't compelling enough to get people's attention without misleading ads, you don't have a good game.

One of the best games ever. Would have been the number one if the following is added 1. If one is able to pause and continue later 2. If one can carry forward his/her moves. Eg. If I'm given 10 moves to complete a task, but I used only 5, the rest five should be reserved so that when I'm out of moves in the future, I can fall on them. With these in place, no game can beat this. If you're downloading this game, please make it a point to join team "winners" where champions are.

The aquariums are beautiful; so are the fish. However, the goal of this game, as with most games, is the developers want you to buy things with money. You have to use all your gems, lives, bombs, etc. just to pass a level. Ridiculous number of boxes to clear and gold to get with very little moves. I uninstalled the game.

Yet another game that is nothing like the advertisement. All of the games from this developer are like that. You don't get to save the fish (or the guy in his garden, etc.) It's too bad, because the gameplay shown in ads actually looks fun. The developer should try to make a game like the ads, instead of just rebranding the same style game with different themes. This is just another Bejeweled knock off with a story built in where you have to earn coins to buy and upgrade things.

Fisdom ad is false advertising. The ads shown are one of the mini games. Every time I see the ad, I'm disappointed it's not the real game. I got to level 17, and the mini game, which is advertised, is no longer popping up. It is a different mini-game. To the app developer, the actual game is great. It is a good puzzle, so why not promote the actual game. I recommend that instead of the mini game, create the actual game that lured people here.

So, it's good for distraction sometimes but it wants you to buy everything. When you get on super hard levels, you're pretty much screwed if you don't have perks attached and there's no other way to get the perks other than completing levels or buying them (cash or buying gems). It's very annoying. Also, it's not as advertised- I've only played the fish eating game ONCE and it hasn't appeared since. There's no way to select what game you want to play.

No big surprise, but the further you get in this game, the more money they want you to spend. The last straw with me was the Deep Sea Adventure segment. Some of the hard to acquire pieces would suddenly disappear while waiting for the "bubble" to dissipate. Very frustrating. Otherwise the game was sort of fun. Great graphics and story line. End of the road for me here.

Addicted - I love the graphics, game play, and events. currently, the only issue that irritates me is the unlimited lives. I just got a surprise 1 hour and then a 2 hour. this would be great if I wasn't headed to bed. I wish there was a way I could bank these to a limited amount and use them when I can, for instance on my lunch break or when I have time to waste. really want to stay up for 3 hours and play but work comes first. please consider a banked option for unlimited lives.

Pay to play! Waste of $! Cash grab! Greedy developers! Used to love playing this game but now it seems like they just want $ from you. There used to be just a monthly challenge you'd pay for, but now they want you to pay the same amount just for a weekly challenge that's almost impossible to complete anymore. Shame on the game developers for taking the fun out of things.

I have enjoyed playing this game for a while now. I even started buying the season pass. But when the price went up, the levels got harder to beat with using all the boosters. For the past few weeks, I've been playing the same levels over again. I also can't feed my fish in 2 tanks. I've contacted support & their bot assured me I was not playing the same levels and have not received any feedback on feeding my fish. I am stuck on the same level with no coins or gems. Waste of time for no fun.

Loved this game, have spent more than enough money in it, but now I think I'm done. I have just noticed last night that it shows a certain number of items to clear, but it is not keeping track of what I'm clearing now. Ex. 2 squids left to clear, 1 clears by moving into a line of 3 of the same color, but it doesn't deduct it from the total left to clear, so i still show 2. So, it's now feeling like I'm being scammed to spend even more money. It's happened in 5 games today - that I noticed! SMH

So, I seen the ad for this game and it looked like fun. Then, I played it. It is nothing like the ad for it. It is Bejeweled but with shells. After going through a few games and not even seeing what was advertised and shown as you strategically going after bigger fish and eating them thus creating your fish to get bigger. Simple right. Not even close. I uninstalled it. You are not even given a decent amount of time to play the game before it cuts you off for you to begin again. Sucks

The levels have been changed to make them exponentially more difficult. Being able to beat levels without spending money is not the point. It's that it makes the game miserable, if you don't. I generally spend money on the games I play. Not ones where it's obvious you're being frustrated into spending it. Then they troll the reviews telling people to use a better strategy? It's not that deep and it is pure luck on some levels. Quit being dishonest.

If you're a new player, or someone looking to download, you should look elsewhere. Like the other influx of bad reviews, I agree the developers have gotten greedy. It used to be $4.99/month for a gold pass, with a lot of extra rewards for the money. Now it's $4.99/week, for much fewer rewards. This was the only game I spent money on, but not anymore.

I loved this game the way it was prior to the multiple day challenges. I reached stage 35 and all I got was a turtle for a profile picture. Can only get stuff for the next 2 weeks if I pay for the gold pass. Can you please go back to the way it was like collect blue pieces and get a bomb type thing. I won't be playing for the next few weeks because now there is no point. Thanks for ruining what was my favorite game

Started playing this game as a way to earn credits for another game. The game is a pay-to-play game. One of the worst I've seen. You will quickly stall out your progress if you are not constantly buying the items needed to move through the levels. The aquariums you build seem useless. The matching puzzles eventually seem rigged for you to lose at higher levels, and the story/quest part of the game, slows to a crawl unless you open your wallet and pay-to-play.

I downloaded this app because I saw an ad that showed the player leading a fish through a neat looking obstacle course. Turns out that's not what this is. Not even close. It's a redundant matching game that has very quickly reached the point where it would appear I can no longer advance without buying something. Deleting the app after only three days. I'm bummed. What a let down.

The game only alternates between Hard and Super Hard and if you are unlucky, the next level will be the same as the hard one but it wont indicate if it will be hard or moderate. So in short this game gives you stress after stress, you can never relax with this. But the challenge levels are fun coz they usually have more than 25 moves to buy you some time. In conclusions, download it if you are not short tempered like me coz if you are then you will break your phone.

Downloaded this thinking I would get to play games that would "save the fish" from different dangers. Instead, I got an aquarium and a bunch of different kinds of games that are really difficult to play without purchasing "diamonds" or other packages of "helps". I will go back to Panda Pop. I feel like this isn't what it was advertised to be.

A nightmare to make purchases through. I have tried to buy numerous deals and offers, but every time I go to make the purchase, the game pulls up the wrong Google play account, no matter how many times I disconnect and connect to the correct one. I've tried numerous ways to fix this and all failed. I've tried contacting them to figure out what's going on so I can actually buy but it's been crickets. Never thought I'd have to chase down a company to take my money. Guess I'll keep it.

They lure you in with easy levels and lots of bonuses, then they increase the level of difficulty so much that you have to buy power ups just to clear a level. Players used to get a 30 day gold pass with extra lives and bonus power ups, for $4.99 but they recently cut it down to weekly, at the same price. They don't care about user experience, they only care about making money. Unless you're prepared to pay to play, don't waste your time downloading.

Stop advertising false games!!! This is NOT the puzzle game advertised! I don't understand how you can get away with such misleading ads that do not at all represent the actual ad. I wish there was a way this could be reported and removed! The funny thing is, I actually want to play the advertised puzzle game. Why can't you focus your energy on creating the actual game you're advertising, instead of so much deception!?

False advertising. It advertises as a "save the fish" game in which you have to move and open gates to let the lava flow without killing the fish. In actuality it is a connect 3 game with various fish aquariums that you can buy items and fish used to spice up the aquarium.
