While the theme is cute, the music fun, and the art decent, the game itself isn't anything new or even all that well done. This game is purposefully built to attract game addicts into spending all their time and money.

Sometimes it's kind of fun... but its rigged to get you to spend money. So it's way more frustrating than it is entertaining. It's also very deceiving because it's not at all like the ads. It's a match 3 game, not the fish eating other fish like they portray it. There are a few little mini games that are like that, but they're short & dumb & there's only a few in between boards for a short period of time. None of the side quests are very rewarding. It's just irritating bc they're so greedy.

I clicked on an ad that was actually fun, where you got the fish to swim in a circle to eat a bunch of things and then get bigger. But after installing, it only teases you with a few mini games like that and it's just a standard tile game. Like, the ad had sharks, whales, thalassaphobia vibes. I just wanted to play the satisfying, well-designed game in the ad. Just show that it's mainly a tile game with a cute aquarium setting. That's what my two stars are for.

It was fun in the beginning...but one of the latest updates made the game hard and exhausting to play. They have changed the power ups and rewards system, some of the "easy" levels are hard to pass... In order to un-stuck urself you have to pay money for the progress in the game. I'm quite tired of it to be honest. 27.7.25 It became even worse than my previous review. If I could I would give 0 stars. I'm uninstalling the game. Fair well and thank you for the fish 🐟

I like the graphics of this game but there is too much going on. Sometimes less is more. I also didn't like it when I was forced to choose a specialty fish and then had to pay game money to store the fish. I was attracted to the game to build and decorate my own aquarium. I almost uninstalled the game, and am waiting to see if more shenanigans happen. Otherwise, it is enjoyable and very visually pleasing.

After playing the "Playable Ad" a few times, I decided to download it. I was disappointed to discover that it was nothing like the advertisements but was little more than another Candy Crush type game. If the ad had more accurately depicted the game, I could have made a more informed choice. On the other hand, why couldn't the game have been more like the ads? It would have been a far better, more engaging and original game if it had. If you can't manage that then at least advertise HONESTLY.

The last update made it so I can't feed my fish. I can't do anything it's almost as if it's frozen except the fish interact still. I loved playing this game until all this happened. And it's been about 2 or 3 months now since I was basically locked out of everything except the one tank. So I guess I'm going to uninstall the game now since there is no point in keeping a game on my device when I can't even play it. Soo disappointed!!!!!

The game used to be very good. Even I have spent some money on it. However, now it gets bored. Always same missions, for many months we don't have the special levels. Also they did dramatic changes harming the players. The dynamite and lightning are not together, we used to got 2 bombs and we used that help and now just 1 is provided, no time with unlimited lives (except you pay), no more 3+ moves after you pass e levels in a row and the increased the prices. so bad. I was a 15K level player

I like this game. It's basically watching Nemo from the Disney movie go through pipes and waterways as you unlock games and slide barriers around to help him move along. It's fun, it's easy, it's NOT REALLY the game. That was the game I wanted to play. Not this Candy Crush create an aquarium game? Where's the game from the ad? That's the one I want. This whole switcheroo has me so disappointed. While the actual game is more fun and appealing than most of the Candy Crush derivatives, the objective to create an aquarium with animated fish is boring as hell. Dudes, way to make a game boring. Get back to me when you create the exciting and more challenging game from the ads!!!

Like everyone else says.. It's completely different from the ad. What a stupid company... They made the game in the ad look clever and interesting, and then the real game just rips off typical gem matching games. They spent the time to brainstorm and come up with a good idea, and then use it to scam people instead of just make the game. Very weird. I understand they will be adding mini games soon which are closer to the advertisements. That's a good first step, but put out an apology

These levels are impossible to win. Your system is designed to force ppl to buy lives and gems to pass the levels. So redicule. I will leave a one star review and uninstall this app. There are plenty of other games to play. Very disappointed, the levels are getting impossible to beat. Not enjoying the game anymore! It's supposed to be fun to play. Fix the issue or you'll loose players!

Money Pit. I really enjoyed playing the game but, as the levels become more difficult, it quickly requires you to use any buffs you have and eats up your lives. Even though I began the game with the intent to spend little if any money, it was requiring (or enticing) me to spend $3 a day, regularly. I uninstalled it, and started to play Candy Crush Saga, which thus far (level 18, game 218) is much better. It is a similar game format (minus the decor creativity), but much less money.

Do not download this game! It is fun and addictive, but even if you buy the season pass, you will still need to spend and spend to get the final reward, so really, there is NO POINT in buying the season pass. They have currently raised the price of the season pass, and at the same time, they have REDUCED the REWARDS. They have limited the power ups and now there are no periods of 15 minute or 30 minute unlimited lives. Stay away from Fishdom, unless you like wasting money on flashy, rigged games

I've been playing Fishdom on another device and used to enjoy the game. Not anymore. Over the last few months it has become all about getting the player to spend more in in-app purchases. I was happy enough to part with a few $ while the game was fun but they are taking moves away plus some other changes... they've wrecked the game. They clearly don't value their customer base. Do not recommend.

Been playing for awhile. Had to start over, Because of getting a new phone. I Didn't save my progress. Know I'm all caught up and almost finished with the game!! Great game for when I'm relaxed after work. Well know that I'm at Level 500 are so the game want's me to update. The problem is it's slow and I can't update at all. How can y'all fix this problem. # Stuck in limbo!!

Having fun so far! Really love this game. The graphics are beautiful. I would like a list of purchases I've made though. Also I really really dislike timed games. I play it to relax! Give k diamonds from piggy bank once and a while. The tanks are fun to rearrange. The fun fish are really expensive too. Takes a long time to collect the vouchers. All and all fantastic little game. I even enjoy the music which I turn down on most games. I haven't spent a cent. Watch videos for diamonds and slowly collect boosters. I just lowered my rating in an edit. You asked for a review right when I got a stupid timed level. CUT IT OUT!!! Not fun not relaxing. No extra anything! What's your point? Use up my lives fast?

Not what was advertised. I was interested in the game because it depicted a scenario type puzzle where you had to select keys that would either allow the fish to pass through safely, or you failed. This game is not that at all. You basically collect fish and complete candy crush type puzzles to earn money so you can decorate the tank and buy more fish. I do not appreciate being mislead and having my time being wasted like that. I uninstalled immediately when I figured it out.

BE AWARE!! I played this game for a couple of days but then I made 1 small purchase. This is my experience. They will charge you multiple times for 1 purchase. The app will tell you that purchase was unsuccessful and you don't get any items you try to pirchase on the game but they still charge you and make it extremely difficult for you to get your money back. The game is designed to get you to make a purchase. HORRIBLE PEROPLE WHO MADE THIS GAME. THEIVES!!!!

I've been playing fishdom for some time, expecting to reach the mini game where you eat fish and get bigger. after all that's what's advertised. but this is false advertising because there appears to be no such feature in game. the violation of Google terms. I will be reporting this. also I bought the fishy Bank thinking it would be available for future diamonds, but I find that I have to buy it every single time! this is wrong and I want my money back. I'm tired of dark patterns. we all are!

Dear Playrix, Every time I see an ad for your games, I see an exciting logic puzzle. But when I consider downloading, I find it's only a cheap match 3 game. A brief look at the reviews for this game will show that I'm not the only one who's noticed. This is clear-cut false advertising, and it's a little pathetic that your creative team only seems to be able to produce one kind of game. Brutal honesty isn't fun to hear, but it's necessary. Perhaps your ad team could learn something from this?

The puzzles in the ads for this game are few and far between. Most of the this game is just bejeweled with aquariums and tons of monetization. Apparently, false ads like the ones for this game attract people who spend more money, like me. After spending and embarrassing amount of money over the past month, I finally uninstalled the game. Now, I'm being hounded by ads for it.

It's cute and I really liked it until this "limited time" stuff. I worked really hard to unlock the camping fish and can't buy them because the event ended and I'm just a few coins short. People have lives. Games shouldn't make you worship them to be able to unlock cool stuff. The ads are also extremely misleading. Nothing like the actual game. Playrix does this with all of their games. STOP ADVERTISING GAMES THAT DON'T EXIST. Not going to play any of their games until they fix these issues!

Have played for years. Rewards decreased, and you can expect to be stuck on games/levels for days unless you are willing to spend money. The developers always say every level can be won - no, every level can be won if you spend money. Also, stop advertising the mini games - i have not seen one for over a year. As others have said, i used to pay $2.99 to activate the season passes, but $9.99 is ridiculous. Fishdom used to be a 5 star game, but with all the changes, even 2 stars is too many. 😒

I used to love this game, then they made the team chest unattainable by people who just play in their spare time. I used to beat 75 to 100 levels a week, now it's rare for me to reach 15, which means I can't get enough tokens for special tanks, I can't win fish, and the bath-whatever challenges can't be completed without paying money. To the creators: a game is more fun when you win and can beat levels than when you are frequently stuck for days. People no longer want to join teams.

I wanna eat fish, not play match-3. The fact you cannot choose minigames and you are forced to play random, boring, easy ones is no fun. Also, the advertisement is misleading, you eat like 3 fish, not that many. I don't understand why there's no laws to prevent fake advertising, as this seems to be a trend. Anyway, don't expect much, and certainly not what was advertised. I spent more time writing this review than I played the game, that should tell you!

Unless you plan on paying money, it's not worth downloading. Most rounds only have 15 moves, and if you haven't bought powerups, you aren't going to win the round. 25 mins to recharge a life. Also, not as advertised. I bought for the math mini game that is advertised in every add. It's really just a boring candy crush knock off. Don't waste your time.

When I installed the game it was different than it was shown on the app detail pictures... It shows a fish in a pipe etc. I got to level 406 and that never happened, you match 3-6 in a row and unlock aquariums and decorate them to urn beauty stars. But if you got the game like me and thought you would be solving puzzly things that's not at all what this app is about. You can join a team and interact with team. On the upper hand it is very social in an anti- social way. If that's your jam get it!

Update: after reading other reviews it seems others were mislead by the ads too. Is that to get more downloads?? I'll be uninstalling. Confused as game is different to ads. The ads show saving the fish using strategic moves that hold back lava or sharks etc, and getting the fish out safely. I've played to level 29 so far of fishdom and that hasn't been in one level. Does it come later?

I gave it two stars because I do like the playing the game. There are a frustratingly annoying things that need to be changed. 1. Gems are stupid hard to get and everything is expensive. 49 Gems for 3 rockets but it takes 30 hours of play time to collect 9 gems. 2. If I have to put in the work to fill the piggy bank I shouldn't have to pay for those gems. I earned them. 3. Chill on the amount of pop ups in a row. Up to 6 or 7 is ridiculous! 4. Needing to beat levels to unlock holiday items now has to go. I'm on level 1080. Beating 126 levels in less than 14 days to unlock the holiday fish at this point is unattainable. Just beginning the game 126 would be no problem. If these areas were to improve, I would change my review.

Don't be fooled by the ads that make you download this game. You think you're going to help the fish escape certain situations, when really that's just the mini-game. A mini-game that you only play every once in awhile. It's really another match game. I haven't played the mini-game since level 15, I deleted the game at level 130 something. Over 115 levels without playing the part of the game that I downloaded the app for? No thank you!

Updates are supposed to make the game more fun, but they’re making it really boring. The bomb along with the triangle has disappeared, and I think that’s a big downside. The 15–30 minute rewards are gone too. And we don’t want any more mini-games with map exploration either.The "Double Bomb" booster has been reduced from two bombs to just one bomb. WHY?? It’s really annoying.😒

Misleading advertising. The Fishdom ad I saw looks like a "Piranha" type game where the fish eat small fishes to grow big enough to eat bigger fishes, but that was just the mini-game.. They pushed the mini game in their ads like it's the primary game structure; the main game is actually a match-3 "Candy Crush" type of game. I played several levels and it's all the same structure. This is not the game I expected from their ad, and it's such a shame because the graphics look amazing.

Was fun for the 3 or 4 days I was able to play before it started crashing. I don't have time for that nonsense. Update: So a year later after the first negative experience, they seem to have fixed the crashing, but now it's a money drain . . . Or trying to be. I simply will NOT pay to play a "free" game. No matter how impossible you make levels to pass. And there's no rhyme or reason. They're just rolling along and suddenly impossible and you can sit there for DAYS unless you buy the helps.

I felt mislead by the gameplay which does not have much in common with the ad that got me to download this game. The ad showed the player solving puzzles involving directing water in pipes to the fish, whereas in the main game, at least as far as I got, the player is not completing puzzles, but just matching circles and shapes. The picture on the ap of the "minigame" showing a shark and fish implies a game much more reminiscent of that in the ad, but I did not run into anything like that.

Like the combination of a match three game and the aquariums. Get coins as you work through levels. When you run out of lives, you can add decorations and be entertained by fish interactions. Each life replenishes in just half an hour. Other ways to earn boosters and unlimited lives. Some levels, when you swipe, the elements don't move the way you intended, on occasion. Beware this is an in-app purchase game. It favors those who make purchases.

It started out as a fun game, not happy that you complete games, and when you fill the whale with diamonds, you have to pay to have them, or after you have achieved your awards to be able to continue, when you failed a level, they will steal them from you. On top of that, I downloaded the game because it initially seemed to be a different game; where a small fish gradually grows eating bigger fish, but in the end, here you are clearing out tiles after tiles.

The usual money-making scheme. Lots to do in the game, but a lot of it is inaccessible unless you pay real cash. Can't even collect the diamonds you win by playing without purchasing a moneybox with real cash - that's really what broke the enjoyment for me. For those who specifically prefer to spend money on a game, this will be ideal. For the rest, the fun is stunted and it can end up being frustrating.

This is great. But I am greatly disappointed that you have to pay $2.99 to get your jewels out. I paid it once thinking it was a one time to keep it open, but no, you have to pay each time it gets full. This is really sad that the makers of the game do to this to players. I would rather pay for the game outright and not have a bank. I have removed 1 star from my last review! 12/12/19 : not one respones back on review about the bank. 1 more star down.

Game was advertised as a pull the pin puzzle game. It's a tile matching game, combined with a decorate your space game, and it's not a good version of either game. The pull the pin stuff is mini "games." There's pretty much only one way to pull the pins anyway. You literally can't go in the wrong order, so you can't lose the minigame. That's not a game... Anyway, ads were dishonest, game sucks, I'll be avoiding this company and all their apps from now on.

I thought I was going to have the little fish eat fish until he got big enough to take on the end boss. Instead, this is about building different aquariums, buying decorations and more fish. Not one of the games had anything to do with the little fish in the game trailer. Plus the matching puzzles goals are ridiculous. They'll give you 17 chances to clear the board of 64 tiles. It's another way to take your money. Stay away from this game, it will just take your money and give you frustration.

I have been playing this game since 2/2020 & have seen the levels become even more difficult & the fees to play rising. You will be stuck for days on the same level unless you make purchases. The new increase to $9.99 for the season pass is RIDICULOUS!!! If you bought every season pass for a year it would be ~$175!!!! That is INSANE! I am part of a team & we are all fed up with the greedy changes that have been made. I have had enough & will not spend another dime on this game.

Another game that requires you to pay to play. If you do pay, it then expects you to keep paying to move forward in the levels. I have have paid my fair share. And I'm done. No gratitude for paying players. If you stop spending money, you will be stuck for days and days. I've seen the pattern of how it sets up the level for you to win or fail. So, yes the levels may be beatable to win without paying, but you will have to play for several days Another game that will scam you for money.

I only played for a few minutes because of the obnoxious hints given in the game. I want a game that I can sit back, relax, and figure out how to beat the levels on my own. Stop giving hints when the players hesitates for a measly 1.5 seconds. Give us a way to turn off the hints completely. I have deleted other games for this exact reason. Until the option of "turn off hints" is given to the players, I will not play.

The ad that is shown is for a mini game inside the actual game. The actual game is a character game with little minigames to win coins. It's perfectly fine if you like games that are storytelling and character building, and you fiddle around with a character. I do not. The ad needs to be change because it's false advertising. Marketing team is hot trash or this company is sketck as hell to run that ad. Downloaded and deleted in under 5 mins.

If I could, I would've given negative stars! I've been playing thus game for over 4 years. It's always been great fun. They offer gold passes that earns you lots of boosters, diamonds, time ect. It's usually about a 1 month pass for 4.99. Like everyone else, they've gotten greedy. Now the gold passes dont give near what they did. Also it's only about 6 days now for 4.99. Several people have already left. Our whole team is looking for a better game to join.

Fun, when it doesn't lock up, but expensive. Past level 1000 you'll need to spend money to make the game playable, and it gets expensive very quickly. And it locks up, losing your power-ups, with no way to reset it or replay the level without being heavily penalized. I'm uninstalling it for these reasons. When they get better programmers, I might consider playing it again.

This game makes the levels extremely difficult to force you to buy gems and lightning. Customer support is horrible. I had an issue with purchases and received error messages. My account was charged, yet I did not get my items. Customer service was not helpful in getting the matter resolved. I provided ample proof and did not receive the email receipt of the purchases. I have deleted the app. Do not recommend this game. Don't waste time and money!

Free to try but Pay to Progress. Game does not play as advertised. This is mostly a bejeweled type of game with very few different puzzles here and there. Games are soon made unreasonably hard to virtually impossible to win unless one spends real money on a lot of boosters to use at once. There are better and less predatory games out there. I suggest skipping this one. PS: don't waste my time with a toxic dev response of "try a better strategy". You know what you did.

The advertising made it look like a fun little puzzle game and I downloaded it because I wanted to see how you made the fish escape the shark. Instead the game is a tile game like Candy Crush, only not as good. Maybe they have that game at higher levels but I haven't seen it yet. I was going to download some other Playrix games but from reading the reviews, they pull this deceptive advertising all the time. I don't want to encourage that so I'm thinking of uninstalling. If the developers ever do make that puzzle game, I'll try it but I consider their ads to be bait and switch.

Use to love this game! There is a golden ticket purchase with extras that use to last 32 days, then only 27 days, and now its every 6 days before you spend $$$. The number of days changed, the way you earn extras changed but the price stayed the same. Its nothing but a money grab and very disappointing. My team is the only reason I dont uninstall the game but I'm not sure how much longer that will keep me. They are all just as upset. I changed my rating from 5 to 1

Ignore the 5 star and the 4 star reviews. Yes, it is kinda fun, but its nothing like the ads I see when playing another game. The ads I see is that the fish eats a small fish and then there is a big fish you have to try and eat. Pretty fun, right? But, the real game is just like those other games, like Candy Saga, just with fish and a little different things. Like I said before, nothing like the ads I see.

Hi! :) I just wanted to say that this game is amazing,no commercials, nothing, but what really bothers me is that you are pushing people to stop playing it. To be more precise,me. I managed to reach 8193 level without any passes, nothing, because the game was fair when it comes to rewards, then fishdom challenge that gives you 3 diamonds.... And now,you updated it,and literally every single lighting you gave is next to the colour that won't help you win!

I really liked this game, but now you are charging more and the new garden outing side game? Wait for an hour to use a cherry to do more matches and you get 1 item from it? Or any of the things to get items, you get a few, then it's another hour? It's not going to make me spend more money, morons, it's just going to make me play less. If you're counting on getting rich by a game, then I'll find a different one. JFC

I give up. A fun game but the amount of money I have to drop into the game to advance, not fun anymore. From now on, I will play for free and when I get bogged down, will delete and start over on my game tablet. This is supposed to be fun and it's not anymore. Deleted on my phone. Edited to add...after reading reviews, two stars might be too generous. No matter, no more money from me. Edited to add again...Yeah, the levels may be beatable but only after youve gone broke paying for help.

Really aggressive "pay us! BUY!!!" advertising everywhere... With the last updates they're changing a really great game (I was playing it daily for years, but I'm losing interest) to a copy of "homescapes" or one of the other games of this company which they show you advertising for all the time. I didn't install those games because I want to play Fishdom and not those. And now they're putting those games IN Fishdom. I don't know why they want to kill this game, but the method definitely works.

This game is misleading. The commercials show something completely different. The reason I DL it. It's another candy crush game. However, it's rigged to use all 5 of your hearts to pass one board, if you do pass. It's not worth the money, frustration and time spent on this game. Also, if you get unlimited hearts, you must use them at that time, which cannot be saved. This makes it difficult to play during your break from work or school. Positive note, the fish are very cute!

This game is mostly the matching jewels type. Some of the pulling pins to make stuff drop, but too easy. Rarely a dumb mini version of the advertised game. You also have to spend a lot of time building your aquarium. I kept playing hoping it would eventually let me play the game I thought I was downloading. I gave up when it was forcing me to buy a stupid ugly "unique" fish which are designed to look like non fish things such as cows.

Fun game and all. But. You enjoy the game, invest time in it. After a certain period, you are 'forced' to do micro-transactions, as you'll have a tough time advancing without them. "It would be a shame throwing away all your progress by quitting the game." Well, it is, and the developers know. But I have to pay in order to advance? I either quit, waste time of pay? They know that also. That mindset disgusts me. Therefore, 1*. Do not recommend.

Can't get past the turtle telling me to "check out my new fish" because no matter how many times I tsp the shop button, it won't open. Uninstall for that alone. It would also really be nice if games stopped the bait and switch ads to lure people on. My 6yo son wanted to play on his own tablet based on the ad that shows you have to eat other fish that progressively get bigger, and was completely disappointed when he found out it's another match-3 game.

I've been playing for a couple of years now. Why did the newest update take away the dynamite/lightning combo? Also, when on a winning streak now, instead of getting a lightning power up, you get two mini dynamite instead? Also, you changed it from getting 2 bombs to only 1 bomb? I like the game as it's challenging, but these are terrible upgrade decisions. It made the game way more challenging, even on easy levels. Hopefully, they change this back to somewhat normal.

I've been playing Fishdom every day for over 2 years now and have enjoyed this challenging game. However, the newest changes (reducing power ups, getting rid of the 3 extra moves, making the games much harder, and charging) have ruined this game for me. I no longer enjoy it and am actively looking for another game to play. Fishdom is losing a great customer.

This game is not visually impaired friendly. None of the text works with select to speak. The conversations that the fish pop up and go away too fast to be easily read with magnification. Also, I don't like being told that I can claim a reward, only to be asked to buy it. Was advertised as something that it's mostly not. I only wanted to play the game that is actually a mini game that it will only occasionally allow you to play. This is mainly a candy crush like game mixed in with some others.

False advertising!! Beware game play is NOT as advertised. I downloaded the game because it appeared as though you had to get the fish through different obstacles in like a stormwater drain. Looked like it might have been fun. NO mention in the ad that it was a match 3 game. Very deceptive indeed. EDIT 17th Dec. Thought I'd play for a while to see if you get to "help" the fish escape. Guess what level 407 an nothing. I'm going to legal counsel as they shouldn't be able to do this.

I have been playing Fishdom every day for over 18 months. Its my go to game. I love the interactive fish in the variety of themed fish worlds Ive created using the rewards from games played. I highly recommend this game. By the way. This review is an edit. I posted a review a while ago because I waz extremely unhappy that after making a purchase of game tokens, the option of gaining tokens by watching videos stopped. This has now been rectified and I am back to being a very satisfied player.

The game is nothing like the ads. Don't hit me with "As of now, there is no such feature within the game..." Because there'll probably never be the same gameplay that is shown in the ads. Y'all just needed a way to make your game stand out compared to the 100s of others that are the same. I'm just here to let people know how ridiculous you are for having an ad for a baked potato when you're really just selling fries: both are fine, but they're different and 1 you can get just about anywhere.

Yet another game that the only way to get very far on it is to keep spending real money to buy perks. There is supposedly 1500 levels to this game, so, at roughly $3 per $100 levels, that works out to around $50 to finish the game. I have been at level 67 for 3 days, and there is no way to advance until I buy "perks", like bombs, to clear levels with.

It's an OK game but it's not what is advertised. I wanted to play the game in the ads, where you eat a bunch of 5 point fish until you're high enough level to eat 100 point fish, then 250, etc etc. That literally isn't a thing in this game. It's a fish tank that you decorate, and you earn money to decorate by playing a matching game (like candy crush or royal match). It's fine, and maybe even fun, and if they portrayed THAT GAME in the ads I'd probably give it 5 stars.

This is NOT the game that was demoed! This is a timed match game not the puzzle game demoed. This game is geared to get your money. NOT HAPPY! Controls on my tablet were glitchy & delayed moves which used time. I spent more than 30 minutes on the FIRST match game in the first level & every loss I was "offered opportunity" to buy power ups so I could win the level. It's been on my tablet 30 minutes & that's 30 minutes too long! Great graphics are about the only good I can say about it.

Game is just as others described. And I honestly wouldn't mind spending money on it cuz it can be a fun game, as I like to support developers... but the levels are getting impossible without spending money. Been stuck on the same level for 2 days. If you are going to do that... at least give more options for gaining in game currency - like watching ads. I have no power ups and no way to beat this level without them. Also means I miss out on keeping snowy place cuz I cant earn gems for last task!

This game is a scam. I have played games before where I felt the need to purchase additional support. It was my choice and if I didn't purchase the support I could still win the game. This fishdom requires you to purchase money to move on. If not, you will literally play the same game for 3 hours with no movement. What's worse is that when you do purchase the items they make the game harder so you could spend all of the items so you could purchase more. Don't recommend this game at all!

The game in the Fishdom ads that are heavily promoted in other games looks super fun. I would love to give that game 5 stars. Unfortunately when you download it, it looks and functions nothing like what's depicted in the ad. Tricked into downloading this through misrepresentation. My big question is this: why not actually make the "game" you're showing in the ads? Looks like fun. And then people who play it would actually get what they are EXPECTING when they download it.

I agree with a lot of the comments here that they give you little moves for some of the levels, even the normal diffculty levels. I am really unhappy with the fact that just recently, last couple of days, they no longer have the timer to gain/collect more energy points for the adventure game. Now you have to spend money to get more energy or play games which in the long run they try to make it so you spend money on that too. It is an addictive game, but I am finding it not worth playing anymore.

I do love this game, but: You will stay stuck in places forever unless you spend money. Feels like a shake down. Certain updates change how you can play the game. Now I can't return to a game in progress without it resetting, losing power ups applied and paid for. Are the developers broke? They have to shake you down so obviously? I play this nearly exclusively, but I'll find another game to invest my time. I don't need to be robbed more than usual.

It's a nice game overall (even a little addictive, I would say...) with cute graphics that are improved with every new update. The biggest flaw I can find is that there are lots of things that have to be "purchased" with the bronze vouchers, but you can't exchange your accumulated silver and gold vouchers for bronze ones so as to buy more things, more quickly.

I ignored the ad for this game for weeks before finally thinking, "You know what, it looks like an interesting type of puzzle gameplay" and decided to give it a try. It's nothing like the game being played in the ad. Tired of these lame companies producing cheap, lame, generic puzzle games and advertising something completely different to get downloads. I'm uninstalling this boring game but not before warning others not to even waste your data on the download.

It's a fun game that is ruined by greed. There's more ways to spend money than ways to play. Many levels are designed to be tight (even with items) so you'll frequently be stuck retrying the same level a few times. In a normal game it'd be fine, but this one specifically limits lives and locks you to retrying the same level until you beat it or give up after 3 days and spend money. Infinite lives tend to be given out at unfortunate times, and you'll usually end up wasting them.

Poor customer service. Item somehow bought I game with diamonds. I asked for diamonds back and to take the item that I did not want or purchase back. They said they are unable to do so. Which is ridiculous. I spent a lot of money on diamonds just for them to be lost like that so easily. No more money spent on this game as they don't help customers with fair transactions. I clearly didn't purchase the item as there are like 6 already in the matching game that i have no use for. Oh well.

If the developers think that it's ok for them to advertise fake content then I think it's ok for me to delete this game 5 mins after I download it. Don't waste your time on this game. It's nothing line the ads. This is a match 3 game. The advertisements are inaccurate and there are no puzzles. I came here to look for a challenge but there's no challenges. If I could rate this game any less than 1 star I would. Thanks for nothing.

Saw the ad for this, thought "this could be fun." But the ad is the mini-game which a toddler could do and you only see that mini-game once. The rest is just a money grab. I understand wanting to profit off your game, but ffs, this game is riddled with buy this to continue...buy this to get a power up...and I don't support games like that.

The game is ok-ish but first of all, it's nothing even close to advertising. I expected one kind of game and got absolutely different. It's like you wanted to buy apples and got cereal. Nothing really wrong with cereal but not what you wanted. And second problem: it's forcing you to "buy" something when you just want to play only. Seems like it's all about buying and advertising. Disappointed.

I feel let down. First and foremost this is not the same fish eating game I was enticed with in the ads. It is just a candy-crush like game of puzzle, of which after a few levels you can't complete, unless ofcourse you buy the ridiculously expensive diamonds. I didn't expect you to be this thirsty for money. I expected better. Really feel disappointed.

I have a love-hate relationship game. They shorten the gold pass time and raise the rate. Now in the GardeN Outing. Level 27 says clay for 4 days now. I've won several levels since then... nothing. Nothing earned towards level 28. Impossible to reach out to support. Running in circles. Why don't they have a simple way to reach out to supportable and obvious glitch.

I'm not sure how this is a puzzle game. Played for 30 minutes. It's a bejeweled rip off. Perhaps there are other unlocks. I don't have the patients to play a game to unlock it. Advertise what's in the box when you open it. Bejeweled with a fish tank you have to maintain, feed the fish, and earn coins to keep him happy. I'm not interested in pet maintenance of a virtual pet.

I wish I could give this no stars. Having a glitch that removes your purchased items (and rewards)& an automated support desk that is severely lacking in effectiveness is a problem. I honestly feel like I've been stolen from. If you play the game and don't spend money, you'll be fine (you just won't get very far). But if you decide to spend money in their apps, be warned they could disappear and you likely will not get your items/purchases/money back.

I used to really love this game but with the new update reducing moves so it's impossible to win without using diamonds for additional moves?! That's just plain wrong. Levels that were hard at 25 moves now have only 13?!! It's a money grab. From a real fun, challenging game to impossible without spending money for more diamonds. Will probably uninstall if they don't fix it.

Update. The new weekly events where you just have to beat levels are boring and expensive. It's not worth buying a gold ticket for it. The older events where you have challenges were much better and you win even if you really struggle with a level. The game keeps crashing and I lose my power ups. Not worth playing while this happens. Update. I received a quick response from support. Hopefully the game stops crashing.

After playing for years, I finally got fed up with the game. They just made lots of changes to the game last week that made the game so difficult and no longer fun to play!! They made it such a way that you have to buy/use boosters and diamonds in order to win a level. The price of the season ticket (only lasts 20 days) went up 30%!! They reduced the effectiveness of the boosters you can collect! They really don't care about the players and just want to make money!!

Just not any fun anymore. I play these games to relax and have fun. When I reached level 2100 and had to buy more and more gems because the only way to progress was to buy cheats and extra moves it stopped being fun. Another thing was that back in Dec 2023 they hiked up the cost of those gems and my level of irritation has only grown since then. After playing some of the other games put out by this company it is the same story with those too. I'm done. Game deleted, along with the others.

Been playing for a year. Fishdom has really gone down hill in that time. The rewards for chests are horrible for the 800 levels required to get them. I'm our team leader and we worked hard only to get a lousy hammer. The gold passes you buy have reduced the rewards by over half. The mini games which awarded players no longer appear. The games become so increasingly difficult that many are stuck on levels for DAYS. We've had players leave due to this and more. I would not recommend this game.

Money grabber. y You need to pay to play,unless you have years & patience to play the game. It's fun in the beginning. They changed the game to include treasure chests which takes away from earning coins so it's harder to make game progress as if you win the treasure chest games (which is a lot), you don't earn any coins, so purchasing game items for your tank becomes almost impossible which initially was the purpose of the entire game. It ends up not being the game you started playing. Sucks!

This game what should be play fairly and free, is not a free, addictive and force you to spend tons of real money, with purchase lasted often for additional couple minutes of play, it's worse than roulette game in casino, at least there you spent money to win money time for time. Here you spent $1.99 and this lasted only for half minute of game progress, give you 5 extra clicks only, and often it's not enough for finishing a game. This European developers doesn't care about your hardearned money. Worse than real casino, with same type of addiction!!! Not Healthy!!! I'm going to delete this game at once, even I liked their design, graphics, video format and colors, images. But I really doesn't anymore spent money for game where progress are depending for how much you are willing to spent. Yes, you can play it for free, but in this case, you checking in daily, without playing, collect your daily boosters, one per day, and after 30 days in the row, you get full line of 30 boosters, what's let you play just 10 levels up, then again 30 days for checking in and play couple minutes to one hour for another 10 levels up. This is not as real free game should works. Either developers are don't care about people's money and their solid satisfaction how money was well spent or not, or this Devs are super greedy!!! Why then I should be being a patron for them and spent $2 bucks for playing 5 extra clicks!???? Delete and don't recommend this game as a "free game" online!!!

I have played several of this companies games, and while the potential for fun is there, the greed that this company has... making it impossible to pass levels unless you spend real money for powerups, seems downright criminal. I've reached a point where all of my 'diamonds' are being banked and they want $3 to release them. I can't get past the level I'm on because the goal is to remove 154 blocks in 1min 30 seconds, AND I have to wait 2 1/2 hours to get lives back ( or buy them)! DELETED!!!

This games WAS fantastic, and the developers killed it, you HAVE to spend money to even pass a lot of boards, or get stuck on the same level for days! They've reduced all the power ups, eliminated extra moves and made even the easy levels impossible. I have no problem spending money here and there, but they have taken any thought out of how you make your moves to win the board, which was the challenging fun part! Now it is just if the right power ups fall in the board. Stupid and boring.

Deceitful and expensive Even if the graphics are nice, it is just another version of candy crush, exactly the same, nothing original. They advertise the mini puzzles but you don't get to play any of those at all. I completed almost 50 levels and did not see a puzzle. I contacted them and they responded I hadn't been lucky and to keep playing. The diamonds you get from your own victories, go to a piggy bank that you have to buy later with your real money if you want to use them. GREEDY.

Initially quite fun but very quickly became impossible to continue without spending $3.99 for a tool to pass a level. Couldn't go any further otherwise and no way to win enough points/coins/upgrades to proceed. Deleted it and moved on to more fun, less profitable for the company, games. Please note that the game keeps trying to get your Facebook login and contacts and your Google login. On the day immediately following deleting it, I was presented with an ad saying the fish "missed me" Creepy!

I saw this game advertised on another game I play. Once I downloaded and began to play it, it wasn't the same game advertised. This game is your typical match three or four items in a row puzzle, which is okay, but I tried several games like this already. The way this game is advertise is you start off as a little fish eating other little fishes, getting powerups to advance to other stages or your fish gets eaten. However, that's not what I gotten, which is pretty misleading.

Honestly? Really disappointed. Downloaded the game based on an ad i saw and the game was nothing like the ad showed. The part showed in the ad was a mini game that i only got to see every ten levels or so if not less. It was still a fun game but nothing what i expected and certainly not something I'll play more than a day or so. And i downloaded it from the link from the ad so i know i didn't get the game wrong. It's just not what was advertised.

Kinda fun at first, but start getting into the 500's and good luck. I'm in the 600's and am literally stuck. So far, 40+ lives attempted and still have not passed it. Some levels are even worse, and they aren't even labeled hard or very hard. A great game if you have a ton of gems and power ups, or if you're not planning on spending money to pass levels, and consequently don't mind being in the lowest tiers for tournaments, then play this. If not, then pass it up.

I really did enjoy playing Fishdom but now its become more frustrating to me than enjoyable; due to being forced to search for treasure every single day, week after week! It has wasted my time/money to even play now that I cannot reap the same rewards as lower level players. Im unable to purchase any new items for my current fish tank which is the ONLY way to progress in the game! Therefore I cannot level up and/or progress any further even though there are newer levels above me being advertised!

Game is rigged. no strategy required. As long as you keep feeding it diamonds (money), you will progress. Otherwise, prepare to wait days to finish a single level, until they decide you've waited long enough and give you the moves that allow you to beat the level. They control the moves (power ups) in a level, there is no being good at this game. It is all in control of the developers.

the prices for seasons started at $3.00, the $5.99, then $6.99, nows it's $9.99!! Absolutely greedy of an online game that i spend money on in app purchases and the prices just keep going up. If i uninstall this game I take nothing with me...no rewards or money back, nothing. So pretty much I've spent a lot of money on this game, and all you want is more

This game is for children, I dont mean that as an insult, I got to level 12 or so, the game is just so childish, but I had seen ads for it everywhere, no ads in game is really cool, and if you've got like a 5 year old, I'm sure they'll like it a lot. 2 stars cause I'm tired of seeing ads for it, and I was trying to play that mini game in the first picture they show where you're surrounded by fish, but I didnt see it anywhere and I'm not putting anymore time into doing so lol

I'm about done with this game. The developers have gotten really GREEDY. You can't play this game without spending a lot of money because the levels are so hard to beat you need specialty items each time. It's impossible to get diamonds and specialty items without spending money. The passes are useless bc it takes so many levels just to get one item. If there was some kind of monthly pass that gave you maybe 50 diamonds and a few items daily, I'd be all for that like in hill climb 2.

Don't pay for this game, don't even trust it. I paid money to ensure I never lost a game to keep my reoccuring bomb. Then it vanished and I had none of my items I paid for. After being stuck on a hard level for a few days, the game keeps encouraging me to "spend more". Im done! My items suddenly disappeared and I feel ripped off. Uninstalled.

I really enjoy this game. I like the personalized fish and the tank creating options. I've found a few levels to be difficult enough that I had to step away from the game for a bit, but can ultimately get through them without purchases (so they're not impossible). Really like this game. Its always at the top of my list of games on my phone that I chooae.

Honestly, i'm very disappointed and extremely ticked at you people. The ADVERTISMENT showed hungry fish game, which i liked. But instead, i ended up with match three. I wanted to play the fish eat fish game. To all who wants to download this game because of the ad, don't waste your breath. They just lie to you. To the developers, when you show something like that on the ad, try delivering it. Honestly, i expected better. What a let down.😠😡😠😡👎

Favorite game at 3,563 level. I love this game and all the néw stuff going on! The sea horse and the chores board especilly! Don't like the time games. Hate the stupid time bombs. Some of thosé levels are too hard and the bombs go off to fast! My only complaint is the money I have to spend to beat levels. I spent ovér $800 one month so I had to quit for a while! I wish there was a way to get some free pearls.

Not the game they promised. The game shown was you facing different obstacles to help your fish through a path. This game is just like candy crush. It does have cute fish tanks you build, but it's difficult to send/receive lives and impossible to work as a team, even though they push it on you. This is from the same people with Gardenscapes, which is also not the game they advertised it to be. Just make the games we want. Quit the bait and switch!

I watched several ads for this game and thought it would be challenging and fun. The ads show the game as a logic puzzle, find a way to save the fish. It is not. This is a matching game with snippets of logic puzzles dropped in few and far between. Im not a fan of matching games so im dissapointed at the misleading ads for this game. Why couldnt you just be honest?

This morning at 245am I made 2 purchases that were both charged to me but did not get applied to my game. One for $1.99 and the other for $6.99. Even though they were small amounts, I'm really bummed as I don't often spend REAL money on games. Only about once/mo. And I was really on a roll winning with my freaking fish! Needless to say, I won't be spending my $$ on this swampy fish tank again any time soon. It's never happened before but I followed all the troubleshooting & still nothing

I NEVER download games, but I was so excited to help the cute little fish get out of trouble. Based on the misleading ad, that's what I thought I would be doing. If I wanted to play a matching-crush game, I would've downloaded Candy Crush. I deleted the Fishdom app immediately after I couldn't get past level 2 without making a purchase. This game sucks!

This app goes from 5 stars to 1 every now and then back because of many different issues. But they usually fix it within a reasonable amount of time. Used to be the #1 grossing game. Not sure anymore.. I no longer buy the bs unless it's 95% off. Seriously, why charge SO much for the game pieces to enhance the play?? You're selling FUN. Digital fun. Your cost is near zero, and you have unlimited supply.You'd probably make more $$ if you cut the costs by 95%. Greedy company. But the game is Fun.

I notice they post all the 5 star reviews first, but here's my 1 star review anyway. I liked this game at first, but they constantly push you to buy! Buy decorations, buy more lives, buy tools to help you win. And if you don't, you have to wait 20, 25, 27 minutes for another chance to play? No thanks I'm not that desperate to pay money to play this "free" game. They also like to leave you stuck on a level for days.

The game that was advertised and the game you get are completely different. This is basically bedazzled but with ocean-related symbols instead of jewels, which is NOT what I was expecting. Plus, I earned a whole lot of gems (needed for various things in-game) and they get stored in a "piggy bank"..... which you can only access if you pay real world money for it.

Same as every other game. Mini game to play to get points to buy things to continue game. But the game isn't like the adds and neither is the game within the game. Every 2 or 3 rounds you get a minimisin game and it goes for 2 seconds. It's needs to be more then that. Also they keep changing the main game so you finally buy fish you like and feeding them and they add stupid new characters and don't let you see or play with your fish anymore. I give 2 stars instead of 1 cause it could be worse?

Used to love this game and found it relaxing. Bought the Golden pass each time until it was it started being only for a few days for the same price. The rewards are less, there are no mini games, team tournaments less, it has become a frustration instead of relaxation. The team I am on feels the same way. I won't purchase things AT ALL and I will delete the app if this continues to just be a source of frustration. This should be an enjoyable, relaxing activity, not total aggravation.😡

Its a cute game. Graphics are great. Tho, I hate how often you have to feed the fish. Also dislike the tank styles or themes. You can't just build a tank in what ever theme. I guess its cool for small kids, tho some levels would have them stalled. I uninstalled due to a) having to feed fish more than 1x a day, b) after each completed lvl you go back to the tank screen then have to select to do another lvl an wait for it to load. It'd be nice if at close of game you could choose to play on.

The advertisements are super deceptive. Scratch that, they just straight up lie in the ads. This is just a run of the mill match game, and you have to go as far as reading the description to find that out. From the ads, to the icon, to the images provided. All fabricated. Don't support this app or company, no matter how much you might want to play. These games are a dime a dozen.

Why do these games advertise that they are a 'Pull the pin' Puzzle style game when they are not. In 10 levels, I hit only 1 that was more like a demo than a puzzle. Even though I downloaded this app from a 'bait and switch' ad, excuse the pun, I gave it a try. Very boring. simple and offers up hints too quickly. I couldn't find any way to turn the hints off. I doubt even young kids would find this a challenge. They might like the pretty graphics & the 'Nemo' clown fish you get to start with.

They've made it possibly obvious that you HAVE to purchase in game items to pass the more difficult levels. Their " service" team will come on here and try to defend that they can be won, but no they can't. This game is designed to rope you in just enough that you'll spend money to get further. It's a scam. They know it, and they continue to get away with it. Also loves messing up the direction you're trying to move a piece. Only ever happens on important moves.

i just want to comment on the reviews I read about "Having" to spend money in order to pass levels or keep playing. I have been playing Fishdom for almost 3 years and am on level 5331. Not 1 time did I need to buy boosters in order to pass any 1 level. They are ALL passable without having to spend Any money. Believe me, I have passed every single level with the boosters I have earned or won or without any at All. So give this game a chance. it is a Great Game.

I enjoyed this game--until I got to level 800. After that, it became too difficult because it took over 10 times just to beat one level. If you multiplied that, it would be 8000 times for only 800 levels! I've had enough! It's time for something new! P.S. In response to my review, Playrix wants you to know that if you spend your hard earned money on power ups, it won't take as long as I said it would!

I loved playing this game. That was until they started making you purchase more moves when you still have 15+ moves available to make. It won't let you do anything but forfeit the game unless you make a purchase, but you still have moves that won't cost you any money that you CAN make, as indicated in your available moves indicator. If I could add a picture, I would. I do have many screenshots.

With the new update, it's more difficult to keep going on the levels. You pass a Hard level, next it's normal, and next, it's again Hard level. The exploration game, I'll never finished because in the beginning, cost 5 lights and then, cost over 40. If continue like this, I have to uninstall it. I'm not enjoying this game anymore.

This is NOT what they showed it would be, I don't want a stupid game like all those other ones! They show us having thinking skills and how to get the fish out of bad situations, but that's not what I see at the beginning, and I'm NOT waiting to get that far either! It's just like that candy one, or jewel one, or any of those you move a piece to collapse the others, I wanted opening gates and figuring how to get the fish out of problems, like they show it, so I have uninstalled it...STUPID!!!!

Playrix has recently issued one of the most cynically predatory updates I've ever seen in a game. They basically rewrote the entire gameplay to introduce a large number of new obstacles, which require multiple explosions (not matches, but explosions) right next to the obstacle or objective. On top of that, they put obstacles in front of obstacles in front of obstacles, requiring far more boosters, in exactly the right spot. It's all to force you to spend more money to have a chance to win.

I am a long time player. I understand price increase. but you also cut boosters. I get more of the hard levels than regular. a lot of the regular levels are multi. I miss the seasonal aquariums and the rooms. the Expeditions are just repeat. this latest update third time y'all have cut boosters. it is obvious that all y'all are interested in is making money. as for the mini games I have yet to come across one. I'm a level nine.

Update 4 yrs l8r: still playing & on a good team, however be prepared to pay to play or be on a good team. the latest update now gives you less rewards & costs more. I refuse to spend any more money so time is now limited to continue. Have been playing for months. Enjoy the game but was initially misleading as to what the game actually is. If you aren't prepared to pay as you play you will be forever stuck on levels. Addictive game when playing with an amazing team that is competitive.

So fun, each level a new challenge. And then you get to buy goodies for your aquariums. Yippee! As I am 'editing my review' it is only to add that I have been playing Fishdom for years upon years and my original comment, "So fun, .........", still stands up today. But would only want to add that I don't understand, why the false advert.? You/it does not need it. Fishdom stands up on its' own!

Not as advertised. It's candy crush with an interactive aquarium. The ad was of saving fish in a puzzle like game of pulling the rods out in a specific order. For what it is this is a nice game but it's not the game advertised for download. I agree with the other comments, either change the ad to be accurate or create the game in the original advertisement. This isnt the first ad that ends up being a completely different game so this company is doing it on purpose 🙄.

For starters, if you've found this game via the "logic puzzle levels" ad, don't even bother downloading. While the game is a fun match-3,4,5,6 and so on, it isn't at all what the ad depicted or even lead me to believe. That is false advertising and is a felony. I don't know who came up with your ads playtrix, but I recommend you either adjust them or take them down and start fresh.

This used to be a fun game but the creators or whomever have taken the ability to earn extra helps away and basically the only way to get them is to buy them I have spent money in the past on this game something that I'll never do again. The levels in the higher numbers get too hard and you have to basically have one of each help to get through some of them. It's way too expensive and like I said you guys were taking away the extra helps.

This game is an absolute cash grab. No ads, but ive gotten to level 93 and hit a wall. They dont give you enough moves to switch the pieces around unless you use a power up. The power ups cost gems, the gems cost real money. Basically, you have to pay money to advance in the game and get far. i dont normally leave reviews, but i was honestly enjoying the game until this and felt it necessary to help others avoid what i went through. There are other flaws in the game, but this was #1. Uninstalled

It's just another candy crush game by another name. Also it only runs in wide screen not phone screen, in 1 hand. My biggest complaint overall is how it's advertised as a math strategy game and it turns out that this part of the game is just a little mini game you have to play "candy crush" for hours to earn. After several levels it never comes back. I consider that both bait and switch and false advertising. At the end of the day, just download candy crush, if that's what you want to play.

Is not the same game as advertised. If you saw or played a version of a demo in which you play as a fish with the inevitable goal to take on a whale monster or something like how it's advertised. You're very much playing a different game indefinitely. This game is shovelware, because I've played other like this. This just has a fish skin over it. It's free, so I didn't even pay for this, and I want a refund for my time that was waisted on this garbage. Definitely don't download this bs "game"0/5

If I could give zero stars I would! Customer Support won't even respond to negative reviews even though millions are reporting & complaing about same/similar problems/issues. 😲😾 Gold Pass is a joke, only 6 days long, same price, as when it was 30+days & very few rewards. Way to kill a good game that used to be fun to play.😾 the only reason I stay is my Teammates have become friends. My Team and I, as well as many others will no longer purchase in game items. 😾

I was really enjoying the game and the variety of levels and puzzles, but like it's cousin Gardenscapes, the mechanics are the same and mini games are basically the same also. Biggest gripe, however, is the levels are geared to ultimately start making you spend real 💰 to get past them. And the concept of earning gems but having them locked in a piggybank that you have to pay real 💰 to unlock is evil. There is already a mechanism in game to buy gems with money, so let us keep what we earn!!!

Was not what I expected. Thought it would be like it had shown.... the fish growing and then eating bigger fish and so on. Nope, not how the game was. I'm so sick of the deception and misleading videos/pics/ads. It's a shameful play on the devs part to get more downloads and hopefully con people into spending money. Game is the same as so many others and lacks originality. Not impressed at all. Uninstalled.

I have enjoyed this game for a long time now. Most complaints on here are legit, but I still played and enjoyed. Whenever an opportunity came up to buy the gold pass option, and then just recently it switched from lasting a very long time to a week. So for this reason, I'm dropping my rating. I will reach out to support regarding my personal information and then I will be deleting the app.

Very Misleading. This game is nothing like advertised. This is another matching game. As you go up to the level, this game is programed to buy extra items in order to move up to the next level or finish the hard level. I have a very stressful job and I started to play this game to relieve my stress and I ended up getting more stressed. LOL. I uninstalled it today.

I noticed the powered bombs would be repeatedly thrown on the exact tile I was looking at. Also that a random fish I was looking at would try to "engage" me. Last, I realized, when I looked at the fish food, all of a sudden, all of the fish would indicate their hunger. So, I'm pretty sure this game is utilizing my camera to track my eyes. Aside from the fact this was blatantly false advertisement, I rather be safe then sorry with my privacy. Clearly there is no ethical standards here.

I was enjoying this game for a while...I got to level 33 and I have been stuck. I even paid to get more diamonds to continue playing after my 30 moves were used and I still couldn't beat it. I've used all my extra helpers like the explosives and the lightning and it didn't make a difference. I tried it when I had an hour of unlimited lives and still couldn't get it. I want to keep playing and enjoying this game, but if I can't get passed this level there is no use keeping it:(

It'd be a decent game if you didn't have to pay for the diamonds in the piggy bank that you've already earned. Almost impossible to get any diamonds since the developers want to hoard your stuff unless you pay for it. It's extremely difficult to pass levels without paying for powerups (via diamonds, cash, or both). The fact that the game won't let you use your own diamonds is a cheap move. Edit: also forgot to mention that if you don't immediately make a move during a game, then the app suggests a move and it's really distracting and obnoxious.

It isn't what they advertise in their ads. They lure you into the game thinking you get to save the fishes. The only way you get to play that is if you win an unreasonable amount of levels (which I have yet to figure out exactly how many) in a row. I made it to level 140 something and it showed up once, way back in the beginning. False advertising only makes me mad and guarantees I will never download from your company again! Not at all happy

So disappointing! Why couldn't they make the actual game they showed in the advertisement? I didn't want a stupid match 3 game, I wanted the action puzzles as shown! I played on thinking I could "earn" a chance to play a puzzel, but NO. Plus if you want to beat some of the levels ,you have to spend $, Otherwise you run out of moves before completing the tasks.If it actually obeys your commands, and you use extra ammo, you may proceed . I feel I was generous rating it a ☆☆. Deception and greed!

Well, you see something in the advertisement and find something so much different in the game. When you play the game you find the difficulty of some levels doesn't make any sense at all and depend only on paying money to continue, after some time the game becomes very boring and nothing new. One more thing I can add that the game doesn't have any moral benefits or goals more than wasting your time and money.

Love it so much. Just one little thing I would change. I wish you could take a fish from one tank and add it to another tank. Other than that its a great game. Also want to know why the add is not the same as the game itself?? I had to delete the game due to my phone playing up. Saw the add for the game and thought wow that different now. So downloaded the game again and found out that it was the same as before. Why are the ads so different from the game???

Disappointed! Saw ad that showed a game of skill. You had to choose which pin to move and order to keep fish safe. I haven't seen that gave or level anywhere. Instead the game is more like candy crush and buying fish things. False advertising. Unable to contact help. Must choose a help option, but none apply. Don't download have if u want to rest your skill. Very upset

I was a little bit leary of downloading this game at first. I was assuming it would be similar to other games of its like! They give you at first a tease of the game and then you have to fork out a grip load of money to progress to higher levels or to obtain special decorations! However I was plesantly surprised that this was NOT the case with Fishdom! I haven't spent a single penny on the game and I am currently on the 500 levels of the game that has, I believe, 2,000 plus levels! Worth it!!

Have been playing Fishdom for over a year now. I still enjoy collecting new and different fish and decorating my tank. Something new always added to change the game up a little. A great way to just relax or pass time. Have never had any issues like I have with some of my previous games. They made it easy for my transfer to a new device, which was not the case in another one of my games.

At first, this was a great, fun game to fill those times of waiting. The previews make it seem like there are often fun fish puzzles, which there are not. As story puzzles advance, they require increasing energy points to clear the path, although the reward or treat energy points do not increase. There is a lot of pressure to make purchases, and "harder" puzzles are difficult to solve without spending diamonds for more moves. It is no longer a fun pasttime.

1st... the game is fun, and, unfortunately, addicting. I say unfortunately because it is very hard to actually progress if you don't spend a bunch of your hard-earned real life cash money. I always say I won't spend any but you HAVE to if you want to gain levels. Most of the diamonds you earn by beating levels go into a "piggy bank" and you have to pay real money to access them. I understand in-app purchases, but we are forced to pay to progress. It is the same way in other Playrix games, too.

Click Bait. The game is well made, but it's click bait. I downladed for the simple action of eating other fish. Its a puzzle game first and eating fish game second. You can't really control the fish independently, it won't let you. You click the next fish over, no dragging. If i wanted a fishy puzzle game, this game would be a 10/10. Its very appropriate for children. The gold gained after the puzzles are adequate. You dont need to pay to win. Just save your coins. The animations are cute.

There is nothing free about this game. The only way to make any money to buy things or level up is to complete the bejeweled-blitz-like game. And the only way to win those games is to purchase "tools" to help you win. And you have to purchase them or purchase coins. So what exactly are we "playing??" If you are not willing to spend money, this game is a BORE!!!!

Did not like it. Also the ads for this game are annoying, making it seem like a different game, but just a matching game where they manipulate the difficulty curve to convince players to spend money. The have is at first easy, then challenging, until the momentum slows to a halt and a player must make purchases to continue. You may as well get the hacked version if the source is GPL.

Saw an ad for this game. Thought the fish eating other fish minigame looked fun. The ad made it seem like that was the main feature of the game, but you barely ever get to play that type of minigame. I don't understand why make an ad like that if it's not even that relevant to the game. If you came up with a minigame idea you think people will really want to play, enough to where you make an ad for your game based entirely around that minigame, then why not make that minigame freely accessible?

The game used to be fun and relaxing. After they realized that money could come easily with the option of selling GOLDEN PASSES, it became stressful and frustrating. Without a golden pass, you get stuck on the same game for weeks until the game itself decides to help you and bombs appear in bulks out of nowhere. I used to play it every day, now, when I get stuck, I simply forget about it for a week, then try again, and so on. SHAME ON YOU, developers.

Addictive but dumb, now we have to pay to open the bank for the diamonds we collected? Stupid. No thanks. See ya. Edit: years later and it's still the same. You have to spend money to use the diamonds you collected, but the time you reach level 190+ the levels become almost unbeatable and it won't be the players fault, it's just how the grid alignment is. Unfortunate, waste of time.

Fun game but dont like that I fill a fishy bank up then have to purchase it to get the hearts to keep playing a game if it's too difficult. Things cost too much in here and they keep wanting you to purchase stuff to keep playing. Also dont like the timed games. I enjoy this game because it's cute and relaxing, but the timed games are not relaxing and are quite difficult to pass. Did I mention.... I HATE THE TIMED GAMES!!! TAKE THEM OUT!

Saw this in an ad and it looked cute. Installed then... First thing is, buy a fish (your character), tale of things to come ($$$)... Started playing then the game is completely different than the ad. Its more like candy crash where the ad showed smallernfish growing by eating other fish. If this is a stage in the game, it was not clear nor did i have the option to skip it qnd play the game i came in for. When quitting the puzzle i was warned i will loose a life... I dont like games that bully me

It's just too hard. Initially you get hooked, but after reaching level 100+, unless you buy powerups, it really takes days to clear one level. Even my mom, who usually loves these types of games, got sick of it. I would not recommend the game to anybody. Just get a different matching game where you can play for hours. Seems that the developers aren't taking the feedback seriously too because when I wrote this, there's like 50 reviews saying the same.

Love the game so I bought Gold pass the other day. I never buy anything. It was awesome. Then yesterday I went on and I didnt have the Gold pass available on there. I've found my receipt and sent to you guys yesterday just as you ask to confirm transactions. I'm hoping I hear back soon and it gets fixed. I love everything else about the game (wish minigames were as much as an option on the actual game as it is in your ads). I'll change my review status if this ever gets handled.

Why do you have to update the game every few days? It's not like there's any difference. Then sometimes you're forced to take certain decisions you don't want to before you play the game. And yes, it's a misleading game. I downloaded it only to find out it's actually candy crush in another background, meanwhile, the main game i wanted is just a mini game that comes up once in a blue moon. So annoying!

It's a brainless, but fun, time-waster. As with most games like this, they will lure you with lots of rewards and extras to get you to play. After awhile they'll make it impossible to pass a level and prompt you to buy something extra. I usually just stop playing at that point. After awhile, they'll send you free rewards to get you to keep playing. At that point, I continue playing. Honestly, this game is nice but it's NOWHERE near good enough to spend money on.

I never write reviews but I am seriously disappointed in this app. The game is a match 3 game...not a puzzle game that the ad shows. I installed this game based on the logic puzzles that were advertised. If you want return customers you should not mislead them with what you are selling. I really like Playrix games and this one has fun graphics but I didn't download it to play a match 3 game. If you advertised that and I knew what I was getting I probably wouldn't have uninstalled it.

This game is totally misleading. It was supposed to be a puzzle game which is the only reason I downloaded, then come to find out it was a matching game.All the work one might put into it to earn what is available is for nothing cuz it turns out that you would STILL need to use real money to purchase what you put all that work in for. I would never recommend a game to anyone that takes the choice away from the player to either use in game currency or real currency to get a promoted item. Frauds!

I don't understand why companies like this keep creating ads that are misleading. The ad shows one mini game where you have to free the fish and makes it look like that's the whole game when in reality the game is just a stupid unoriginal match 3 game with rare fun mini games. Please stop lying in your advertisering. Or, crazy thought, actually make a game like you show in your ads. It looks fun, people would play it, you must think so too since you misrepresent fishdom as being like your ad.

The designs are beautiful, and overall is a very good game, but it is not relaxing. While games should be relaxing, this game is furtstrating most of the time because levels are very hard to pass.You need diamonds which are difficult to have. Also, with the update, the game has removed also the mini games where you could have some minutes of unlimited lives, and the boosters are not the same.

Yet another exercise in false advertising. Remember the ad that makes it look like it's about leveling up the fish to eat bigger fish? Yeah, that's just a minigame in this bog-standard tile matching game. The minigame is what you see in the ads, and they become increasingly uncommon the further you get in the game. Skip this one and save yourself the time.

Similar complaints like all the new reviews since the last update directed towards greed. I have loved and supported this game for too long but now it's all about advancing through levels, not collecting items through tasks to help you get through those hard levels. I have spent way too much money on this game and now you want me to spend over $27/month on the Gold Pass instead of the $5.40? Well your greed has just lost me as a player at level 6045.

So I haven't even played this game I see ads for it all the time and it's all the same "solve this puzzle" gimmick that I've probably seen 10 other mobile games do. So I think you should take just a fraction of that effort and make the game you are advertising. There is obviously a demand for your false advertisement game, it's common sense that that's what the consumer wants. Do not reply with some copy and pasted message I've seen on 5 other comments. If you really read I'll play this game

Another money making app. Starts off amazing. Fun to play. Relaxing. Then all of a sudden becomes impossible to continue unless you buy stuff. I don't mind buying a game like this for around €5. But these games are designed to make you spend lots of money. I don't want a challenging game to get stressed and spend bulks of money. I want a game to relax.

This is a very fun and addictive game. With that said, you will have to spend money once you get so many fish bowls, To pass you have to spend money. It is a very fun game and you want to keep getting more different fish so you need more bowls. And that cost. 1 month I spent $75 just so I could pass the levels to get more fish. Just wish when you reach certain levels you get some kind of reward for getting that high. something free, just something. That would make the game more interesting.

I have been misled to download this game thinking it was a different kind of game. I was playing other game and saw the ad for fishdom therefore downloaded this game.
