The ad I saw was moving sticks around and burning the fish and sharks etc, trying to escape from other predators. This game is basically feeding fishes and then candy crush???? Game is OK but will not be playing further as your ad is misleading and completely different.

THEY WILL NOT LET YOU WIN UNLESS YOU SPEND MONEY! I despise your recent update for the game. Thanks a lot for ruining a good thing. Well, now I'm going to uninstall this game. You've went and changed the prices of extras. I went to purchase the 1.99 deal that used to be and found out it was changed. Over level 5000 and now it's gone and for nothing. You had to get even more greedy. Thanks a lot. ZERO STARS. UPDATE: THEY WILL NOT LET YOU WIN ANYMORE UNLESS YOU SPEND MONEY!

in the last few weeks I have lost my super lightning without closing the game or restarting and when i contact the support, they gaslight me saying you must have closed the game or restarted or something else. it is very frustrating. and again, I was just playing the game and put down the phone for a minute and when I opened it, I was logged out and surely enough, when I opened the game the super lightning was gone. and of course it would be a waste of time to contact support.

The game was a cute and somewhat addictive time killer. However the constant nagging to leave a review gas caused me to lower my rating of the game and remove it.... If I leave a review don't constantly ask me to do it over and over again. Plus it reaches a point where you can spend days if not weeks (and a small fortune) trying to complete levels. Another issue if I start with the two bombs powerup they shouldn't be placed on the board right next to each other. Rendering one useless

FUN BUT MISLEADING! People, this is a candy crush style game. I'm on level 70 and so far I've played the "fish eating fish" game exactly once. If candy crush matching games are your thing then you might like it, but if you want to play because of the fish hunting game, don't bother downloading. On the plus side, its not riddled with ads like some games so there's that.

Fun, addicting actually, with a lot of variety, and increasingly challenging puzzles, but I really dislike that gems earned must be purchased for use with cash, as well as chances to play the games. I also dislike that there are requirements to purchase further game time, or that a timed break is mandatory. Just let us play and use our earned gems and other items

I really like the game but am disgusted by the game as well . The game is designed to make you spend money if you want to get anywhere . It's got nothing to do with luck or skill when it comes to passing a level ( just depends on when the game decides you have wasted enough time yet ) The worst part is when those cute little fish turn into playrix pimps trying to get you to notice the sales that are nothing but a rip-off .

I like this app and have spent more than I care to mention, but at $1.99 and .99 cents, I admit it did not seem like much to get past a level(I got sucked in). Now you have raised your prices. I will just keep with the free, I'm sure your season pass will go up in price also, which means less chance to pass levels=more wait time=loss of interest. With millions of users, how much more $ do you need to make? #sad#dissappointed

The game itself is kinda fun but it's insanely annoying how it always pushes you to do things when trying to just enjoy yourself. All these notes popping up block the view of your fish tank, too. Also, the ads that made me download it show a totally different style of game than what you actually end up doing. 100% misleading. I checked out other games from this company and as it seems that is just their thing. Huge disappointment.

It's a good game, but there are two things that it really needs. 1. Is a pause button for the timed levels so we don't end up losing a life if we need to stop for a minute. And 2. Is a "are you sure" option when choosing to spend diamonds for more moves/time. I have lost COUNTLESS diaminds, ones I've usually paid for, because the screen comes up so quickly and I think I'm still playing the game and accidentally click to play on and so I just lose the diamonds. Based on comments on Facebook, I'm not the only one incredibly frustrated by this. Surely it's an easy fix so that people who accidentally hit it can still opt out.

To be honest I was pleasantly surprised to discover how much I enjoy this game. I was addicted to Candy Crush and had gotten quite good at it but was stuck on a level in the upper 400's. Then I saw an ad for Fishdom and just had to try it. The graphics are adorable (and the fish interact with each other and with you!) After the first several levels the game play becomes more challenging but bonuses are fairly easy to get and use. The only complaint I have is that you have to use your unlimited plays when you win them and not at a time that's convenient for you. All in all, I am extremely satisfied with Fishdom; in fact I would go so far as to say I'm "hooked!" 😉

Forced to update right in the middle of playing with only one move needed to win the level & right after I purchased 10 diamonds in order to get 5 more plays to win said level. So am out the money spent to win that level(am still stuck on the same level)and didn't even receive the "free gift" promised for updating. It's impossible to advance very far in this game without spending quite a bit of money unless you want to spend the next 15 years of your life playing it. It's a total rip-off.

The game play is fun but I deleted because you have to "wipe" the screen every time you log in, feed your fish, close 5-6 different gimmicky prompts\gem ads, watch a few animations, get some more prompts, hit play, get a few more prompts and animations, then play for 30 seconds, then close more prompts....and the cycle continues. Can I just play the game already?

It's almost embarrassing how unabashedly generic this is. You played Gardenscapes? Yeah same game, but this one has a fish theme. Play a matching game (and sometimes a few little mini games they can put in the ads) to earn coins to upgrade your aquarium until the Bejeweled-clone gets too difficult to beat without paying for power-ups. Uninstalled in less than five minutes.

Great effects, usually fun to play but this game often keeps you stuck on levels, particularly if you get a 2 hour unlimited lives reward. Eg - if you have to catch a # of squid to win and just need a couple more, if they're not ready to let you pass, they just stop putting squid on the board. You still have to move, so you do until you lose because there's no way to win.

This game is a jumble of other games, but is not good at any of it. As a puzzle, I got to level 194 on my first life, over a 2 day period. This game has literally no challenge to it. The matching game has no purpose but to make you waste reaources. The mini-games are pitifully easy and never seem to progress to anything more significant. Lastly, the decorating of the bowls is equally pointless. I uninstalled on day 3 because this game has no interest that quickly.

I absolutely love the game or I DID love it. For reasons only known to the developers, they have changed the time on the goldpass! I have no problem paying $4.99 for 27 or so days but now you have me spending the same amount of money for a pass that is only good for 7 days??? How does that make any sense at all? We used to get 1 hour free play now it's 30 minutes. Until things go back to the way they were I won't spend another penny. I will also start looking for a new game to play. 😪

Terrible game. It is rigged. If you use your free bombs etc, it puts them where they don't help you at all. Timed levels are the worst...no time to figure out strategy to win the level. Good game just wish there was more puzzles. Update: been playing this game for a few months and it's addictive nice waste of time but they try to drain your pockets. Not at all as advertised. I wanted the game that they use to hook you in. This is nothing but another match 3 game, with added features of decorating an aquarium. The mini games are the ads, they are scattered and weirdly done. That was the reason I choose this game. Even though the reviews were not great. I love this game I'm somewhere level 4000+ I do wish that there was an option for us to dlt special aquariums& that the story book aquariums were put to better use or also could be dlted, after the challenge was complete. For instance, I may need 1 more red game piece, but there are none on the screen, or one bubble and there are none. That is frustrating. Secondly, I really do NOT like the timed levels. I'm sorry, but I am giving all of these games that have misleading ads inside of another game ONE STAR. If I could give zero I would. I hope they implement a system to where you can choose what kind of game you play instead of being forced into one boring type.

I do love this game and will continue to play, however, there are a few issues. 1) downloading updates - sometimes takes forever, if downloads at all. I've had to delete the game and reinstall. Been playing this game since it's inception (stopped for about a year), however, in recent times there are too many updates, alot of hidden difficult levels (yellow level extremely difficult to win), extra difficult levels every 3 levels and some impossible to beat unless you purchase a lot of gems/diamonds. This game makes it impossible to pass "simple" levels without spending actual money. It's getting to the point that i want to stop playing that game after years of playing across multiple phones. One time I didn't get diamonds for updating the game like I was supposed to so I submitted a complaint to their support team, (not really expecting them to ever respond or credit me the missing diamonds, because other games I've played like Candy Crush for example, have awful support and usually do nothing to resolve issues for me.) These guys responded within a couple days. They apologized and credited me my missing diamonds. So thank you for that!

This game is highly addictive. Some levels are almost impossible, however. It would really be nice if you got more rewards than you do. Its almost impossible to advance at times without spending money and you could get more for what you spend. I also don't think you should have to pay for the coins you get for winning levels. That's a reward. We have to pay for enough.

I absolutely love Fishdom! I have a number of aquariums now and Fishdom has a number of new contests and new quests that they add on to help clear levels. You can use money to buy boosters but, with patience, the games can be beaten, but now the game gives you ways to earn boosters. I love the variety of fish who all "talk", and make me smile and laugh every day. Decorating each aquarium is lots of fun! I highly recommend this game, so download the app and have fun. I did and I do.🙂

I loved this game when I first started but DANG it costs sooo much to pay, you can't get out of any level without multiple $$$$$, this has become "rob a day each time ya play.!! Now I've played for quite some time but it's getting really slo on the loading and now its F. up alot of other games so I had to uninstall it. Too bad it was relaxing.

This game is actually really fun. I enjoy how it isn't over ran with ads. Although I noticed some levels they don't give you enough turn so it's IMPOSSIBLE to beat the level without using gems, which the main/only way of getting gems is spending money. Seems scummy to me. If they were to either improve those levels (adding more turns) or make it so you could watch ads to get gems it would be a five star game. I've been stuck on level 86 for days and spent hours trying to bet it. No luck

Im rather disappointed that this game is nothing like the advertisment at all. That game looks way more fun and challenging. That being said i like decorating the aquariums and the selection of items is great. However in order to get the coins to decorate the aquarium you have to pass levels that are just too hard to pass. Ive deleted other games by playrix for the same two reasons. Nothing like the ad and way too hard to pass levels.

The good: It's a fun and cute puzzle game and I've invested hours in it - nearing level 4k. The fish are cute and the puzzles are quite entertaining. The bad: I've played a bunch of similar games, and while I have no problem spending some money on them, this game and its algorithm are particularly shameless. I could write an essay about it. So it's on its way to be wiped from my phone as soon as this season is over.

I thought the game was ok for what it was but after getting bored and deleting it I started seeing ads that portray it as a completely different game. It seems to be a trend with mobile games right now. Fishdom and Gardenscapes are the main ones but there are many. I have no respect for a company that so blatantly advertises false information. If you think that that style of game will get more customers than your actual game then maybe you need to rethink your game instead of lying to everyone.

Impossible to beat levels after a certain point unless you purchase gems and boosters. I was wondering how others got to level 400 before it got hard to them, turns out the lowest levels were switched in recent times so that you only have under 10-15 moves to pass them. Those who had this years ago got 2x more moves. It was fun while it lasted. Switched to Royal Match and they actually reward you for playing their game and make it fun and challenging enough.

The game is so addictive, firstly it was so interesting, as I was gaining coins, gems a D etc and the challenges were kind of easier. However, as new achievements completed the game became both addicting and boring. Boring in terms of the thing that you don't get coins and gems until you win challenges, and another issue is you don't win advanced challenges without extra supportive items. Furthermore, I was thinking that I will get coins from the fish timely but I have not received any coins.

pretty good game.... they make most of the goals and levels almost too hard to the point i feel forced to pay... most levels seem like you have to pay to advance. not my favorite freemium game. If they have a few easier levels in between, i wouldn't feel like they were just after my money. Another suggestion would be to offer a power up after losing a level if a video was watched, or some other ad (like ab pop). The game owners just seem too thirsty for my money.

Edit: The glitches in the game continues. You will make the right moves and it will not do what it is supposed to do. The game forces you to buy power else you'll not be able to progress This game used to be fun the makers got greedy. The game is designed in a way that you will HAVE to spend money after the initial lvls. The cost to buy upgrades also keep on increasing..not worth it..the fun is gone from the game and you'll see the same complaints in the team chats too.

I really enjoy this game. But the recent change to the Gold Pass is TERRIBLE. Pay the same price for a quarter of the time? Fewer options to earn power-ups, and now they can only be earned by passing levels rather than by completing tasks. If the change was to make us buy more frequently, it backfired. My teammates and I are done making purchases. Dumb move, developers. Such a shame to ruin my favorite game.

The fish puzzle that spams other game ads is a mini game here. This is another matching game with a lot of extra stuff. Graphics are good/gameplay smooth. Super hard levels = spend $ to clear. 54 clears with 14 moves is obviously a cash grab. The fish minigame become less frequent as you level up. Free perks are held at 24 and 48 hours. There's also a boring side bit to decorate a room that makes no sense. The aquarium is cool, but becomes tedious to maintain after awhile. Ad free though so ok

If you're getting this because of all the ads you see showing some interesting strategy games, DO NOT get this. It's all about an aquarium and a bejeweled type game. Don't waste your time, like I did, because of the marketing hype. I got to level 56 and NOTHING opened like the games in the ads. Fraudulent ads at their best....

I first downloaded the game based on the ads which turned out to be misleading. It was supposed to be an escape puzzle game, playing as a little fish. I decided to give the game a try anyway once I saw it was really shapes matching like candy crush. The game is pretty fun BUT after a while you can't play without special items which have to be bought or a randomly picked daily gift. THE BIGGEST ANNOYANCE is that you earn diamonds when you play. You have to buy access to the diamonds you earned!

I downloaded based on a video ad for the game showing a system of pipes and a reservoir of sludge that required sliding and pulling pins to direct away from a fish. The actual game is nothing like that. It's just every other playrix puzzle block game with fish. Sure, there are minigames that differ in game play but the art and animations are terrible and they make up less than 10% of the game. Pass

This game was fun until I got stuck and could no longer advance. I have literally spent so much time repeating the same level that I have memorized how each square will change and am always left between 1 and 13 tasks (gold tiles) to be removed. Also the mini game (the part in the ads) is the game I truly wanted to play but that's only 1% of the actual game.

It's fun, but turns into a money grab quickly. First, the fish eating mini-game shown in the ads almost never comes up - the vast majority of this game is a color matching game and using the proceeds from that game to decorate various fish bowls. Second, it becomes very hard to play without money after a few days. Although the developers claim there's a free to play solution to every level, I think the solutions to a lot of levels are random enough that players can't find them without $$.

Impossible to win when you get to levels in the 40's. Making puzzles harder just discourages you and I'm not putting my cc in to win games!! When you get to the summer bowl good luck getting fish. It will take til next summer to get them! The coupon system sucks. Could be a fin fantastic game if they weren't such Moby dicks about it. Yes, their beatable when you pay money to buy the packages of bombs you offer! Again a Moby Dick move!

im on level 36,was really enjoying game until the game told me unless i bought something- i had to wait 30 minutes to play again ! Yeah- thats free- NOT. quite a while later- love it but still challenging. I was enjoying the game, after 1 1/2 years I was on level 4917, it started to crash/freeze and nothing suggested worked. Too bad, time to Uninstall and move on

Nice Game, but just the same concept. I was looking for something different. I saw the ads showing a fish in a pipe and you had to choose how to get them passed an obstacle. Intrigued, I installed to find this game is like the others. Homescapes minus the storyline. And what hooked me were 3 little mini games that are, for me, the highlight of the whole game. Overall the main game is ok. I like the different aquariums but not entirely what I wanted.

After being bombarded relentlessly with ads for this game, I eventually downloaded it. Despite deleting a number of other games, it keeps telling me I need more space to play. Wow, this is a game, not a major programme! I've now read many reviews on here, explaining that the advertised games are just infrequent minigames, and that the gameplay is significantly different- just another match3 game- I'm now going to uninstall this having had no opportunity to play at all, I just won't bother.

The game needs an option to play untimed and a better way to earn diamonds, for those of us on a limited income who cannot afford to buy them! You also need to make it so that the player can hold their device anyway they want and the game board orientation will change. It's annoying to only be able to hold my phone one way, because the charging cord gets in my way.

Great game, been playing for years. But I've become disappointed in it. You follow a trail toward an object burning points to clear objects. however the game forces you to clear objects not even in your way just to get you to burn points so you have to buy more. You also reach a point where you can't complete the game without spending $$. its become a total Scam!

I have uninstalled this game because match 3 has been done to death. I don't like them anymore. I only installed it because I wanted to play the eating fish puzzle. I didn't realise that it was going to be mostly garbage match 3. I had the same problem with homescapes & a couple of others. Match 3 was good 20 years ago. You need new game ideas & the fish eating fish is a new & more interesting idea. You really should work on developing that idea more.

I like playing this game, but can you stop with all the pop-up messages?! It's quite irritating when all I want to do is FEED MY FISH! Stop with the hard stops, & I'll give it 5 stars. EDIT: If we are awarded infinite lives, please make it optional if we can save it for later instead of being forced to use it right away. I just updated the game to the Holiday Season version. I wanted to play 1 quick game because I had some free time but wasn't able to because I didn't wan to claim the 1 hr yet

I downloaded it because I kept seeing ads where you have to drag and drop a fish to other fish, eating the smaller ones to level up and be able to eat the big ones. I thought that looked fun. Turns out the actual game is basically just candy crush. I don't know why the ads show a totally different game than what you actually play.

I uninstalled a game to make room for this one because the getting the fish through the tunnel by helping it through the traps looked like a lot of fun. However, that part of the game is few and far between and when it does pop up it will not open. What a rip off, false advertisement. If i could give less than one star i would. This is the 2nd time I've brought it to your attention and obviously you don't care so I'll just uninstall Fishdom and install the game that actually worked.

For a match game this game is pretty fun however I have spent money just to beat a level and then it gives me another level too difficult to beat without boosters only a few levels later. You would think after spending some money on the game they would allow you to play for a few days or something not only a few minutes. Some of their levels are impossible to beat without boosters that you purchase. I've played this game a little over a week and I'm going to uninstall

Only download this game if you're rich and have a lot of money to waste on buying multiple powerups (which will sometimes even magically disappear without you even using them!) It's a waste of time trying to resolve these issues with the developers because they simply don't care. (Especially if they've already got your money!)

Changing my review....played this game for years but some of the new changes are hot garbage. Challenge levels are frustrating and seem especially created to kill a run of levels and take away momentum as they are nearly unbeatable and the rewards are paltry, somewhat rage inducing and they certainly reduce the fun of the game and the amount of play time. I don't mind a bit of difficulty (been stuck on more than one level for 50+ gos) but the challenge levels are just a kick in the teeth.

It is basically just a match-3 game, like Candy Crush or any of the plethora of other games like it. The other "puzzles" (pulling the bars or eating the bigger fish) are incredibly basic and require minimal thought or skill. This falls in with all other Playrix games that have little, or even nothing, to do with what you see in their ads. Why do you spend so much time developing ads that don't showcase the game instead of actually developing the game?

It's not at all as advertised. I do NOT want "story time" or a "meet & greet" with a freaking animated character. It also looks NOTHING like the ads in other games, not even remotely close. Basically, a HUGE bait and switch. Will be deleting game and also ignoring future ads in that game. Market your game properly or don't at all. The way you SELL it is cool, but it's NOT what you get.

The game is fun to play. I have this on my cell and it takes up a lot of memory. I am now at the point I'm having to delete the game. The add ons , like the seasonal aquariums. When they are over they don't get removed. I think this is a poor design in the makers. It is sad that I'm having to delete it because I enjoyed playing even when I got frustrated. Rated a one star due to aquariums that are seasonal are nor removed and it has taken up too much memory on phone.

So far so good. Fun to play and versatile. Hopefully it won't get too difficult. I play games to relax, and using 20 to 30 lives to get through a level is not relaxing...it's frustrating! A year later...tired of constantly having to update. Updated on 3/6 and now 11 days later I have to update again to continue playing. Now 2 weeks later, have to update again. This is getting rediculous! Nov. it has been 3 days since I updated and now I can't continue the game without updating again.

They catfished me, I downloaded it thinking it was one of those choose your weapon with the Nemo fish. It wasn't long before I realized it wasn't that, let alone a big part of the game, but surprisingly, I ended up staying. To give an idea I'm over level 2200 in just a couple months and still playing. That's all I can say tbh. You didn't have to catfish me though fishdom, I would have liked you anyway.

Not as advertised. Wanted to play a game to save a cute fish. Got match-3. I've played to level 150, got three simple mini-games in the very beginning. Nothing after. Boo. Purchases appear costly compared to other games. Designed to waste them so you'll buy more. Won't get my money. Their other games are similarly deceptive.

I am hooked! (line and sinker)! Other than losing several decorations and when I asked about getting them back,AFTER searching for them & following instructions,to no avail....THEY BASICALLY CALLED ME A LIAR AND ACCUSED ME OF CHEATING!!!! However I am still playing this highly addictive game. And spending enough cash they SHOULD know I'm neither a LIAR or a CHEAT. FUN GAME!

Initially I really enjoyed this game but once you pass level 1000 it becomes so difficult that it's no longer enjoyable. They need to take a page from Pet Rescue Saga and offer more rewards to give you a chance to pass more difficult levels. While I appreciate the customer service, in that I received a response to my review, I cannot imagine that receiving tips will help me. I'm past level 1800 so I'm quite familiar with the ins and outs of the game. For example, at level 1852 with the number of moves it's nearly impossible.

I really thought this app would be fun and relaxing I'm on level 705 can not pass level without buying more boosts and passes. Im over this game now. I have spent hundreds of dollars and I don't feel it worth it. Cant get any further. They make these level impossible. Just to get your money. This is just a game for Playrix to make money off of so beware. Very frustrating!

Fun, but a totally different game than what was advertised. Only install it if you want to end up paying a lot of money....the levels get so hard that you basically can't pass the them without buying things. You will end up spending a lot of money if you want to keep playing. Too bad. If you have kids that have the ability to purchase on the app, be careful!!!

Takes too much money to play. fun game, but not worth it. *Update* I changed this from 2 stars to 1 star because of the comment from the creators. This game is not always passable without some sort of additional help (aka paid for assistance). I've been playing for years and I'm quite good, but there are levels that no one could pass without at least getting extra moves. just own up to it and do something to make it more affordable and fair or don't say anything at all! ill probably delete

A very hard game but cute,only thing I would change is the fact that you have way too many hard and super hard levels after two or four easy levels. Along with a challenge level and too few powerups and to few moves. I changed my rating to one star as it's way too difficult to make it through even using power ups. I have been stuck on a level for the last 2 weeks and used up all my power ups trying to beat the level. I will be removing the game as its just to frustrating.

Fine. But I didn't realise it was dev-ed by the same guys thar made Homescapes and others of the colour-matching sort, so I only installed it because I saw the ad in another game and thought the game was a different thing. It wasn't what I expected. Besides, it's bloody annoying that fishes have cartoonish smiles instead of a more realistic fashion.

In order to advance in the game, you literally have to pay your way. Once you pay, and depending how much, you receive ammunition to defeat the board. You gain ammunition within the board also. Like the game, but having to pay so much in order to advance and receive higher levels and rewards is not fun. Not fun at all. 😯😒😔😢

From ad, thought it was the game where you move your fish to try to nom your way out. After installing only found out it isn't, but those puzzle type game. Even at lower levels (around 10), already hard to play. So less moves but need to finish so many tiles etc. Forcing us to use all items to clear a stage. Probably AI would be able to clear them all within the moves. Not a fun game at all.

If I could put no stars, I would. As much as I enjoy homescape and gardenscape there's just something missing from this one. It's so, incredibly boring! Even after thirty levels I was just having such a full time. My tank choices were uninteresting, the fish were uninteresting, it was all such a bore. You'd probably have more fun watching live fish, don't waste your storage space on this one. 👎🏽

It is very nicely done, addictive, beautiful and relaxing...But it has one huge flaw, which ruins the whole experience - levels are absurdly hard to beat without power-ups, and power-ups, of course, cost real money. I am at level 30 now and I'm already advancing as slow as 1-2 levels a day, and believe me, I play pretty much. If at level 30 it's like this, then at levels 100+ will I spend weeks stuck on a level? Maybe so, if I don't uninstall it first.

Not as fun as it was a couple of years ago. There used to be special seasonal fish tanks that we could earn tokens for and with these tokens buy fish and decorations for those tanks. There are no more special seasonal tanks only really stupid stories that don't contain/keep any fish. The game play is now random chaos rather than using your intellectual abilities to plan/calculate how to beat the levels. Hence, this game is less rewarding to play than it was in past years.

I feel lied to. I downloaded this game because I thought it would be a game about fish eating other fish in order to power up. This is what every commercial I saw for the game had, but instead the game seems to be based around the candy crush model. Which I hate. Please don't advertise one game only to actually have a different game. Uninstalling.

Pretty good little game. The scenery in each section is quite detailed. The prices for most items are too high. Cute and challenging game. It would be really cool if the fish and other creatures in this app could really respond to you when you talk to them or respond to their questions! This game is expensive; too expensive if you purchase the fish bank everytime you want to collect the purple diamonds or you want to purchase a theme package!😐🐬🐠🐙

I like the game as it keeps me to be strategic in every move I make. However, as the time goes on, each aquarium and even other seasonal events are getting more expensive and unreasonably difficult. You are compelled to buy gems if you want to finish the game however my wallet was finished first before I finished my game. I wish that the golden coins can be used in buying gems through this it can help players manage their games and finances efficiently.

EXTREMELY EXPENSIVE! No way to get diamonds without purchase. This game needs a diamond system like the solitaire game version of this game. Every hr you get a stock of diamonds on that game. This one does not and it costs a lot of money just to get a small amount that doesn't last long. Diamonds are a must as some scenes need more turns you have to buy.

You get to a point where you have to buy boosters in order to pass levels. They make it almost impossible. It was fun at first building fish tanks but eventually you get so frustrated with spending money and still losing, I wound up deleting the game. Also the game is NOTHING like you see in the ads!! It has a candy crush type game that you play ONLY, and you build fish tanks to gain points!

Thought it was something completely different... The advert was a puzzle solving game where you had to pull levers to get the fish through the level alive. But then when I download the app and start it I find out its just a candy crush rip off with an aquarium. Incredibly disappointing that the advert is so untrue to the reality of the game... Especially because based on the advert I wanted to play that - and not what I in reality got.

Cash grab - the little games it advetises it to be are very sparse and take 2 seconds. Most if the game is stupid and they try to take up time with the little fish trying to say clever things and then there is the constant bombardments of buying more in the game. One after another. If the game was more fun I might consider spending money, but if the only way to really enjoy it is to continuously spend money, then no thank you. Wouldn't really recommend.

Great graphics, appealing sound effects, and absolutely wonderful music that warms my heart. Why am I rating it with 1 star? There are over 4000 levels in the game, and after clearing only 5% of those levels it became impossible. The random number generation won't let me win, and the only way to progess is by sheer dumb luck or by spending hundreds on microtransactions. It isn't a "puzzle game". It's a "how rich are you?" game, and I'm not playing it. Trash. 👎

Played off and on for a couple of months then uninstalled. From other reviews I knew the logic maze games they advertise were a minor part but after 20 levels and about 5 hrs I got one 30 second maze game. The rest are more speed matching with minimal brain work. Then the game insisted I had to buy a certain fish and wouldn't let me do anything else. I wanted to save my treasure for a better fish (IMHO) but there were no options. The whole thing seems quite manipulative. No thanks.

Misleading Ad. Ad shows pipes and asks you to save the fish. But what you get are fish bowls and a RIP off version of candy crush. I took the time to finish one aquarium hoping it would finally lead the the pipes. But it doesnt. I've found this same misleading ad for gardenscapes and other similar games where they advertise saving something but the actual games is something else. If the saving games are developed, why not let us download and play those? How do we actually find those games?

I enjoy the graphics etc......BUT to play the same level repeatedly (sometimes 30 plus attempts) is very frustrating!!! plus the game insists on the player using up the bombs etc and still cannot beat some levels. so i can only rate this with a single star. update 2-13-2019, gaming experience still sucks so now removing from my device. games are supposed to be fun and relaxing, this isnt anymore. goodbye!!!

The ads online that promote this game are all but pure propaganda. I am only interested in playing the "Save the Fish" game and I don't enjoy decorating the fish tanks or any of the many other tasks I must complete to play the all-too-brief mini game to save the fish. You should make a game that is a long, increasingly complex version of the mini-game which is the only aspect of this game that you advertise. I have removed the game from my device.

I was only able to apply basic strategies due to the randomness of each puzzle. Eventually, it became difficult to move on to the next level unless I purchased gem packages. The more I purchased the more rewards I earned, but if I slacked off purchasing gem packages the rewards were few and lackluster. Unwilling to invest more funds in the game in order to progress to higher levels, the entertainment value lost its appeal and I uninstalled the game.

I uninstalled it after a few days. The game itself could be cute but just like the rest of the games like this (Homescapes, Gardenscapes, etc.), it's just a way to draw you in and try to get money from you. You start out fine but soon can't advance without buying "boosts" and you have to buy the boosts you earn because they're "locked" in a bank or treasure chest. Don't waste your time (or money) installing.

Love the game, but it's •way• too expensive. I'd deleted this game once b/c of it &will again. I've noticed some good changes, but my biggest beef is to have to PAY to access diamonds that I already won. That's just BS! And it's all so expensive - don't let the "only" 9 diamonds to continue & earn that "special ticket!" that let's you buy "original" avatars allow you to get carried away; you'll end up spending a lot of money (to buy the diamonds) for something that's purely cosmetic!

Makes you spend money to get the jewelry out of the fish when it's full On the real hard parts it takes away things that you need to progress. This game is just a money pit. I can't believe that it's as popular as Evony where the option is if you want to play slow and risk getting hit you only have to invest 5.00 1 time not every day. That's 150.00 X 12 = $1800.00 a year that's one heck of a lot of money and you'd be better off buying a game system that you can play forever. Just saying

It's not quite like regular solitaire, and the RNG is especially frustrating, especially in later levels. It's set up so that you cannot win without making in-app purchases at some point for boosters, which is a common problem amongst most RNG games. I have paid to support devs for games I like, including RNG games, but I don't personally find this one worth spending money on. Especially since, even with a pass, you cannot consistently win levels and will have to continue buying boosts.

While Fishdom is a great, fun game that is both challenging and more addictive then Bejeweled, I will not continue playing as this game is way, way too expensive to play. You have to spend money to purchase purple gems needed for everything from continues during a level (9 or more) to refilling special tools (49+), while spending from $2.99 to over $100 to get 50 to 500+ gems. This game is fun to play if you got the money and don't mind spending it like water.

totally addicted. ok after been playing for a little while now. I am disappointed that I have to pay $2.99 to get my gems. I don't pay for games that say they are free. I do enjoy this game but that is my only big complaint. also a little annoying is the sensitivity of the direction you want to move a piece. you want to go left for example and instead it goes right or some other direction. but that's all. I'm still going to play. ;)

This game is fun... eventually it does get super challenging so you either have to pay to get past a level or fail at the same level many times before they let you win. But I really enjoy the decorating of the aquariums. Wish coins & vouchers could be paid for so that I didn't have to wait to be able to afford decorations in-game. I don't like paying to get through levels because it's not guaranteed...I've put money into the game at times just to lose again so I don't anymore to avoid upset. 🤷

Fun and entertaining game! But, when a major update happened, I lost most of my points that I had accrued...I went from over 1 million down to 200K. Also, I dont like how long it takes to open the next tank, especially if you've maxed out on fish for the tank. Then, you're left with putting rinky-dinky items in to clutter the tank.

Don't get this unless you like spending money. I'm going to describe this game as everyone else has. You can't play this game past lvl 42 without paying money. I was stuck for days because I wouldn't pay for an in app purchase. I caved and bought an explosive but it still wasn't enough. I leveled up after buying a plant for the fish and got an explosive pack and passed the level. This game makes it impossible to play without spending money.

Misleading ads and too many hoops to jump through to actually play! I wanted to play the puzzles advertised (get a fish through mazes by opening keys/tunnels) but that isn't the main game. In the month I've played, I've only unlocked 2 very short puzzles. I kept the app because I like the main matching game and fish tanks but the amount in inner-game popups is rediculis (5-10 before I can play!) and now I can't seem to advance without purchasing power ups. I'm done.

Just completed the February update for Valentine's day. I strongly dislike the change in features. They look very low budget, blurred, oversized, lack of detail and overall worse than the original look. They could've changed the theme of the tank as they usually do; not the appearance on the board. I it goes back to the old appearance.

Update: after 5+ years of playing... the repeated gold pass events do make it a bit more Pay to Win... but it's cheapish The midget loves it... editing my review because I see the many complaints about levels being too hard etc. So I'll say more: first yes some levels can be a bit of a challenge but that adds to the fun... no you absolutely DON'T need to pay anything to succeed in this game! And if you choose to spend a little there are really cheap ($1-$3) options that can give A LOT of help.

After beating many hard levels and winning 50 diamonds which are the game's currency, we are forced to "purchase" the diamonds from a piggy bank for $2.99 weekly. Its a ripoff built into the game. Ruins it for me. :^( UPDATE: 04/2020 Game is getting too unpredictable. 3 of my aquariums just disappeared with no warning or explanation. Lost all my fav fish, sea turtle and decorations overnight. What the...?

BEWARE. Fun game, but it's a con. They just want your money. DON'T download. Ads are misleading as the game shown is rarely available. Then, as you level up, it becomes too difficult to win to force you to "pay to play." If you don't pay, you end up playing the same level over and over and over . . . You get only five lives, then have to wait (and wait) to play again. You can spend days on one level. Not enough moves are given, and bombs don't really do anything to clear the board. Awful.

I'm lowering my rating b/c as i play i'm realizing that the diamonds that i earn from winning levels gets stored in a piggy bank that i am then asked to purchase for like $5. Why would i pay for something i earned for free? I'll continue to play, but i will never buy the diamonds... that's just ridiculous. And its annoying that i cant just start a new level. It's a waste of time to show me every thing i earned while playing if there's a timer running for my free play time.

Money hungry!! This game used to be fun. Now the developers have changed the game so now you can't even pass a level without paying. We used to get diamonds on the mini games. Now we don't. the game wasn't as advertised but it was still fun to play, I spent hours of my life playing up untill you get to level 30 ish then the games are so hard that you can not beat them unless you pay for power ups. deleting unless there's a change on the difficulty level. I think this game is really great and a lot of fun BUT there are levels completely unbeatable without spending money and that is frustrating. Enjoy the game very much so far (lvl 183). My ONLY COMPLAINT is the automatic hints. You don't even get a chance to look at the board & decide on a move. I find them very distracting and annoying. Wish they could be toggled on & off.

Money pit! Don't download it! I use to enjoy playing this game, but it has become so hard that you almost want to stop playing. The same levels have on avarege between 5-10 less moves. Great start to the game, but it started to get to levels where you absolutely HAD to buy power ups or gems in order to beat the levels. Soooooo ADDICTIVE!! I've even started humanizing my pet fish😂😂 the game is too cute.. My only suggestion would be to add and create more unique dialogue for each tank! I used yo really like playing this game casually,, probably thousands of hours, near the top most level. Recently they updated and prices for playing on pretty much doubled. And then when you get to a Hard or Super Hard: forget it. You're stuck for DAYS & sometimes have to play a level dozens or even 100 times only to get stuck AGAIN just a few levels later. While they say free to play, they're clearly trying to force you to spend $.

I can understand making purchases maybe to get ahead in a race or to collect boosters for the OCCASIONAL challenge or super hard level. But when you can't win a regular level without using all of your boosters and diamonds AND STILL having to make a purchase, it becomes a scam. And I see I'm not the only one complaining. I only gave 2 stars because I really enjoyed the interactive scenes and mini games. I guess I'll check back in a few weeks to see if anything has improved.

The game has no ads which is great. The gameplay is mostly your standard matching game, tragically. I installed it for the little fish path minigame. Since it doesn't have ads, its revenue is off of microtransactions. They really like to try to push you to buy stuff.

Yet another scam game. I installed because of the mini games it advertised, only to have those games disappear after a few levels. If it takes days of endless grinding to pass a single level due to the game's need to get you to pay for the privilege of playing, it isn't fun anymore.

The only problem I have had with game so far, is I have gotten all the pieces even got the check mark, but it comes back that I didn't win the game and had to play it over. I used to have a large fish aquarium so this brings back memories. Also on daily plays, although I play it everyday, I keep getting sent back to day 1. Irritating. Updates?
