I have been playing for a long time, over 5k levels, now the past couple seasons my game has been riddled with issues! Last season I bought the Gold Pass as soon as it was available. A couple days later my entire season, including Gold Pass, disappeared! A woman from Support finally answered me several days later, and she accused me of CHEATING by somehow changing time & date of game! BS!!! This season my game won't load. At all. After I bought Gold Pass. This game sucks. Don't waste your $$.

The ad for this game is deceptive. The actual game is nothing like advertised. It's one of those generic puzzle games like Royal Match, gardenscapes, and many others. You just slowly "decorate" a fish tank. It's a BS game, don't waste your time if you are looking to find something more fulfilling.

Genuinely not sure how to rate this game. I love the aquariums and buying stuff for them and all that. It's weird because much of the art & dialogue feels like this game is for kids, but MANY of the levels (every 5 to 10) are far too difficult. I've played bejeweled type games since childhood, but I've never come across one this hard. Losing the same level 20+ times (USING BOOSTERS EVERY TIME) is not fun. I'm very close to uninstalling, which I don't want to do because I enjoy the fishes :(

I love the fishes and flowers the game play is easy in some parts i love it thank you!!! the talking fish are so awsome & the aquariums are so beautiful with those different color skemes, i love them all the empress fish, the seahorse Rachael ilove them all! thank you for creating this!❤i don't like it when you have to update the game because it slows the feeding process for the fishes down! and then they have to wait even longer just to b feed their food! You wouldn't want to wait for ur fd?upd

This is my favorite match 3 game. Better than all the others out there, and I love the friendly fish! People saying it's not free and that the levels are too hard to beat without money are... wrong. I've cleared over 7,000 levels, and I never pay to play. Maybe it takes a few tries to beat a hard level, but that's what makes the game fun!

My previous review was 5, I downgraded to 1. I like being able to compete without being on social media which I'll never be on again. What I don't like about Fishdom, that messages to developers has not resolved, is being forced to participate in aquariums with which I consciencely do not agree. There is malevolent symbolism being brought in to an otherwise fun game. Give players the option of bypassing aquariums dealing with evil topics, and I will increase rating!

Pros: Soo many different levels and even some in- game games. The graphics are top level. Cons: Yellow levels are supposed to be easier than the red and purple levels. But I've found that the higher up in the game you get, often the yellow levels are just as difficult. It gets pretty frustrating. Also you only get 5 lives and it takes a very long time for those to replenish. So I took away one star for these reason.

I haven't enjoyed the game since they took off the merge mini game... I get on every once in awhile to see if it's back and then back off when I see that it's not. the explore mini is just too high maintenance and annoying because everytime there's a new season, it makes you go through the same tutorial that you've already been forced to go through.

This game used to be a lot of fun. I've downloaded it 3 times. Problem is everytime I've downloaded the game, it has extremely changed. They have made it impossible to play without buying your way thru levels. These aren't just difficult, they are next to impossible. Game is no fun anymore. Thanks for ruining it. I won't pay to play... ever!

This game can be addicting but very frustrating at the same time. I'm on level 623 and no matter what power tool I use, there is no beating this level-I went to YouTube to see how to beat and I noticed they got 30 plus moves in the game and I'm only getting 20...WHY?! Time for me to find a new game-I did enjoy this game, while it lasted.

I have been forced to lower my rating. Although the game itself is fun itself, the creators are extremely greedy. They have nearly made it impossible to pass levels without spending money. They raised prices on everything, sucking the joy right out of it. Lower the prices and make it enjoyable again please! Many have stopped playing for that reason.

I really love this game and the fish are really cute and say funny things. Decorating tanks is great too. The only thing is that many levels are way too hard and it makes me so angry that i wont be able to buy a special xmas fish ...bad bad bad. I give up. I would give it a 5 except for the impossible levels. Grrrrr. Its bad enough i gave up on gardenescapes. What a rip off. FALSE ADVERTISING.

This game does have teams and I do like that. I'm glad that they have a way to connect to so many people around the world. So many games making add FB accounts or Instagram. But this game allows you to add just an email. I love the games, the aquariums, and some events. I do wish the events were new. I got a repeating event that I already got the special fish.

Update...they have changed things in the game where it's harder to get free points or cheaper points (the fish bank) it's very hard to win without spending money on this game. Levels are too hard without purchasing things. I'm going to delete it. Very fun game. the reason i didnt give it 5 stars is because of the timed levels. They are very frustrating to the point it takes the fun out of it. I'm considering deleting the game because of the timed levels.

Saw ad where you save fish that looked fun. Not anything like ad. Just same match 3 like every other game. Cant even turn off hints. Wont let you look at game for 2 seconds before tiles start nudging and nagging at you. Wont let you play like you want. Makes you feel like you want to avoid hinted tile even if its the one you would have picked given 2 seconds to look at it. Makes you feel patronized when you have to pick hint when it's best option. Also, tutorial fish wont shut up. Frustrating

The only thing creative about this knockoff pay to play game are the number of predatory tactics they use to try and force expensive in-app purchases. These features include: lying that you will "lose" a contest, large buttons to purchase but the X to close the menu is small and the same color as the background, and match games that require no skill to win if just purchase more in-game items.

Like previous long time players have stated, the game has drastically changed...for the worse. It was fun & addicting at just the right difficulty and price point. But it seems that they've gotten greedy. A lot of the "non" hard levels are now just as difficult as the hard & super hard levels. Plus their Golden Ticket event (of $4.99) has gone from once a month to every 10-15 days. I'm out. This is now just a pay-to-play game

When this game was advertised, it showed that you have to remove the bars in order to save the fish but when I donlowded the game it was no different than candy crush. I am kind of disappointed because of the false advertisement I hoped that this game would meet my expectation like the advertisement did. Unfortunately it didn't. Over all if you like candy crush or toon blast, than I recommend this game for you.

I have played this game for several years, I enjoyed it at first, though I found it annoying to have to have so many decorations in one tank in order to get enough stars to open the next tank, sometimes less is far more when placing objects in a tank. Next.... the level have gotten so difficult that the only way to pass is use boosters, and the only way to obtain enough boosters to pass is to buy them. When it takes several days of using all your lives to pass a level....not so fun.

I really enjoyed this game when I first installed it. The fish are cute and keeps you entertained. I spend a decent amount of $$ so that I could purchase extras. At first it was fine but then it seemed you couldn't get far without continuing to do so. Unfortunately when I changed phones, my progress did not come with me. Although I read there was a way to do so and I contacted the dev, I was still unable to transfer and have since gotten no response. Very disappointed.

Graphics is nice but the game is extremely hard. When you reach high levels its almost impossible to win without a bunch of powerups which you can only get by buying in app purchases. This is an expensive money grab colour matching game. Not recommended for casual players. Itll break your bank not unless youve got cash to burn. Stay out of this game. Too greedy.

I really do enjoy this game. It's fun and I love the puzzles. I'm kinda stuck. During the last Seasonal Game - Easter, you needed to acquire 3 stars, I only acquired 2. I'm currently in the USA fish bowl. I need one more star to move on to India fishbowl, but there is not opportunity available to gain another star. I still play because the puzzles are strategic.

Have been playing this game for some time. Now it will NOT bypass an update. When I go to update, it just "sits and spin". Will have to un- install and will probably lose all of my progress! Agree with another review, NO fish in tunnels like advertised NOR fish and sharks!!!!! Now almost 3 years later, they have updated the game and periodically you get a puzzle game pop up to win 3 diamonds and coins. These now have the animated fish that was originally advertised years ago. Nice Fix!!!

You have to have gems to play the game but you rarely get them. You must PURCHASE THEM. You need to award more gems as prizes. Also, if you don't finish a game, a message about continuing covers the game. You can't see the board to decide if 5 more turns is a good decision. In some cases 20 wouldn't be enough, but without seeing your position, you just have to guess what to do. Those 2 things make the game frustrating. Correct them and the game could be 5 stars.

This game is rigged for you to spend!! It's starts of easy and has some good challenge to it but the higher you get the more impossible it is. Certain levels are impossible to beat with the moves you get given. So then you purchase gems etc to get extra moves and then it still doesn't let you win. If you give it a break for a while and come back it sometimes lets you pass. Reminds me of pokies- luck side of things. Lives take for ever to replenish, 1 every 25 or 30 mins.

My favorite game! It's fun, interactive, challenging, but not so much so that you get stuck forever on a level. There are many diversions, like collecting pearls for a while, or competing in tournaments to earn ranks and prizes that help you win levels. Decorating the aquariums is fun, and they have holiday themed items to earn. So, it has a little bit of everything. Animation art is well done. Get this game! ;)

The ad is misleading (Im around level 33 and only played 2 save the fish). If you are not willing to pay REAL money you will get stuck in levels forever. I'm out of diamonds and low on coins, so I cannot get extras moves. I've played this level over 30 times (and there is no chance to pass it unless you have extra boosters or extras moves). Not fun at all to be certain you cannot pass a level unless you pay money. I'd rather be given a choice to watch ads to get more moves. Super frustrating.

I've been playing this game for over a year but now uninstalling. I don't mind spending a few bucks playing a game but I've wasted quite a bit of time and money on this. It's turned into a pos pay to win game and that takes the fun out of it. Sometimes you can play the same level 100 times losing and then spend a few bucks and win. This game basically cheats and not worth the time to install. Even if you do or don't spend a little money playing games there's plenty of way more entertaining ones.

Pros: The fish are friendly, and the aquariums have some really cool things to put in them. The mini games are fun at milestone levels as well. Cons: BEWARE: While you may start out with powerups and fancy things, once those are gone, it's pretty much over. The game then shifts into pay to play mode. Be prepared to wait 30 minutes just for 1 life to refill. Overall: 2/5. These types of games all have the same formula to get your money. Like casinos, they give you a carrot before striking.

The ad is very misleading, the game is about playing a candy crush type thing to gain coins and buy fish or objects for the aquarium. You do play the game advertised but only when theres a mini game and after a little while it gets harder and harder to receive them. It's an ok game I guess I just wish the ad wasnt so misleading about it.

Was fun to start but after 200 levels it stalls out. Constant bombardment of tournaments. Can't beat levels unless you buy upgrades. The hard and super hard levels are just ridiculous and not enjoyable at all (unless you buy special upgrades) Can't build your aquariums cuz you can't beat levels. They advertise mini games. 200 plus levels in and only saw 4 mini games (which btw are what you see in the ads). Basically, pretty boring, will uninstall due to lack of enjoyment and interest.

negative review if I could. for about three or so years I've played and enjoyed this game until yesterday. I was on a team that regularly chatted and played well together for the weekly competition getting trophies and it was fun. yesterday, the cost of the season pass increased, the pass made getting prizes and rewards fun and the bonuses changed, now no double bombs, no dynamite/lightning combos anymore. no reason for the change, no warning. lost me and about 10 of the team I played on.

I'm sure this game is fine for a child who is learning how to count but for anyone else it's really just an insult to their intelligence. Also, as usual it's just another money grab. It starts easy but then it gets harder and harder to the point that you have to purchase - making it the usual pay-to-win gaming model that so many games these days follow.

Its not the type of game I was expecting. AGAIN the advertisement of the does not match the game at all. Watch the advertisement then play the game if you do not understand. The ad shows you moving obstacles in order for the fish to pass thru or die. Thats the game I wanted to play. The one Im playing is boring to be honest. Im uninstalling and I wont be downloading any more games from this makers ads. Im not happy about my time being wasted because of false advertising.

Great fun with challenging puzzles. Timed puzzles are a tad bit unrealistic to complete in the allotted time. Usually requires several purchases of diamonds or extra bombs and the like. On level 325 and have yet to come across any of the puzzles that are shown in the advertisements of the game - puzzles where the player chooses paths to save a fish. When do they come into play? Still, the bloody little game has held my attention with new game elements sprinkled in here and there.

I do enjoy match games and the fish are cute, however, I had stopped playing for a while because the levels were getting unbeatable without using specials. I came back and it freezes when I go to look at my other aquariums, the levels are still ridiculous and I will probably stop playing again. and in a couple months come back again. it's akin to being stuck in a toxic relationship

The stupid hints that I couldn't turn off are the reason I deleted this game. I'm guessing the game is meant for younger children. It was most annoying that you can't do anything on a new level without the game wanting to guide you through the first five moves. THAT'S SO ANNOYING! You should think about giving the player the option to turn your stupid hints OFF! Also, the whole reason I downloaded the game is for the puzzles. This game is just like Candy Crush for the most part.

The game is pretty fun. I like the fish and accessories you can get for the aquariums and the side events and mini games are fun. However, it's mostly a match 3 puzzle game, which I didn't realize because the preview for the game isn't that. It is almost like false advertising. The game they show is actually one of the mini games that hardly comes up. I thought I was downloading one game but got another. It's still fun though.

Level 4456 i had one of the little stone faces ( or whatever it is) left. After getting all the crabs. It was saying 1 left. I played the extra bought chances 4 times. It used up over 100 bought purple gems; which no game ever should. I did the double triangles 5 times, which clears everything, and it was still wanting more credit. I never paid for a game until this pandemic beginning last year. I enjoyed this game so made it my 'treat'. It has become an expensive habit,not worth it any more

utterly frustrating. I've been playing the same level for 4 days and it carefully arranges the colors to be impossible to win. i've tried using the power up pieces and it still carefully and seemingly deliberately puts things where they either cant help or deliberately hinder your ability to finish. when there are 50 choices of where to put something and the game puts it consistently on the spots which ruin good moves, thats not luck. thats programming. i dont need this frustration. downgrading.

Fishdom is fun and super addictive! I love the fish and their expressions, the colorful aquarium environments and the ability to purchase plants and decorations with my winnings. The Aqua Tasks add another level of challenges, plus give you boosters. I don't have much use for the voucher process, though. It takes so long to get the right combinations. Overall, though, one of my favorite games.

This game has many issues that just hard to ignore. Waiting 30 minutes for a new life. Sucks as you wait 2.5 hours for 5 lives but they are gone in 6 minutes. So hard to pass some stages and wasted a day trying to pass just 1 lvl. Like lvl 324 which is super hard. Took me a day and a half to finally beat it without spending money. Not wasting my money here.

Since I stopped paying for so many months, I find the game is so frustrating because there are mainly hard and extremely hard games but at least I am saving money!!!! Finally we are receiving some worthwhile prizes. Big bucks will keep me interested for a while longer. More incentive is feedback for more play.

This game has a lot of potential, but I'm truly disappointed and got extremely frustrated. It looks like the game is trying to get me to pay money to win and continue playing. It's not even about skills, just pure luck or more boosters. Some levels are physically impossible to win. I got permanently stuck on level 409 and a couple of levels before for days. It got ridiculously hard and not fun anymore. What's more disappointing is that I see so many similar reviews and no change at all.

Very fun. I found this game on accident, but it's addicting so I kept it. The only bad part is that it takes forever to get diamonds so it makes me not want to play. There should be videos we could watch to get diamonds, or other challenges we can do to get diamonds. UPDATE!:: This game is still so fun,even years after,and now you HAVE added other ways to get diamonds!! Perfect!

I have played this game for several years with no glitches. In the past several days or will not load. I get the "loading" screen but it just sits there showing me the tips below the loading line. Never progressed beyond that. I have tried everything I can think of. Would like to re each the developers, but can't find a way to do so. If the game wasn't stalling on me I would rate it 5 . I really dont want to delete it. :(

Having bunches of fun. It had a few glitches, but they are fixed. And through it all, the team stayed in touch to let me know what was happening! Cool! Go team! Ya got a good game here. That was then, this is now; I started playing after years off. Now I build up diamonds so they offered me a "fish bank" to put them in. It cost 30 diamonds. I pay the 30 diamonds and it gives me a note saying that if I want the fish bank it costs $2,50 (or 3 or whatever.) I don't like lies.

The fish math game is pretty non-existent. I had 3 levels of that, which were very simplistic, and then played for a couple of weeks and never saw another one. Basically, it's a candy-crush style game with an additional matching game built in designed to get you to use money to buy power-ups. Since I don't spend money on phone games, I am not the target demographic.

It used to be great but if you aren't willing to spend money then expect to be frustrated. It's gotten almost impossible to get past levels without the use of several boosters and sometimes even then they don't help. I don't play it as much anymore because I get tired of getting stuck on levels for days only to get excited for beating it to have it happen again. Then all the bonus games, how much it takes to complete a tank, and blue bolts Diego needs for adventures are excessive & ridiculous.

Lots of games have in app purchases for boosters and extra lives. I've always been able to play them without purchase. Not this one. Levels are too difficult. Took 20+ tries to beat. Now I've reached one I've tried at least 50 times and can't beat it. Not spending money on virtual nonsense. I tried deleting to start over. Started me back where I was. You have it fixed to pay money or else!! No thanks

This is a great match 3 game. BUT! The ads for this game and ALL other "puzzle" games from this company are misleading. The ads are what make us want to play because solving the puzzles is so appealing. BUT WHEN THEY'VE REELED YOU IN... ITS JUST A MATCH 3 GAME! I'm so disappointed. The ads are tantamount to false advertising. Get my hopes up and then BOOM! Crushed. Smh.😪

Played it for a few days, the puzzle gameplay is pretty much the same as a PC game I used to play, but after 50 levels or so it seems much less punitive. The cartoon fish are cute, and the aquarium building aspects are well done. It feels like it is probably getting more money from optional collectibles than game mechanics stuff which is good for a person like myself who can't really afford pay to play. So far it is definitely better than I had expected going in.

It is a good game but you have to spend money to get diamonds to level up if you don't break all the squares, there should be more bonuses. The games get harder, you have 28 moves and 102 squares to break. You can't win so if you want to continue you have to spend more money to get diamonds to continue. This game is a money-grabber and this takes The fun out of it.

I've been playing this game for probably 7 years and by far it's absolutely my favorite game but I can't help but notice that the moves have become less and less, 11 moves on a hard level, so of course you're gonna run out quickly and have no choice but to use gems, which cost money! Please don't become greedy like other games, I can guarantee you'll lose players, just be fair, I think I'm speaking for everyone....

Not what I expected. The ads look like it's a game where your fish eats other fishes but I rarely have those mini-games show up. It's basically Candy Crush with a little different theme. I hate Candy Crush. Stopped at level 728, too many hard & super hard levels. Don't want to play the same level for days. More frustrating than fun. I'm done.

Unfortunately, I hate to actually say this - like many others have stated after level 33 it becomes difficult to the point you're having to replay the level but that still gets you no where. It does become necessary to purchase more tools (if you must) to complete the level. I thought what others had said was just simply false because they probably weren't utilizing the methods of obtaining the tools in the first place but, no. I want to add the chances it gives too is not enough.

Clickbait app. This is a basic tile swap puzzle game, by heating levels you can decorate an aquarium. Occassionally a "puzzle" level pops up that looks like one of their many clickbait ads but these are rare. I got to play the minigame in the ad once and havent seen it again in over an hour. The game is cute but since they use clickbait ads I'm lowering my rating.

I have been playing fishdom for years. Must say it's been my favorite game for a long time. I am not happy with the developer lately. No more mini games, very disappointing, and the monthly challenges have now turned into 2 weeks for the same price. Seriously, are you that greedy!! Also, challenge levels, 1chance or you lose all shell power ups. More gimmicks!! It seems that the developers are finding more ways to cost us money to play this "free" game or at least participate in events.

I have been playing this game on and off for years. Over the last 6 months or so the game has become a money grab. Levels are increasingly difficult to beat regardless of their, supposed, difficulty level. The side games are seemingly impossible to beat unless you spend money on boosters or gem bundles to bypass the outlandish tasks. Not nearly as enjoyable as it used to be.

Many levels are over exaggeratedly hard and then suddenly after so many tries you oddly beat it quick and easy. It seems very rigged to get you to spend money, however there is an issue with purchasing extra credits. So, for myself, the push to get you to buy credits is in vain. It makes playing the game seem pointless and not at all like a guineuine game. However, for the most part it is a fun little game and the aquarium is fun to decorate.

Fun game. Very addictive. However, the higher the levels you climb, they become so difficult that it takes way longer and many more lives/gems to beat them. More frequent hard & super hard levels. The mini dory fish games are extremely rare now. I think I've seen just one in the past few months. This makes me feel financially ripped off by the game. I've paid way too much money to overcome the levels, and feel cheated by the lack of mini-dory games that are rewarded.

Totally a pay to win game. For a puzzle genre game, it has a fun concept, but the levels eventually become unbeatable without constantly using power ups. At that point the game is no longer fun. The entire point of puzzle games is to beat puzzles with your mind rather than depending on R.N.G.sus and power ups. That's why I'm giving this one star.

I don't normally love games from the play store, but Fishdom actually is an awesome game all around. I haven't had to deal with one pop up ad at all in the last month of playing it, and I enjoy the levels and minigames and the endless amount of fish and aquarium decor in the store. The only thing I find tiring is waiting for the game to load when I first open it up, but it's a small price to pay for a great game. Good job developers!

The game itself is good. But I want to play the game not have to constantly click where it tells me to click before I can continue my game each time you add something. The process is always the same. What is the point in giving a tutorial each time just because it's a different scene or fish that wants you to do the same thing you've been doing each time! I'm on level 314 I think I know how to play. Stop the tutorials or give us an option to turn them off in the settings and I'll give 5 stars.

Has spiraled downward past year... nothing left other than the graphics, which have actually improved. If you haven't got hooked into investing...quit while you can, or better yet, don't start. There are no mini games, never were first two years I played. Out of nowhere they were there and then gone again. Has turned into a Story game, like Homescapes, instead of decorating and collecting aquariums, like it used to be.

If you're downloading this app because of these cool ads they project on other games, DON'T BOTHER. The levels that have the little fish eventually devouring the big fish are very few and far between. It's mainly another insipid "match three" game coupled with a knockoff "bone-us" round of "pull the pin". Powerups you are forced to purchase "the first time" as a demo? GTFO! Uninstalling!

Update 3: I don't need to play through the tutorial every season. I should be able to skip that and just play through. This is the same problem as in my last review only 4 years later (can't skip through unnecessary animation) UPDATE 2: the animation has gotten ridiculously long and you can't skip any of it. I don't care about your Valentine's day animation and talking to the turtle or any of the other added stuff. I just want to play the levels

This game cheats you, very frustrating. Certain moves, don't do what they are designed to do, when using other tools. Or it lets one win help, that doesn't allow one to make a move; one was about to make. Or when one wins an hour or longer of endless life, but one can not reserve it for a later time. I call BS...... and no, I'm not referring to biblical studies.

UPDATE: Continues to be INCREDIBLY FRUSTRATING it takes so long to 'fill' up a tank and to top it off with crappy stupid stuff that looks horrible and hides the beautiful fish!! Please fix this!! So incredibly frustrating that you have to fill up your fish tank with incredibly stupid items that usually make no sense whatsoever then you can't even see your fish. Why bother buying fish if that's the case.

Not as advertised. I repeatedly saw ads for this game showing gameplay. I took a chance and when it was played it was a candy crush clone and not even close to the ads. I did play many levels to see if the gameplay changed but it stuck to matching type game with variables. I deleted the game and after some research ,many games from this publisher false advertise.

I like fish. They are very colorful. You can build any kind of tank, but don't forget to feed all the beautiful fish you can purchase when you buy them with your coins you get for playing each game. They are like a real fish tank at home. The fish you are so unique, and they even talk to you, you can buy figurines for the tank's. Each tank is a different place, so many different things you buy for fish. You will enjoy the game. I really like how you made the electrofying the icons all raise up.

Game is fun. But customer service isn't great. Had trouble with progress after switching device. They helped. Then it had issues connecting, so it said to reinstall again. I did that, but game progress was lost. Apparently they can only help you once. What the heck? Their article told me to do that when restarting the phone didn't work. Do better.

Up until recently the game has been fantastic. I've been playing for a long time now and it's the only game I ever actually paid for. The gold pass cost money but you could enjoy it for a month where as the recent update has changed so the gold pass only runs for a week or so and cost the same amount of money. I now refuse to spend money on the game as it's just too much to ask of people. So disappointing.

I like this game. However, I find it a bit disturbing that I lose a particular session over and over again until suddenly everything lines up and I win. It seems to me that I win easily when I have purchased a lot of diamonds. Also, I don't like some of the new "specials" they have. I miss the old ones. Update - August 2020. I still am amazed at how I lose over and over again in certain sessions but then will suddenly win. I like the new "seasons" where you can earn boosters, etc.

Fun game... BUT the new gold pass is ridiculous. It was great before, $4.99 gave you tons of bonuses and it was good for around a month or so, making it possible to finish. Now it's still $4.99 and not only are the bonuses nowhere near what they were before, but they give you so much less time (6 days for the same price as when it was a month!) so unless you have no life or responsibilities, and just sit around playing Fishdom 24/7, it's unlikely that you'll finish. So disappointing!

If you are downloading the after seing the ads, i must tell you that you are going to be utterly disappointed. Its the same old school colour matching game. Or in other words some upgraded version of candy crush with some interesting mini game as shown in the ads, which you will get to play only after 5-6 level. Very disappointed with such misleading ads.

Addictive, deceptive, expensive. I wanted to play the strategy games IN THE ADVERTISING but never got to that point. I spent SIXTY FREAKIN DOLLARS on items to help pass levels, etc, and still never reached the place where I could play the part I actually wanted. This game is a total rip off and I'm livid that I JUST wanted to play the game in the advertising, but no. It was one of those asinine candy crush types where you match stuff. Not a fan anymore.

This game and the other 2 like it are not as advertised. In the advertisement the fish is being chased by a shark and you have to choose 1 of 3 options of defense to get away. That game seems fun and exciting. But the only difference between this game and candy crush is the theme and I don't want to play either. The advertisement is clearly a trap

I've been playing this game for a long time now and always gave it 5 stars. Didn't mind spending money on season passes or extra power ups etc, because it was worth it, but lately the game has changed. It's become much more difficult to beat levels even using multiple power ups. Why buy extra power ups only to use them all on one level! (even the levels not labeled "hard") Making the game that much more difficult does NOT make someone spend more money, but less since it isn't as worth it!

The ad is kinda misleading. It's just a regular match 3 game. I usually didn't enjoy playing match 3 game, but this game is quite fun because it has many events. Also you got to decorate aquariums with nice graphics. The levels are sometimes seemed impossible to beat. Overall, just like a normal match 3 game, it's all fun until you got stuck in a super hard level.

Ok so I love fishdom... ALOT... NOT A FREE GAME. NONEXISTENT SUPPORT/CUSTOMER SERVICE. It really is sad to give only 1 star - started playing last year and it was a lot of fun until about 6 months ago. This game is supposedly free, but the only way to be able to clear more than a few levels a week you'll need to buy A LOT of in-game purchases. The graphics are great, but it's just not worth the aggravation. There's a difference between "challenging" and just frustrating - and when it takes 3-6 days with 75-300 tries to clear a level, it's not challenging, it's frustrating. I left the team I was on because of needing to make purchases to clear levels - it hurts a team in competitions if you're not clearing levels. I formed another team eventually. My newbie players were giving up within the first 100-200 levels because of getting stuck on a level so frequently, so being up in the "halfway" range of 4000-5000 had nothing to do with being stuck. They launch "seasons" and offer season passes (which used to be a good deal, but doesn't really help you anymore) but then if you look at FB a lot of people aren't even getting the seasons or their season passes after paying for them in the last two launches. Most recently, I completed a star in one my tanks and got NO reward. I checked all of my tanks and they were fine. I checked the help topics and followed their steps - which included if everything was as it should be to contact Support. I did that and it took 5 days to hear back - and they told me to do the steps I had already done with the help topic for not receiving a reward. I had already sent screenshots showing that everything was complete, so I sent screenshots again, along with a screenshot of their own help topic instructions. The Support person had said I didn't need to check each individual aquarium, but their own help topic said the recent update had resulted in some decrease in beauty points and to not rely on the screen showing groups of tanks but to check each individual aquarium. So I did all that again, and sent screenshots. I sent screenshots of my open tanks showing it was saying I should get rewards if earned the next star. It's been a couple days and haven't heard anything, so it's been a week total. I looked at the FB page and a lot of people are having issues and saying the response if they were lucky enough to get one is the usual "there's nothing we can do". This seems to be the response for everything. Some of these people are asking about things that cost them cold hard cash. Even contacting support is an ordeal, because sometimes you can't get past the automated "bubblebot". Swim away from this game, swim away as fast as you can.

Game is great fun and has not given any hassle. New features added every so often. Would be nice to be able to confirm continued play - sometimes pressing that button was a mistake! The tanks are fun. Fish are cute. The puzzles can take tons of "try agains" and then wait for more lives or you have to spend money to get ways to buy lives and powerups to beat levels. Love it but sometimes get irritated at some levels, keeps you addicted though. I changed from 4 to 1 star because the game has gotten very difficult to beat. Just started playing and I'm already hooked. Loads of fun. A real challenge. I like the game but you shouldn't be demoted because you don't beat levels. That's irritating. I hate it when they pull a BAIT AND SWITCH. HORRIBLE Game... it is nice visually and the puzzles are challenging but many of them are created to do nothing but get you to spend money. OK... I get it. Great way to pass time while also challenging yourself. The game seemed childish at first with the graphics, but the puzzles are definitely for adults as well. Great little game, just wish the timer would stop when the lightning comes out or the pieces are changing colors, shorten the time to renew lives, and at the end, no need to explode all of the leftover bombs (it takes forever sometimes!) nothing like the ad i found it from. instead, it's like candy crush with mini games between levels. honestly, it's too many games in one. also, it doesn't let you learn the game as you go but rather, it practically forces instructions every few seconds. with that being said, its not all together terrible and would be pretty enjoyable if it weren't so annoying.

You developers totally ruined the game. Text too small for visually impaired and no accessability. Fun game but not as advertised. They've removed the annoying ads most have, but just force you to purchase power ups instead. Pick your poison. There's a difference between a challenge and forcing you to buy power ups.

Downloaded cause of the ads In reality, they don't show you the actual game. They show you a mini game that you only ger every 10 or so levels. So I was introduced to this game from an offer wall, and actually liked the game. Puzzles aren't extremely bad and cute aquariums/themes. Good game, addictive but lives take to long to renew and as you get to higher levels it becomes almost impossible to complete. This is probably my favorite game. That being said, "Play on" sucks. There is no longer any way to turn it off. Good game, expensive though. It had been improving through contests but then they cut moves by a third to a half....saying they had complaints the game was too easy!!!!! I don't usually play games but I love this one so many levels.. I love this game, its very challenging. The only thing I don't like is that your aquariums end up way overcrowded with stuff before you can move to the next aquarium. I hate false advertising. All the ads show a variety of types of games. But it's mostly a match-3 game where every once in a while a mini-game comes up that looks like the ads. The overall gameplay is fun and rewarding. But after getting to higher levels - i have come to realize that the levels are not even skill based. the game is another money making scheme like every other game. very expensive compared to what your paying for.
