I expected, and was excited about, a strategy/puzzle game and ended up with a 'tile matching' snoozefest, with the aim of buying and feeding fish. It's pretty by design and will appeal to people looking for that type of challenge but, for me personally, it was a big disappointment.

It's a fun game at first but the more and more super hard levels impossible to get past without using everything you've got, even if I use boosters it STILL won't let me get past the super stupidly hard levels, it won't give you any colors together so you can create bombs, you have to use ALL OF YOUR BOOSTERS and then pay out ALL OF YOUR GEMS and then buy extra moves and use ALL of the extra switch moves..ect. I've played a lot of games, this one quickly gets to a frustrating unattainable point.

Enjoyed the game initially. Even enjoyed the harder challenges,but then I got stuck at a level that I've not been able to clear after numerous attempts. I can see that only boosters will help me with this. Great fun game though, until you run into this wall of no progression. Also, the adverts for this game is very little part if it. So i felt a bit clickbaited.

There's good and bad. Love the talking fish. Like being able to acquire diamonds and power-ups without purchasing all of the time. Some levels are VERY difficult to win without power-ups though and you waste your power ups trying to beat one level. And it always seems like you lose by one so you'd have to buy diamonds. Sometimes it can be a more frustrating than fun which seems to be happening more often than not. I ended up taking a break for a while because of it.

I constantly have to update. It's not working/won't install update. Now i can't play. Totally annoying!!! There's no point in rating a game i can't access and no point in advancing through all the levels, decorating all one's tanks, accumulating all the points just to be locked out of the game due to the constant updates. If you are playing on a phone: BEWARE!!! Playrix games are a total waste of time. I have an unlimited data plan and still can't update w/o deleting basic apps i use everyday.

The games shown in the ads are just mini games, and they're too easy to win when they do come up in the rotation of mini games. (Mixed with super simple pull-the-pin minigames.) The main game is nothing more than a simple match 3 game, easy to win at first. It quickly devolves into the same trick: reduce the total moves available so that you eat up your boosters to get through them. Never got hard at all, while I was playing, but I could easily see the trend. Quickly deleted this trash.

Do not even start this game! The developer has made the game a money grab...used to be challenging, which was fun, but now it is infinitely harder and purely designed to force you to shell out $$$ constantly to stay in the game. I am sure they still make it easy at the beginning, to get u hooked then start the money grab later.

I hate the timed levels. I play them for several days before accidently winning. The level I am on now does not appear to be winnable so I may not be able to continue this otherwise enjoyable game. Another thing. It was falsely advertized. It showed fish being saved from all types of potential calamities. However, the actual game has nothing like that in it. I am very disappointed with it. I am adding to my review 2 weeks later. The timed levels still have not been elinated. Too much stress 4me

They reward you with gifts if you watch an ad, but sometimes they lock up the device and sometimes the reward is not given. Great graphics, lots of variety, the fish talk is awesome, need to reward a little better, more careful placement for in game help tools would be nice, you can do away with the timed screens- no need to add stress to an awesome game! A junior version for children would be great!

I enjoyed this game for years but over the past year, it seems rigged more and more to push spending money to pass levels. I don't mean level difficulties, but the fact that a level will go on for days during contests or whenever you've earned free play for a specific amount of time, even using boosters. Then the 1st time playing after the contest or free time limit is over, the level practically beats itself without you even trying. It's gotten more frustrating than entertaining.

It was great, but now that I've gotten over level 300, it's getting way too difficult and frustrating. I've started other games that have more options for those of us wanting LESS challenging and more relaxing games. Too bad because this was my 1st game and I've come to really love my aquariums, decorations and esp my fish. Maybe the developers can give some of us another route to go instead of harder....?????? Please...?

It's fun but it's obvious that bombs are placed in places that make them less beneficial when used. Would to be able to choose when to deploy bombs and dynamite if I choose to use them in a round. Other than that, fun game. Enjoy the challenge. Update: recently started playing again. Will uninstall again. Made the mistake of buying the fishy bank of diamonds. Now virtually every level requires me to use diamonds to complete. Very frustrating.

Game is a mix of match-three, aquarium building, and optional and pointless ad-puzzles. The ad-puzzles are as simple as they look, skippable, and pointless, as they yield no rewards, likely included just so they can claim no false advertising. The match-three is the main focus, and for what it is, it's fine. There are some serious design flaws, however, more that character limit allows. If you're looking for a match-three, look elsewhere. If the ads enticed you... look elsewhere anyway.

Advertisements for this game are misleading. I thought the game was about passing obstacles like the advertisements made it seem, but what was shown in the advertisements turned out to be a "mini game" that you barely get to play. The actual game is boring, but the graphics are great and the touch response is immaculate. So for that I give it 2 stars.

Ok so I was dissapointed at first that it wasn't the mini games as advertised, but then I had fun building the aquariums. But when I got up to higher levels it got the point that you couldn't really pass levels in a reasonable amount of time without spending money and that started getting frustrating and not fun anymore, even $5 to $10 a day adds up to alot in a month. So I did the right thing and deletet it, no more hard earned money down the drain.

Game always worked fine for years. However now every time I log in none of the game functions work. I click on the screen and all I get are ripples like when you chase the fish around. It doesn't seem to register any other on screen buttons at all. Like the aquarium, team, decorations or the gold pass buttons. I paid for the gold pass and now I can't make use of it. I deleted and reinstalled now. Doubt thatll fix it tho. From what I've read from others, they seem to have the same issue.

I like the game or I wouldn't play. But the captains games are impossible to complete. Too many hard, super hard, levels bunched together now. Ability to create full aquariums are greatly reduced because of extreme cost of items as you get higher in levels. Subsequently I have been becoming more and more dissatisfied. Love the fish though. Very peaceful. Need to state halloween event stinks. No way to beat enough levels to get any new decorations. Dropping rateing. Until the.extreme cost and or n

The ad is very misleading. Looks like a great game of problem solving to get a fish to safe. The shark and fish ad has played over and over in other apps for me and I finally decided to give it a try. Turns out to just be the same old game but aquatic form of matching tiles to earn stars and coins to make my aquarium "how I want it". Disappointed, thought I'd be getting a new experience. Should have read the other reviews first.

The ads this game are incredibly misleading. It was portrayed as a puzzle game, but it's nothing more than match-3. Very disappointing and frustrating that these games keep showing the game play as one thing and end up being completely different. This is common with playrix games. All the ads show the game play as getting the character through obstacles, but none of their games have this. What a scam.

It's fun at first but as soon as you get to higher levels it gets frustrating. In order to pass, you need to make lots of power ups and combo of the color power up, or lots of diamonds (have to spend real $) to continue playing after losing all moves. Majority of the levels are less than 15 moves and the tiles needs to be hit 1 up to 5 times. The last few hard, super hard, and challenge levels are next to impossible. Literally spend 1 hour or more on this levels with 1-3 hour life rewards i got.

All the advertisements I've seen for this game shows a fish trying to get away from a shark and you have to pick the right tool to help him get past obstacles excetera excetera. There's nothing like that in the game. It's all just the typical matching objects of the same color so that they disappear and new items drop. I played like 20 rounds and never got to anything similar to the ad. Uninstalled.

Not like the ads. The ads show mini games which is what I wanted to play. The game is actually building an aquarium (which was kind of fun) but the only games I actually got to play were the match 3 to clear the board games. They were frustrating sometimes. I got to level 62 and had never received a puzzle piece to play any mini games which what was advertised. Unistalled.

This game has progressively gotten worse and worse. Y'all have it rigged for the lighting to go away from each other, even though they are lined up to fall side by side to help clear the board. It's also hard to win more than 2 or 3 games in a row without using diamonds to keep going, so I must spend money to keep a streak going. It's so obvious when I can beat a hard level, or even a super hard level, and then run out of moves on a regular level. Even though I have power ups and extra moves.

I downloaded this game because of an ad in another game. In the ad, the fish swims through a tunnel/screen meeting obstacles and you select what the fish needs to get through the obstacle. When I downloaded it instead of that it's a matching game! This is the 3rd or 4th game I have downloaded that has been that way, and now I realize probably all made by the same people. (the advertisement shows a level/extra that is only a small fraction of the game instead of the actual game...)

Once again, like homescapes, game is nothing like the ad potrays it to be. The ad makes it look like you are going to have to pick solutions to get the people, or in this case fish, out of the situation they are in. It gives you 2 or 3 options to choose from to help the character. This game has nothing to do with that. Its a stupid candy crush type game where you just slide things around to make rows of 3 and 4. Completely stupid and not as portrayed in the ad.

Not as advertised. The game shows a lot of cute mini games but seems to default to the "pull the pin" type and even that is once in a great while. Many levels REQUIRE power ups to finish. Nothing at all like the Fishdom it used to be, no longer a relaxing aquarium but mostly a match 3 game. Got this primarily for the mini games and even bought some power ups. Feel like I wasted money. Very disappointed. Ad is NOT like the actual game. Probably will uninstall.

I, like many long term players am very disappointed with the changes made. The mini games have gone, there used to be fun extras like the bridge game and the collecting gold bars. Now we are stuck with the Atlantis Cup which was OK to begin with but is now boring. I used to buy crystals and other things but as the developers have now got really greedy I will no longer be buying!! Bring back the old format and stop repeating the levels.😡😡

Fishdom was absolutely the perfect game until this update on February 4, 2019. They have completely changed the graphics of the game pieces and now they look horrible and it makes the game unbelievably boring and infantile. Please bring back the original look of the game pieces. The new bubble pieces are too tiny and unrealistic looking. The best part of this game was that the original pieces, aquariums and fish were thr perfect animation, etc. BAD UPGRADE

Levels are designed to be so difficult that you purchase bonus's to be able to pass them. That makes playing the game boring because I refuse to buy bonus's just to play a game . Some of the levels are repetitive. I find myself less interested in playing anymore because it takes too long to pass the level...and I've been playing Fishdom for a very long time.

I loved this game for years and gave it 5 stars. However the last year or so they have reduced the number of turns on the levels compared to tutorials online of the same levels showing 10+ more turns than currently given, making it nearly impossible to pass levels without paying. Many of the players on our team have quit playing for this reason. I hope Playrix corrects thos or I won't be sticking around either.

Started playing this game not too long ago and it was fun for a bit. But now, with all the new updates, basically impossible to beat any levels or make any progress without using the resources. Basically it's become a money grab and wasn't worth any more time or consideration. There are better match-3 games out there that are more fun and get that combo of difficulty and interest correct, just not this one.

False advertising! Nothing like the Ad shown to help the fish out of obstacles. Do not download unless you like playing Candy Crush. Thats pretty much what this game is, Also the levels get hard to the point where if you'd like to continue you have to purchase $$ . The Only thing I enjoyed was the little fishes🐠 you buy with the coins you collect for your Aquarium they talk to you! But not cute enough for me to keep the game. It's pretty annoying that is NOT what was advertised! Uninstalling!!!

Not what the ads for it show. Like any other game anymore, the ad shows something completely different. The levels you play to earn coins are just like playing and gem/candy swapping game. Boring. I'd like to see a game where I actually had to solve the puzzles shown in the ad. Why not actually make the game you're promoting in your ads?! I already have and play candy crush, we don't need any more games like that!

Today I am having TROUBLE. I can open the app but once I get to the screen showing me inside a aquarium, if I try to tap on the food button, the store, to play a game, etc it wont do anything. I'm very confused because the game isnt exactly 100% frozen but I did restart my device, uninstall and reinstall the app, clear the cache on the game, and checked to see if my phone or the app needed to be updated and they both are up to date so I'm not sure what is going on. If ANYONE could help me out!

I love the fish and the game keeps you on your toes to find the right combinations to beat the level. I really like this game and app! Recently I have had extreme difficulty with the updates. It takes up to 3 days to"update" and then only when I contact the developers does it actually update. By then I have missed out on timed activities. Not happy with the the update issue.

Disappointing. Downloaded it because if the minigames constantly advertised in other apps. No minigames, only matching. Game is RIGGED! You have to pay to win! You lose rewards and benefits you collected in a level if you don't buy more moves to finish it. Moves per level are limited, not good for a match 3 game. Not very rewarding for the effort. Not worth the money. Already spent $20 in just few days playing, want my money back. Unsatisfying!

The first 30 levels are pretty easy and they get progressively harder. You have to buy bombs to beat some levels, unless you play it over and over until lives run out, then wait 30 minutes for a new life. It was a let down to know that eventually it just let's you win if you play the same level constantly. It's obvious when you get 16 bombs in one level when you've gotten 0 the previous attempts. Still a good time killer though.

For the most part this is a fun & relaxing game. But after 3 or 4 'fun' games you'll then get a 'Super Hard or Timed game that will easily use up your 5 lives. If you're trying to make a quota of, say, so many pearls collected within a certain amount of time, you realistically might not make it. Same goes for trying to get a desired tank decoration or fish within a certain amount of time. The graphics are great, though. I'll play this game a little more but then I plan on finding something more fun & relaxing. I can deal with Super Hard games but really HATE Timed games!

The "save the fish" mini games shown in the ads are very rare, so I wouldn't recommend installing this if that's what brought you here. The match 3 / bejeweled levels and tank designing are fun and addictive. You can get far without spending real money, but it takes patience and luck, so there are lots of enticing offers to help you bet levels if you're willing to pay. Each update seems to reset my notification preferences, so I'm uninstalling to prevent it from waking me up again.

The game play showed in the adds wasn't what I actually experienced and what I got was basically underwater themed candy crush. That's not what I wanted, the game itself seems fine if you are good with spending money. For instance you can collect special jewels but they go in a piggy bank you have to pay to open. Graphics are good and it never crashed on me.

Just deleted. Played it for a long time. Completed all of the levels and was on the Atlantis Cup. Enjoyed it but it became utterly ridiculous. I'd get the gokd pass. But now absolute money grab. Levels set up that are impossible to get by without spending money. I don't mind paying some but the game has become a joke. They obviously don't read the reviews or are making enough money not to care. The Challenge levels with 7 moves? Yeah, sure that's beatable. Don't waste your time or money.

The lower levels are pretty fun, but then you need to buy power-up to just even play; it goes from just the right amount of challenge to virtually impossible with paying to play; some paying is okay, but this is ludicrous. It doesn't help that if you ask for clues on how to solve the levels you get, "Buy the golden pass"; if the only way to get past a level is to pay for the privilege or wait for the dailies, then it's just not a game worth playing.

A couple days ago, the game started freezing as soon as enough bombs are used to make a lightening bolt. I tried deleting & re-installing the game several times as well as re-starting my device multiple times. I love this game, have been playing for months & have spent a lot of money on it. I reached out to customer service via rhe game but the 'contact us' interface was limited. There are no other options to contact customer service!! Grrrrrrrrrrr. Please correct the issue asap!

Changing my review. There are far too many hard and super hard levels that you get stuck on and use your 5 lives over multiple times. I am now stuck on 902. giving up. Sick of the same stages over and over and getting nothing or progressing. It takes the fun out of the game. Hate that you can't replay the older and easier levels. Wonder if the fish die without being fed? Looks like we're gonna find out.

Losing all the coins, levels, tanks, decorations etc. that you work for just because two people in the same household, on two separate devices, can't play the same game, separately or even at the same time It reloads the game even after telling it not to. We have been trying to get these issues corrected for months to no avail. This is ridiculous!!

You'll enjoy it at first but when you get to higher levels, they take entirely too long to open/unlock new aquariums. Update: This game has become too focused on making money. They've made it dern near impossible to advance without spending money. There are games that are just as fun (if not more) and cost nothing. (Yet another update): I've uninstalled this game. It takes days to pass one level unless you pay for "boosters" or extra "gems". Absolute frustration. Not worth it.

This game used to be really fun and I loved decorating the tanks. But after the update, they're just greedy for $$. The gold pass was $4.99 for the month and the tasks were fun and I purchased the pass every month, but now it's only 6 days and you have to beat levels to win?!! When you get 3 to 4 hard/super hard levels to one 'normal' level, which are even getting harder, it's not fun! And they've cut the level move counter sometimes in half on lvls, such BS! Not worth spending any money on now!

Misleading Advertisement The Game is okay to play and the control seems to be fun. But the main reason of this negative feedback is that the advert which is shows is completely misleading. As there is no such puzzles in the game. Even after playing 10 levels, I didn't get any puzzles as advertised. Then while reading the reviews, found out that people had played 400+ level but still they haven't found the content show in the advert. Please include some levels as shown in the advert.

I initially downloaded the game based on an ad I saw in another game, I was a little disappointed because it wasn't what I expected. (The ad showed different gameplay) But the game is surprisingly addictive. The team, and chat features need to be upgraded, And they make it hard to play for free, not going to lie I've spent money on it :) I think it's a cool game but it could be better. Still not a bad way to waste some time.

False advertising!!! Terrible. To many "superhard" levels that force you to use all your powerups and I've beaten over 100 levels and have yet to see anything comparable to the ad I was shown that made me want to download the game in the first place. It displays these "save the mermaid" puzzle games in the ads that look totally fun and its NOTHING but a cheap rip-off of candy crush that wants you to spend more money. At least on Candy Crush, the powerups allow you to beat levels. . .

I really enjoy the game play. But after a short while it gets to where it's impossible to beat levels without purchasing gems,boosters,etc. Then you run out of lives, in turn you must purchase more 💎. I don't mind paying for a game. Everyone had to make money, nothing comes free. But $15.99 package doesn't go far at all. Most games are 4.99-10.99 And they are long term beneficial. I could spend $50 one time and play a game on almost any console, for as long as I want.

Very irrelevant to the teaser ads, little bit disappointed. I just want to say the actual graphics on this game are great. But the ads that draw people to this game are nothing short but awful. So basically on the ads, you try to save the fish from suffocating from being out of the water. But instead you get one of those 3 match puzzle games. What a letdown. So at the bottom line, don't listen to those teaser ads at all costs. They are very irrelevant to actual game and not worth of your time.

Not a fan. The gameplay isn't really snappy I feel like for every movement there's a slight delay that adds up overtime and makes the overall game drag. The game story itself has so much going on at the same time like different events, the levels, side mini games, decorating the fish bowls, buying fish/decor. There's so much going on that every time I log on i get like 5 different pop ups taking over the screen forcing me to go along even though I may just want to play a quick round.

Misleading - the ad is not like the game at all. The game wanted me to "fill an aquarium" instead of giving me puzzles to save a fish. It's just like Homescapes, which I got because it looked like you can set everything on fire, etc., but in reality you just pick rug and furniture colors very very very slowly (the game gives you a long boring story and never gets to the point).

Game is nothing like what is shown in ads. It's not a bad game, but the advertisements always show a different type of game. It's an aquatic version of Candy Crush. It's a fun game, but as others have mentioned... if you want to keep advancing, you're going to have to spend $$$. Uninstalled after 1st day. 1 star for misleading ads and "required" purchases.

This game used to be more fun- I've noticed what everyone seems to have noticed, that you used to get more moves a year or two ago for levels. I've been stuck on one that used to give you 20+ moves, now you get 12. I don't mind paying to play, but when I use everything I bought to try to pass a level it's not fun anymore. I feel like this is a cash grab to make you buy more to beat levels. I will say their customer service is great with any issues. I upped from 2 to 3 stars for that.

Love this game!!!!... However... It's seriously loosing my support. I tried emailing through the store, but got a... that email is no longer being monitored, contact us through the app... ... I don't know about anyone else, but I can't open the app, because it has been saying...New Update Available. It has been trying to get the update for days. The level I have been stuck on, seems to be designed for you to buy and waste resources, and not skill nor challenge.

I was lured to this game by an ad in another game. The game advertised is not the actual game, but a mini-game. As you move higher in levels, the mini games become few and far between. I did become addicted and used to love this game, but the developers have gotten too greedy. It's become a pay to play game. If they added back the original number of moves to each level, that would be a great start. Also, let players watch ads to get boosters to get past difficult levels.

Kind of fun, but way too expensive to move forward. I joined this summer, but quit because I noticed profit trickery. There do seem to be entraptment techniques in the gameplay that trick a player into going further & spending more. One thing, on higher levels (1000+), it becomes seemingly impossible for someone to succeed without buying tools & weapons. Many folks find themselves spending up to 100's of dollars (monthly) or more on games like these. I recommend Chuzzle 2 as an alternative.

Uninstalled as the decorations are too expensive and it's taking way too long to advance. It was fun before, but last time I updated, the match would sometimes go the opposite way. That being said, I bought every decoration I can for the dragon level and I still have to get a ton of decorations to advance. I was excited about the Alice and wonderland Wizard of Oz level but as I have been so stuck and the decor is so expensive, it has made the game boring.

Fantastic game, but the latest update (Jan 2019) has ruined the look of the game board - bad decision. The move of the boosters to the right hand side of the screen was an even worse decision, as I keep accidentally using them when my hand brushes against them. A good addition would be a marker next to items indicating that they have been purchased.

I have played this game for a couple of years now, and am very high on levels. I really enjoy it, but not giving 5 stars because there are a few issues I dislike. There is no bug filing, and many times the power ups don't work as expected. Plus, since I am so high leveled, I have to do this Treasures and after completing boards there is no aqua splash and I don't even get coins for completing the boards. Developers, where can I file bugs so these issues can be looked at?

I feel misled. The ads made it look like an escape game. It's not. It's a switch the pieces game like candy crush and others. It has the added task of making you set up a fishbowl with winnings. The escape is a bonus game that pops up randomly. I've seen it 4 times the whole time and haven't seen it in days. I just want what in the ads. I didn't see any of what I am doing in the ads. Gardenscape is the same except fix a garden not a fishbowl. I bet homescape is the same too. Same developer.

Super fun! Lots of play and levels, no ads, colourful, fun. I like the constant competitions and chances to win prizes. The animations between games feel tedious to me. I'd like the puzzles to just start, without having to see a fish wink at me hundreds of times. Also, I'd like to be able to chose when I claim the reward of unlimited play. I often get it, when I'm just taking a five minute break and can't enjoy it. These are just suggestions, not complaints. The game is great!

I love this game but many of the levels are almost impossible unless you play them 50+ times, use all your bombs and just happen to get a good bomb at the 51st attempt. Kind of disappointed about this. Since the latest update, hard and super hard levels are impossible to complete. Level 4100 is unbeatable, I have failed over 60 times. Instead of the relaxing game, it has become a source of tremendous frustration. So much so, I am seriously considering uninstalling the game!

At first it was quite interesting and addictive as the stages kept opening up. But now it is as though it is made intentionally difficult so you don't finish the game and honestly it's getting annoying. Not like I don't like a good ol challenge but it's getting ridiculously hard and boring as you keep trying to pass a particular stage for hours and then you have to spend money to buy extra lives and stuff. Seems like a market strategy and it has gotten me tired.

Your last update was what kept me as a player! I was frustrated and about to delete the game when you started the task list. What a difference! I'm now able to play longer and earn items to help in the game. Smart move on your part. I'm now a loyal customer. p.s. I also hate the timed levels. Please get rid of them! Two major problems that remain: when I want to play and have time to play, I can't because I have no lives and when I have no time to play, I end up with infinite lives.

It's very frustrating when u have things lined up so that the ones u need will drop into place on the next move and then when u make the play and the ones that should fallen into place instead just disappear. Poof. Gone. This games is rigged. It happens all throughout the game making it almost impossible to win a level without spending money...and that ain't gonna happen. So Uninstalling.

I love this game! Very addicting for sure. I think, that you should give a chance to buy boosters with coins. To be able to beat level(s)... you need to have boosters to help. Or you're stuck on that level for hrs or even days. Some levels you don't even give nearly enough moves either. But, yes... I now like this game or I would not be playing it.

I really do love playing this keeps your mind sharp, and quick. Everyone could use that.this would be an awsome game if something wouldn't stop you from making a move of your own instead of a move they want, then it interfears by stopping moves reloading or not allowing you to access a bomb. I can deal with the way the game Is, but when things go missing. and you can't get them back that's bad.I want my fish back. thank- you.

This game is one of many diversions, which, I suppose, is why I love playing! Not all is worth going after without spending some real money. Yet what the game offers in variety and simple diverting fun leaves me to have but two complaints... One, a few too many pop-ups when you're just trying to start (minimal), and secondly, the sheer enormity of how many beatification points are required to open up further tanks! In the beginning, this isn't so bad, however looking forward, the tanks I wish to get to are almost beyond comprehension of what will be required, and that in itself causes more stress, and is a turn-off to a game I play to alleviate such stress! Overall love the game though!

Advertising to this game was misleading. The games that I saw advertised on Instagram weren't a bunch of matching up tiles, they were more challenging and logical games, like trying to free the fish or avoid it being eaten by a shark (you'd know what I'm talking about if you saw the ad). I have kept playing the levels thinking that it would get to that, but all its been is matching up tiles. Going to Uninstall soon because it's getting boring.

Don't waste your time. It was fun at first and around level 89(2 days of play time) it becomes impossible to win without buying boosters or having purchased extra moves. I wouldn't mind paying for the game, but 6.99 only gets you a SEASON PASS. That's pretty damn expesive for a monthly subscription. If it was a one time purchase, I would be on board, but 6.99 a month for a mediocre puzzle game is asking too much. There's many more games like this and I suggest not wasting your time.

I loaded this game because I liked the look of the puzzles in the ads. There is a long time between levels, it sometimes moves the wrong pieces, I have to keep shopping which I hate doing and after all the waiting and playing I still haven't come across a single puzzle like the ones in the advertisement. False advertising and pretty boring. Nice graphics, if you like candy crush and shopping, you'll enjoy this.

i loved everything about this game, until they changed the graphics of the shells and things in the actual puzzle part. They look way too childish and are actually harder for me to look at. I used to play for hours which was relaxing after work but now I find myself quitting after just a few moves because the graphics are so terrible! the graphics in the rest of the game didnt change and they are amazing! please go back to the better graphics!

I want to like this more but some of the levels are just silly. Some of the hard or super hard levels are very easy. Next minute on a normal level you can't even pass it using power ups at the start of the level. Makes no sense. Also I find that it will glitch and not do what you actually try to do. Like you move the object left but it goes a different way or it just doesn't move at all. When that happens and you lose a level because of it, it is annoying. I find myself getting more annoyed.

Fish are cute but play lags sometimes. Average match game at best. Might be more fun if you could go back and play another level when you can't get past a tough one. Annoying that it offers options and you click, then it pops back to a previous screen because you don't have enough credits for that option. (Why bother asking if I can't?) Not a very satisfying time-waster.

Have played for a very long time. The recent changes have taken the fun away. Used to be able to complete the special events, can not now bc the points have changed. Only 15, per win, unless it is a super hard level. But they also make it much harder to get to keep the extra aquariums, so why mess with it. Game may have to go on hiatus. Looking at other reviews the developer may want to go back to the old stlye

Honestly, this is probably the best match-3 game out there. I love the vibrant graphics, the adorable decor and fish and easy controls. It's so fun how they always have a challenge or tournament going on. The only thing that is an "issue" is how the fish get in the way when you're moving objects around. If they could maybe add a feature to temporarily remove the fish to be able to renovate the tank, I'd love it! Definitely deserves 5 stars! All of playrix's games never disappoint. 👍

I am currently unable to play my favorite game due to a glitch. On level 4843 I can only get to the first block of the game..when it is time to advance to the second block it freezes..I can only back out and end the game. I have sent 3 messages with screenshots and detailed information on how I have tried to fix the issue myself. I have restarted my device I have uninstalled and reinstalled the game and to no avail. I lost a bonus of 6hrs of free lives after winning an event. No response!

Not a fan of the new update. The pieces look weird, and now if you're out of lives, you get fooled thinking you have another life because the beginning graphics come up, but you can't start the game. Really frustrating. Also, when we run out of levels and are doing treasure chest levels, you don't get the extra stuff at the end. It's almost like you're being penalized for completing all the levels. You should be able to get all the good stuff w/ treasure chest levels as you do w regular levels.

Originally gave it 5 stars because it's a great game and I don't mind spending the $4.99 for the pass but the levels have been impossible to beat without paying for a cheat. Even the ones that aren't labeled hard or really hard. And the beach ball you get used to help now it makes things worse. The mini games are only at the beginning every 10-15 levels. Now there's none.

I played this game for a year or so. I loved it but as you progress you end up spending money to beat levels, otherwise you become stuck. This wasn't really an issue though because they've added some boosters and mini games to assist with the tougher levels. Don't get a new phone though because your progress won't transfer over, even if it's saved and linked to Facebook. I reached out to customer support, no response. I've deleted the game that I spent money to play. Disappointing 😞

Boring. Also it's not even the same game that was advertised. This is same scheme that Gardenscapes has. They show a game where you're choosing items to fix problems, but it's literally another matching and fix-the-place-up type game. You probably won't get to what was advertised until you're at a high level. I didn't want to do any of this other stuff to get there, so...uninstalling.

it started off great, it's a fun game that gives both the gem matching game fun with taking care of your fish tanks, getting new tanks/ fish etc. I noticed it getting harder as you progress (makes sense) however, at some point I feel like you really have to spend to get past a level. I really can't afford to be spending to get special tools to get thru each round. current round 10 fails. I won't pay to get thru each round! Sad because this is a fun game before getting to impossible level.

I've had this game. The stars I've given are for the beauty, creativity and endearing qualities. It gets to where, if you don't spend money, you can't progress. Note to devs and ad people: stop advertising mini games that don't exist! I might consider a reinstall if there were mini games like the ads show, and they gave an optional way to earn the game currency needed to progress. Not everyone who plays "free" games can afford to spend money to continue. It's the whole point of playing "free"!

I have played this game for quite a long time now (level 4000+). There's been ups and downs. However, this last update is very frustrating and expensive to continue playing. They have cut the starting moves to each level way down (you can see on YouTube how, even a couple months ago) there were way more starting moves to each level). I don't mind spending some money but every couple of levels is either rated hard or very hard and very little beginning moves and impossible to pass.

Update: It is so difficult to win levels now (even with boosters) that the fun is rather gone. I rarely choose this game now to unwind in the evenings, maybe once monthly, if that. But I'm hanging on in case it improves. Previous Review: I really love this game. I also love that the Devs have made it possible to transfer my game play to a new device WITHOUT FACEBOOK. That means I am not too worried about buying extras because I'll keep playing in future.

It can get frustrating and boring at times but I've never spent any money and for the most part it's like when I'd shoot pool, win or lose I shoot. Only difference here is you have only get 5 rounds and longer wait time to refill. I try to make the power ups versus using the ones I earn from daily and other rewards. Sometimes strategy works and sometimes it doesn't. I've been stuck on levels forever and eventually move the next. It's only a game. I prefer the mini games tho.

This puzzle game is a lot of fun, and I haven't caught any bugs. My only quibble is that it's not in any way the game it was advertised to be. The ad I clicked on to install it showed a fish navigating a series of dangers and obstacles. The game doesn't have any levels like that; it's a series of puzzles where you match seashells to destroy tiles and create explosions.

This is my favorite game. It's very challenging, the graphics are excellent and the sounds are good as well. I would recommend Fishdom to people who love to challenge themselves to solving hard puzzles. The only thing I don't like about this game is when you get 1or more hours of free play you have to play it all at one time. You should be able to pause the game at anytime so you can play your free hour etc at your convenience.

would LOVE to give the game 5 stars because it's graphics, bright colors, ease of use deserve it ! but the limited number of plays without either spending large amounts of hard cash or length of time to wait for more lives I feel is extremely high. Please revisit this issue and consider making changes. I quit playing before for quite a LONG time because of the cost and I really enjoy the game.

I used to love this game. I'm a fan of matching games and aquariums, but there's a problem. At later levels, the difficulty ramps up ridiculously. It's not that they get more challenging, it's that they get more impossible, where even boosters don't help you beat the level until you get lucky on the umpteenth retry. There's also no telling which boosters might help, or if any boosters just get in the way. I played this for the aquarium, not for the frustration.

As a match 3 game, Fishdom is decent. Nice graphics, but really nothing to make it stand out from any of the other match-3 games around. But the main reason for the rating is I feel the game is a bit of a "bait and switch" game. All the adds I saw for it make it look like a game where you are making choices to help your fish survive/escape various situations. That is not the case (at least through level 21). Uninstalled as I was hoping for something different instead of basic match 3

Imma drop my rating and I'm no longer playing until the issues are fixed... I've lost way too much diamonds, boosters and lives. On 1 level, I have beaten the level at least 10 times, yet I'm still on the same level because the game crashes and does not count it. Done, completely done. After playing this game for over 5 years, I refuse to waste my time with something as annoying as this. I loved this game, but not anymore.

False advertising!! Im super annoyed and cross right now as I've just wasted a huge amount of my data downloading something that i thought would be fun and challenging leading the fish through difference obstacles but it turned out to be a match 3 type of game and it's the second time this has happened. Same story with 'gardenscapes'. Very disappointing!!

I love the game, except for the timed ones. I play to relax and keep my mind busy, but timed games really irritate me and make me anxious, especially when you get to the higher levels. When I hit over 410, I ended up uninstalling the game and reloading at the beginning because I got so frustrated trying to beat a timed level. I don't spent money buying stuff and if I'm out of bombs, etc. and hit those timed games, it's gets really annoying !!!!

I think if you are going to have a daily clam, them the munitions should stay with the player for a day, not just 1 round. Also, the yellow squares should disappear after 1 hit, not 2 or more. But best fast moving game without extreme violence. Love the optics on this but can be expensive & too long of wait between lives (even the fishes agree!!). Wouldn't mind spending $5 for a lifetime agreement. But to have to spend money each time is not worth my while.

Complete deception. The ads show logic games where you are trying to figure out which levers to pull in order to free the fish. Just finished the 18th level and the game is absolutely nothing like that. It is the "match 3 in a row to clear them" game that hundreds of other games use. You get points to buy stuff to decorate your aquarium with. Nothing unique or fun about this game. No logic puzzles, no "rescue the fish" as shown in the ads. Complete waste of time.

It's a fun game, and you have to think ahead of time, using math and common sense. You'll quickly learn what happens if you don't plan ahead, so strategy is somewhat important too. There's no variety throughout levels, consists of same thing level after level, so eventually became boring to me. I would never pay for the app, but as a free app, it does keep you occupied and concentrating for an extended period of time, if you let it.

Fishdom is definitely better than playrix's other games I've played such as matchington mansion, homescapes and gartenscapes. It doesn't make you waste what you've earned doing stupid things you don't want to do. You basically just buy fish and accessories for your tank. The levels are starting to get unnecessarily difficult, however. I'm wondering how long it will be until it's so hard it's not fun anymore. It's started a little, after a couple of weeks, but im still enjoying it.

Love it!! Great animation and beautiful visuals. Lots of colors and variety. It's a very eye pleasing little game. Plus the game itself is pretty neat. It's like most other matching games, but this one is just a bit different. It has cool objectives to each level and it also has mini puzzle games every so often that you can play (if you choose to) for extra coins and small bonuses. Overall I really like it!!

Really fun and no annoying ads! They don't presure you to buy stuff either, it's more of a gentle, occasional, suggestion when they do. I like the way your fish chat with you. My only problem is that, on my chromebook, I can't play any of the mini games you get when you beat the levels. That was one of the reasons I wanted to play the game to begin with... :( otherwise I would give it 5 stars. Maybe you guys could fix the chromebook compatibility with the touchpad/mouse? READ THE 1STAR REVIEWS!

I downloaded Fishdom just to get bonus items for another game. Now at level 2350 in Fishdom, the previous game has been long uninstalled. Fishdom is cute and fun. The game can be challenging. Levels go from easy to hard. There are always events going on (seasonal and recurrent events). The decoration is very relaxing and the fish are adorable. In game purchases are not necessary to advance in the game because there are so many rewards for playing (daily perks, rewards from events or from tasks.)

This game is fun. The graphics are darling. But......I eventually reached a level that I absolutely could NOT pass without spending real money. I have spent several dollars playing this game - but the levels, even the "hard" ones were passable. I have no idea how much real money you'd have to spend on this last "hard" level I quit on. When it gets to the point where a level CAN'T be passed, without seeing that you'll be spending a few dollars, if you're ever going to pass, that's enough for me.

Great game! It's fun and addictive. The business model is pay for play so sometimes it's impossible to move through levels without extreme patience if you don't pay. Developers- a bug I've come across is that some levels "hang up" and don't allow the player to win when they should be able to based on the number of moves left. E.g. 10 moves left and 4 items to clear but the items do not appear on the board until several moves have been made. I've seen this happen with squid, oil, and bubbles.

I've played for years and paid for the season passes. It's become impossible especially with having number of moves cut drastically. Even with boosters impossible. Then when you have it beat it throws a lightening under the coin so there's no way for it to drop. Appears rigged now. Tired of spending a week plus on one puzzle. What was fun is now beyond frustrating. Not worth it. Un-installing.

The game is very similar to all the other puzzle games of such with the exception of decorating of fish bowls and adding fish to personalize the environment. I am disappointed in the fact that the adds for the game is misleading. At which level do you help your fish swim through the pipes as a shark chases it and you have to male a decision on which is the best tool to solve the scenario???? Where is that ??!. I would give 5 stars if that was available. I have not seen that answered yet !

Update: 4 years playing. Level 6723. Gone! I got another phone. Everything switched over, except Fishdom. It WOULD NOT load my game! Tried to make me start over! Would not load my saved progress! 4 years! I tried everything. Thanks for nothing! Really love the games, challenge, graphics...everything! Update...3 years later, still playing, still loving it!

This game is okay. It's bright and colorful, can be fun, and a decent time killer. I don't care for (and ultimately uninstalled because of) how there are limited moves, WAY too much stuff going on (multiple goals, quests, and myriad windows that pop up upon loading reminding the player that there are at least 5 different goals/quests/whatever to do), and an eventual limit where the levels are so tough there just isn't a way to beat them without power ups. Too busy and demanding for my tastes.

It's fun. Fish friends/designing tanks is great. But, as you get to higher levels it gets less fun, b/c it's hard to pass levels. Especially if you've made purchases previously & you don't want to all the time.They say you don't have to purchase,but, yeah! By 500's you "get" the game, but if it takes 5-10trys to pass a level-what up? I mean there's 4000 levels, 32-40 tanks. The game could move along a little better. I'd rather pay for the game up front.I'd even put up with a few ads. Might quit!

Reasonably fun way to kill some time. What is annoying though is they reduced the number of turns to compete a level. Go on YouTube and watch a play through of any level. YouTube shows 25 turns to get through level 114, I was given 13. Of course it becomes more difficult. I can get to within a few blocks of competing it. The game is always willing to sell you a few more turns though!

I truly love and enjoy this game for sure and would recommend it to the rest of the world, but there are some certain things that are not necessary for instance "Beauty Points" are massively high to achieve from the little purchases I make from the store. Complex Levels are becoming more and more by the day which makes me fed up of the game as the days pass, (I've stuck on a level for the past 5 days). Moves are becoming less and less on particular levels. If you could help me I would much love.

I used to love this game, but recently it has changed (not for the better) levels cheating me, some are impossible to beat, keep going until the game decides to let you pass. I refuse to spend $$ on a game that I feel is deliberately cheating me. Sorry you felt these changes were necessary, you'll end up losing a lot of players, which means losing $$$ because someone made a bad decision implementing the latest changes. Have a good day! One time, Big time Fishdom can

I've played all the Playrix games extensively. They're much more fun in the beginning, but soon they become less about skill and more about random chance (getting ideal piece layouts) and/or about whether you're willing to spend money on their various little 'cheat' abilities (as I would call them) to overcome the randomness and low number of allowed moves in the mid-upper levels. The graphics and primary gameplay are cute and high-quality, but the reliance on pay-to-win ruins things for me.

It's a fun game, but you folks make it too expensive to play the higher one goes. I found that it's nearly impossible to complete a level without boosters OR without purchasing more moves. The price for more moves is purple diamonds, which you have to buy. It's great that we earn tokens to buy fish and decorations for the aquariums, but it would be much more helpful to win a bunch of purple diamonds. I'm uninstalling because I'm in an economic downturn and can't afford anymore.

The ad is misleading. The ad only comes during the minigame and not the general gameplay. I like it though. Unlike a lot of other stage games, it gives you something to build while beating the stages. I find it a good combination. Personally I don't have time to play the 'candycrush' stages. I only wanted what was advertised. Good concept though.

100% Misleading!! This game advertises as an adventure game that provides challenging puzzles in order to move forward. It's just candy crush all over again. I even played up to level 20 in order to make sure it wasn't a special level thing only. I wouldn't get this game unless you want another candy crush type game. Also, about 25% of time, the shells or whatever doesn't move in the direction I wanted it to.

Is there a chance the chat box could be improved please? Our team is a great chatty one but actually using it is painful. If you make a mistake in your typing early you can't move the cursor, you have to delete the lot. Also can't see once you go past the end of the typing field. Added bonus would be to post screen shots so we can help our team mates, or even revisit old levels. Great game tho. Thank you.

The game is fine. It isn't as advertised though. I was intrigued by the mini-games in the ad. There were about 3 in the beginning, but nothing since, and I've played up to 150 levels. It's an average candy-crush type game while you gain coins and bonuses to build an aquarium. I'd give a higher rating if not for the deliberate false advertising in the ads.

The ads looked pretty cool, logic puzzles based around keeping a fish alive. Wish it had been that. What you get is a standard, match 3 or more game. During 17 levels, I got just three extremely easy mini games that worked like the ads. They didn't look like it, the animation was third-rate compared to the ads. So I uninstalled it. Don't promise one thing then give me something completely different.

I've had Fishdom on my phone for the past few years and absolutely loved it. After the most recent updates, though, I no longer enjoy it - it's become a chore. I find it takes days to clear some levels because you have so few moves and the daily bonuses are nearly useless. I'm disappointed and even kinda' sad because I love the little aquariums I've built, but it's just not much fun anymore and I absolutely refuse to spend money to purchase bonuses in order to play a free game.

Love this game but once you start buying gems, the game makes your game harder and frustrates you until you keep buying more. Not happening anymore people!!! Games should be fun not frustrating. I love a challenge and don't expect to win all the time but this is beyond that. I watched YouTube videos to help but they always have more moves than the level I'm on. I would be able to pass these levels with more turns too.

I used to like Fishdom. Now there is no relaxed mode. Once you get up above level 30, the levels are timed. I am uninstalling. Update: Tried it again. Now the timed levels start even earlier, and the relaxed mode is still gone. I really wanted to love this game again, but I don't like beat the clock games. I get enough stress at work. So disappointing. Uninstalling again.😣 Goodbye, sweet fish.

It's been interesting with a different take on the match type game that are out there. Not fixing up another broken down manor and doing even single tiny thing is fixed with a level or two for each tiny upgrade. Also inspires more creativity thru from a vast amount of choices making it different for every player out there. One down fall I feel is the levels get super difficult and impossible to win very early on and super fast in the game experience. I've bee stuck in the 40th levels now. Mad!

Don't spend too much time on this one. You will reach a point where literally every other level is either a super hard, hard, or challenge level. This is to use up all boosters you manage to save and try to get you to purchase more boosters and moves. You will spend days on the same level only needing 1 or 2 moves to complete. Also I didn't find any mini games like stated in add. This is just a match 3 game.

I chose to uninstall because when you still have moves left in the puzzle it says you don't have anymore moves and makes you start all over on the level. Needless to say it's extremely frustrating. It's all to make you keep playing. I'm not playing into that. It also tries to get you to buy more lives for $2.99... and when it just decides you have no moves left, when you still do... rigged. The developers don't care to change, probably will get a response like others "sorry I feel this way."

I really like playing the game. I enjoy being picked for special sales, and in-game, side games. I think that there should be more ways to win free coins. I don't always have the extra money to spend, so I can't play as often as I would like to. I enjoy achieving the treasure chest, their contents are very useful for finishing the harder levels, adding to my coin total, and free plays. I have even recieved jewels a couple of times.

I used to love this game. Unfortunately, it has become quite exhausting and annoying for numerous reasons - constant bugs, levels that require boosters or additional moves, pushing players to buy gold pass in order to play the game and pass the levels more quickly, etc. Getting people to spend their money has obviously become the main purpose of this game. This used to be such a cool and relaxing pastime...

This could be a great game if it weren't designed to make you spend money. The higher levels are almost impossible to pass, they don't give you enough bombs or lightning. Swapping 2 lightning tiles is supposed to clear all the tiles, but it doesn't; it leaves you with only 1 tile after your last move every time. I stopped enjoying it and deleted. I can find other games!

I already have this game on my Kindle and I enjoy it. HOWEVER! The advertisements in other games led me to believe there was another version that also looked fun having to unlock puzzles to save the fish from certain doom. NOT THE CASE AT All! Just the same one I already play. In regards to those who think they have to spend money to beat a level that is your choice. It may take a long time, but that level will eventually get easier.

First thing to know, if you cannot complete the puzzle and you exit to retry you lose the power up anyway. Next is that the minigame you see in advertising, is only available every 7 puzzles ( even more during an event) or so on average. Third (to top it off) is the fact that the stages expect you to do 2 or even 3 things at once in order to clear them, not only that they only give you like 10 turns to do it. I could go on with 5 or 6 more things but, there's not enough room here for them.

I've played red this game for a long time now. It was my favorite! I have spent a lot of money getting boosts and gems to pass levels. I love the different challenges. However, the new update killed it for me. It started all over again! I've tried the save progress route and uninstalling and reinstalling and save progress route again. I've tried to contact support several times already and get only articles to read. Then they all me was this helpful? NO! I have still yet to be contacted. Delete

S'ok... kind of a lot going on though. It's basically a match 3 game like Candy Crush, with extra mini games and a fish tank feature that makes use of coins collected by passing the various levels. That would be enough, but there's other side challenges that are time limited and more things to collect to buy items for your aquarium that start to get a little bit convoluted. Too much for me to get involved in, so I'm sticking with simpler stuff. Free but too time consuming.

Obvious statement, but the ads are incredibly misleading. The puzzles are one per day with a 24hr cooldown. The rest is a match 3 game with the normal "decorate a useless space for no reason". Standard fare, they give you an easy ride just enough, and then throw you the levels you can't win without paying. It's predatory and shameful. If it was occasional it wouldn't be as bad but it basically becomes you paying them to win the board constantly, and it's not even guaranteed you can finish it.

I'm not all that impressed. Fishdom is a match three game that is heavily free-to-play. No ads, but the game will squeeze you constantly, making it extremely difficult to progress without spending in-game currency, which not surprisingly can only be purchased. It looks cute, the art is great, and it's well built, but that's all in service of the worst the mobile gaming industry can produce.

The graphics are adorable!! BUT the game isn't fair. Some levels are fun, others are just ridiculously frustrating. I don't want to quit because I love the aquariums but the levels aren't fun anymore. 😔 Playrix: The suggestions don't help. I give up! It's totally unfair when the firecracker I JUST made is frozen before it hits the bottom of the play field (still the same turn). Not to mention the lightning I justfreed with a bomb refroze before the turn was over!! I'm done!!

I enjoy the game but it ends up being a money grab. The levels get harder and harder and the turns to play get less. Unless you're willing to pay to continue playing you have to wait for time to pass before you can play again. A huge rip off. Got to level 93. Spent days trying to beat it. Finally paid 2.79 to continue, then another 2.79. Only got 3 moves each time. What a waste of money. I enjoy the game but uninstalling because it's a disgusting total money grab.

As all the other review say: it's fun at first but then just becomes an exercise in playing the same level 50 times until the game, or the odds, randomly give you the combination of pieces you need to pass. It stops being fun and there's no skill or strategy involved at all. And this is even with the gold pass, that I've purchased many times. It must be virtually impossible without it. If I may make a suggestion to the company: don't piss off your paying customers. App uninstalled, bye!

Aquarium is nice, but not as advertised in the ads. I wanted the puzzle aspect where you help the fish like what is played in the ads. I've played many levels thinking maybe it would unlock a puzzle level, but I'm uninstalling after reading other reviews. If you want an aquarium game with matching gems like candy crush, you will probably like this game. I'm giving 2 stars because of false advertising, lack of puzzles, and the fact that you have to spend real money to unlock certain features.

Fun and addictive but too long to wait for lives or get through some levels without paying. The worst is the lack of bonuses or opportunity to get or win them without purchasing them. Alot of money grabbing in this game for sure. Also I have tried unsuccessfully for weeks now by uninstalling and reinstalling as well as connecting and disconnecting and restarting my device; but I still cannot get any lives from fb, which is very frustrating.

It's a really fun game and I'm addicted! Edited to add that after the latest update I can no longer play. It's completely frozen. I can't click on anything. Very disappointing. Edited to add that the game just gets worse and worse. You can barely win a round without paying and they raised the prices ridiculously while lowering the amount of coins you get in the fishy bank. This game just wants money.

Initially, I did give 5 stars and a great review. However, I have come upon levels that are almost impossible to complete without using boosters and $$ to buy diamonds to buy more time. So, I looked online amd utube vids for help. Lo & Behold, the requirements were different!!! Where other players were required to collect certain number of regular pieces such as red stars/green turtles., etc., and save squid; I had to collect pearls and save all the squid! As you all know you have to make a match next to the pearls a few times to make them available for collecting. Is anyone else having these problems? Different goals and differing number of turns you get to complete given tasks? Developers: please advise and fix this issue.

Earlier I uninstalled Fishdom, I had to play each level many, many times before I won that level to move to the next. The boosters were hard to obtain, and winnings were minimal at best. I decided to give it another try, I don't know what was done, but Kudos to Fishdom!! The game is still challenging enough, but not impossible! (Without paying for boosters & such!) I have actually enjoyed playing again! Fantabulous job, Fishdom!

the game is fun overall love the different options we have when it comes to decorating our tanks with the fish figurines and plants. just a little frustrating how hard it is sometimes to collect the coins and tickets to purchase these things. yes i love the holiday themes as well but same goes for those as well all most impossible to build up enough to buy anything big before the season is over. im not one who has the money to put into these games so i just survive off what i win from playing

I love this game. I have been playing for a few years. Loved it so much that when I bought a couple of new devices I installed the game to both(at different times on purpose). It was fun playing different levels each day. Then one day all 3 devices were synced (I'm not sure but wondered if it happened because I agreed to hook one up with Facebook to get extra diamonds) and I had the same level on all 3. I was beyond mad. I deleted it off my phone. Still mad about it tho.

I am past level 5 thousand. Still think it's a very good game. It has many mini games, challenges etc. However i have stopped playing because the beauty points are quite extreme.. You need over 300 thousand bauty points to complete last star in a tank. The decoration or fish that has about 40 thousand beauty points costs about $150 thousand coins. Tops you can make in a level is $2000 coins. You do the math...how many levels you need to play in order to complete a tank? Too much time :/

Very cute, challenging and addictive. I would appreciate a few changes. One such change is, when you win an hour or 2 or 6 of unlimited lives, it would be nice to be able to put the game on hold and/or be able to save the unlimited hours for when you have a chance to play, uninterrupted. I hate wasting that unlimited time if I can't play because of my life getting in the way, lol. It seems I have trouble getting more lives to be able to play longer. Maybe you could win lives as well as diamonds

Absolutely awful. Its NOTHING like the advertisements. In the ads, you eat fish in a feeding frenzy style game, getting bigger and bigger, but then you actually get to it and just like, a completely different game entirely. It's false advertisement through and through. I cannot believe stuff like this is not only allowed, but seemingly ENDORSED.

The game itself is awesome, but the player support is disastrous and totally missing. They restricted some features automatically because of "suspicious" activity on my account. The only explanation I could find was that I simply played too well without buying anything in the game. And that is frustrating for playrix. The, when I contacted the support on the only channel available, chat, they didn't answer. I do not recommend the game.

Like the game play and level of difficulty is good. Not a big fan of the new update with the more cartoony game pieces. I wish there was a feature to where when looking at your fish tank you could remove all of the icons fdom the screen and see just the fish tank. False Advertising. I had to change my review from 5 to 1 star because I saw an ad for Fishdom on Snapchat that showed a snippet of the game play. What the ad shows is a completely different type of play. It has nothing to do with the way this game is actually played. Advertising one thing but providing a different product is a good way to get lawyers excited.

False Advertising. In the ads it shows a strategy game, where you move rods to save a fish, but after downloading - that's nowhere in the game. Instead it's a match game (like Candy Crush). VERY misleading. I wasn't sure I even downloaded the right game (even though I clicked the direct link through the ad) but I read other reviews and others were duped as well. Why advertise a game that doesn't exist?

Too difficult too quick! I get to collect purple stones but can't use them unless I pay - that's just stupid. There's at least a thousand levels I believe and I can't get past level 40??! There's really no gradual progression, just become too difficult too quick. A beautiful game mind you, but collecting your money is way obvious. Too bad, too. I'm done with this game.

Greed ruined this game. Levels get so hard impossible to beat without power ups which u have to buy. Spent at least $50 on this game and just getting worse. U are bombarded with ads to buy specials needed to win. At least when u buy a game it's a one time fee. This game gets expensive if u want to succeed. Totally disgusted and sickened by the money grab.

This game isn't what I was expecting (until I read through the reviews before downloading) bc what I was expecting was what I saw in the ads. However, I still like the game anyway. If you saw the add, this is nothing like it. It's all a lie, people. It always is. Now I want to eat the little fish and I have no game to do it with. Thank you for nothing, Fishdom.

Love the game and that there's no ads!! Reason for only 3 stars as I wish it allowed you to use your infinity lives when you wanted verses right when you earned them. Instead they show the "minigames" - which exist in the game, but rarely occur. There is something to be said about your game when you avoid showing the actual product.
one of my favorite games, I love animated games, always attract me🦋🩷

This game is very misleading, it is not like what the add shows. It showed obstacles, that the fish had to go through. The ad looked fun. I love the way my fish encourage me, the many different things that can be bought for my aquariums, the special individual ways that the decorations can move when I touch them. I have been playing this for 2 years now, hero update & few rules are still not clear to me alty I manage with shield on, but seriously without payment you can't become big player here that's sad rest will play till they keep things good. kindly bring things which can help normal people enjoy the game

Very fun game but other reviewers are right. The creators of the game make some of the levels so difficult that there isn't a way to win the level without purchasing diamonds.
