Thanks for a fun game!!!!

Worst update yet. I can't figure out how much to spend in coins to move up to the next aquarium. The current aquarium shows up over the settings icon, but doesn't show amounts. If you spend coins it updates, but shows no totals. If I lose a level the game freezes and I have to close it and reopen to continue to play. The game will spontaneously freeze and close in the middle of a game, causing a loss. Any gems spent or boosters used are lost in the freeze. Should have left it alone.

You simply cannot progress in this game without spending money. You earn jewels through your game play but they go into a 'bank' that you have to pay $2.99 each time it gets to 50 jewels to gain access to them. The levels get progressively harder until it simply isnt possible to beat the game without buying boosts and extra moves. Stay away unless you enjoy spending money all the time!

A worse version of Candy Crush. Thought I was downloading a game that would have more puzzles and interesting mini-games, but no. Just another matching game that introduces new quirks and pieces as you progress. Definitely becomes "pay to play" once you get up into the mid-3000 levels. Even "easy" levels require multiple attempts or power-ups/boosters or diamonds to continue so you can actually finish the level. Probably uninstalling -- better games or other things to do with my time.

Pretty game with great graphics, sound and theming. However, it is very repetitive and riddled with ridiculous micro transactions. At the end of an event, it did not give me the earned rewards but extorted me to use crystals to "buy" everything I had earned. Since it was worth about $45 I decided to buy some crystals for $9.99 to rescue my earned rewards that were being held hostage. Not only did I get charged for the crystals but also did not get rewards. Happened again and gave up in disgust

Gets addictive. I got to over 400 levels and the ingame puchase screen pops up, i close it and it pops up, continiously. I cant continue playing unless I actually pay for a gold pass, as this screen will not stop popping up and let me play. Im very dissapointed. I reinstalled but same issue. I will not be paying to move forward. I have Enjoyed the game although the further you move ahead the levels are almost impossible to beat without buying in game purchases.

I've had to edit my review with less stars than previously. The levels have become so hard that even the ones that aren't labeled as hard, can take days to beat. It now takes days to be able to buy decoration or fish. The challenges are impossible to complete, unless you can play all day, every day, and spend a lot of money (which I can't do).

Love this game, all my fishies! I spend countless hours customizing my aquariums and just watching the fish interact with the environments and each other!! Great game play that doesn't withhold any aspect from those who choose not to spend money on the game. There is a sense that this developer cares about the player's enjoyment and not just profit like so many other games. Purchases are actually worth the price, and don't leave you with a sad regret when you look at your purchase history later!!

Honestly? I could copy paste this review from other apps. Not as bad as some, but still, it's a basic match 3, with elements of decorating your aquarium and acquiring fish, that draws you in with misleading adds of puzzles that represent a tiny portion of the actual gameplay, and rely on you feeling attachment to the fish and wanting more boosters. Outdated graphics and truly cringy humour.

I was turned onto the game from an ad. The gameplay shown in the ad looked fun. Unfortunately, the gameplay shown in the ad is not the core gameplay. It may be one of the mini games, but I had played for around 30 minutes and did not run into it. I just don't understand this new issue plaguing the mobile games industry. Why make the ads look different than the gameplay? Just make the gameplay that. I'm sure you can find just as much way to monetize it. Stupid.

It's fun until it's not. Eventually you reach a level (for me it's 3682) that the algorithm simply does not provide the pieces needed to win, no matter how many attempts and extra options you use. You have to spend ridiculous amounts of gems if I don't want to waste days on a level because the "hard" or "super hard" levels outnumber the regular levels. You are basically forced to pay for gems if you want any chance of progressing to the next level. So, time to find a different game.

DON'T BUY THE GOLD PASS!!! The levels are so hard it's a waste of money. I was buying passes and several combo packs but I won't do either anymore. After buying the last gold pass, I became stuck on a super hard level for 3 weeks.. Only to win the minute after I get the notification the new gold pass is available. Wouldn't hurt as bad if I hadn't spent $20 trying to beat the level. It wasn't possible until the game decided it was.

No way this deserves 4.3 stars. I'd give it 0 if I could. Can't play without updates. Tried to update but all failed. Back to the game, pop up update blocks game play. Another issue, if you decide to pay for gold pass, it's not a one time charge but lasts a limited time, then you pay again. Not a lot of money, IF you were only doing it ONCE! Surely a nightmare for people with low impulse control and limited income. This is, in my opinion, one of the greediest games. Too bad. Too many issues.

The game will load perfectly, but after it loads... the only things within the game that I can select are the decorations or the fish. I can't select the menu, next level, the store, etc. I've uninstalled, and re-installed, phone is up to date, on wifi and then just mobile data. All with the same result. It has been this way now for 3 days.

The game is great! The reason I'm giving it a one star is the false advertising. When I have seen any of the ads for it they show where the fish is trying escape or something of the like, what they don't tell you is that those are the MINIGAMES, which only show up once every 3 to 5 levels. It's not the main game play. I would be fine with them being the minigames but tell me. I got the game for the minigames without know that was not the main game play. Just advertise appropriately.

This game would be absolutely worth five stars if it was advertised for properly. It is advertised as a pull the pin game, much like the thumbnail, but that's not the main point of the game at all. I think you get a pull the pin mini game once in a very great while, and they're not even hard, or progressively challenging. The game itself is extremely cute, but it is falsely advertised. The game is MOSTLY like a Candy crush match game.

The game ads give the impression that the game sessions are scenarios which present a character in trouble. The player needs to pull the correct pins in the proper sequence in order save him. The actual game is about moving pieces to form sets of like consecutive pieces, causing explosions, and blasting gold nuggets. Not what I signed up for. The rewards go toward redecorating an aquarium. Not interested. This was a tremendous disappointment.

Previously I gave Fishdom a 5 star, but because of changes made, I must edit that score. Was a nice pass time. Changes are continually being made. Lately I lost most of the friends in my friends list, and now they took away the help friends button. Left better games because of changes.... Done with it! By the way I would never invite my friends to play this, especially not now.

The puzzles are purpose-built to give you too few moves to solve so you'll spend money. The "puzzle" shown in the ad only appeared a few times, then it was all candy crush nonsense. Also, I've noticed the "support team" only seems to reply to people who have paid, and clearly the main complaint (that the puzzles are all about getting the user to spend money) have been entirely ignored. A couple puzzles being that challenging makes sense, but EVERY SINGLE ONE is pretty ridiculous. Uninstalled.

If you saw the ads for this game and think it's a puzzle game to get your fish through obstacles, get ready to be disappointed. It's just a candy crush clone with a different wrapper. The obstacle course thing is just a mini game that pops up after a few levels. Very few, like 4 or 5 of them out of 350 levels. Complete false advertisement, but if you like dumping time into candy crush style games, you might have fun.

Agree with all the other reviews...don't really play games but the "save the fish" theme advertised did seem a tiny bit fun...I don't understand why you make an ad for something that you aren't then providing! It's actually infuriating, not because it's so disappointing, but because it is so wrong...having said that, I realize that all advertising is misleading to a great degree-doesn't make it any better.

**edit again and rating change. You guys literally ruined the game. Now you can o ly get the "helps" when you pass a level. It was better when yiu had mini challenges like collecting x amount of pearls. I have been platform years and am on level 5000 and something and use to spend money for diamonds and stuff. It's just not even worth the 5 bucks now.** The puzzles are a good mix of challange so its not too easy and the difficult ones aren't so difficult that you want to give up.

Fun for the first week. Then just hated it. You get smashed into a pay wall pretty quick. You literally can't progress in the game without spending a whole bunch of money. If you're into wasting all your money on in app purchases then go ahead. But if you want a fun free game to pass the time I very much do not recommend this game. I would've preferred some adds to get extra gems and stuff but the developers are hard up on taking all your money.

So done with this game. Not worth your time. I was even a loyal customer and got the gold pass...but once you get past lower levels, there is not enough return to justify money spent. When stuck on a level, tasks requiring completion of levels or thousands of a color not in your level are impossible to complete so no booster rewards to help. Nothing more than a money grab. As promised, i am uninstalling and quitting game since I missed finishing a collection, which is only plus of this game.

Been playing this game for over 3 years and at some stages it realy gets difficult, but it is about how you can beat the levels and also improves certain skills as well. It was never meant to be easy and what makes it worth it is that you build your own aquariums and see your progress as you go. I love this game from the beginning and I'm now at level 3962, so I can still look forward to much more fun time.

Pros: It has NO ADS! And I like to decorate my tank. There are many different themes. The interactions between my fish are cute. Cons: The ads about the game are misleading. It's a puzzle game like Candy Crush with bonus levels being the fish eating other fish. Very pushy about buying their in-game "diamonds" to buy more lives. And the gem/life ratio is steep. Once over LVL 100 it's a LOT harder to beat. Feels very pay to win, takes 30mins to even regain a life. Would be 5*s if not for that.

So, my better half plays this and got me into it. It used to be a blast. Once you start getting to 150 it becomes harder, which is expected, but by 500+ (I'm on 600 something now) even the easy levels can take me days to win. They say every level is beatable without spending money which I do think is true, but the odds are in line with winning a lotto ticket. Sometimes I find myself logging in each day for a while just for the daily reward to save up enough boosters to TRY and win.

I can't understand why your video for the game is different than the actual game. The video shows a clown fish stuck at the bottom an you need to save him. An there are two pegs one with lava an the other with water an you have to pick the right peg. It's very miss leading about the game. It would also be nice if I could use my play points for stuff in the game like diamonds. Other then that it's a good game. I hate that it takes forever to win 1 diamond unless you buy them. Not everyone can do.

I deleted this game. First, the pros: graphics are fantastic, aquarium fish are fun and funny, large variety of pretty fish and decor to buy with coins. Now, the cons: It's nothing but match 3, no variety. I spent real money trying to get to the next level, and I still had no luck. I have good hand-eye coordination, but I'm not going to keep throwing my real money down this money pit to keep playing. Developers are talented artists, but they are taking big fish money from us little fish players.

Great until update This game is fun, but I am a little soured after the update. 1. The active pass jumped up to 9.99, not going to buy it anymore. 2. The bomb "power up" went from 2 bombs to 1 bomb. 3. Previously, if there weren't any more moves, the pieces on the board would switch, now the game ends. 4. On the adventures you used to get more lightening up to 150 every 5 min, now it's only to 100, & now you have to do a lot more tasks. Waiting to see if dev listen to fans.

recently updated game is now so hard you can't progress without spending money. Even buying boosters won't help much though as they aren't as good now either. even though I made it to the Atlantis league I'm giving up and going to royal kingdom. at least you can pass a level. just spent over an hour on one fishdom level that wasn't even a "hard". used all my boosters and still didn't pass. Read the room playrix, this update sucks

Some levels are complicated, and, if you don't use boosters, you will fail. You have to pay for boosters, diamonds etc... I don't. Game is good with challenges that you can win boosters. A lot of fun! Sucks when you repeat a level like 20 times over a few days, but, the perks are decent. Will continue to play!

Highly addictive but equally fun! I just wish that there were more ways to earn diamonds and boosters! They should stop the "hunt for treasure" thing when you run out of levels to beat and count those as levels. Be warned, tho. Apparently a recent tax on in-app purchases has been instituted and as a result, i am deleting the game.

This game took a turn for the worse after the latest update. Levels are almost impossible to beat, even with powerups. Oh, and those cute little "save the fish" puzzles you see in ads? A total lie. They don't exist in the game. This is nothing more than a run-of-the-mill match 3. A 1-star rating for false advertising!

This is a candy crush style game that's decently fun. However, if you're coming from one of the ads for it, I am 1000+ levels into this game and have seen maybe 5 of these minigames - each of which was less than 30 seconds long, and the first one was after I hit level 500. None of the ads show actual game play, so if that's what drew you, look somewhere else. I continue to see ads for this game that are completely misleading - including ads for minigames that don't exist.

The ad shows a series of puzzles involving water flow and escaping. The entire game is actually just candy crush to earn coins, which you use to decorate your fish tank. I don't understand why they would advertise it as something completely different from what it is. I mean it's not a terrible concept for a game but it's extremely misleading and frustrating for people who want a game like the ad showed.

Not the game that is described in the add. Like others have said, if I wanted to play a game like candy crush, I would just download candy crush or one of the other hundreds of similar games. Wish I had read the reviews before downloading, I would have saved myself the trouble. False advertising is NOT okay. Horrible way to get downloads, I uninstalled right away after realizing.
I buy the season pass each time and it doesn't show. too much hassle with in app purchases... seems like a system glitch playrix directs you to Google and vice versa. it's quiet silly

This game really sucks. They make it so hard to get to other levels, UNLESS you spend real money to destroy the ticking bombs. Then when you destroy one or two, they add more and more bombs to be destroyed, and by the time you get some out of the way, time RUNS out. Y'all can have this game. If I could I wouldn't even give it one star.

No mini games after you you pass a higher level, just challenge puzzels. The game used to be fun but after you get so far into the game, it's all about money. Used to buy the gold pass but will not spend the same amount for a few days. First took the mini games away and now the gold pass and the way it works. Used to have a goal to reach but now it's so disappointing. They have changed everything that made it fun. There is nothing left of the game is fell in love with.

I saw this game advertised to me multiple times and I figured "why not"? Turns out I needn't have bothered. The parts of the game used in the advertisements aren't even a part of the main gameplay loop, but rather are bonus mini-games. The main game itself is a bog-standard match-three game. Inoffensive and boring with no innovation to the formula. I never thought I'd find a game that would make me say "I would rather play Candy Crush," so that's an achievement, I guess.

I had to downgrade my rating to 2 stars. I love my fish, but is there a way you can have the fish interact or notice when I buy new plants or add new fish. Im beginning to not want to buy things for my tank because its not like the fish notice or interact with what I add. Then I'll go back to 5 stars. Can you please help me enjoy my aquarium even more??

I was really looking for something different, but this is just like soda crush, candy crush, bejeweled. It's fun decorating the fish bowl, but its expensive and without the addition to the game I was looking for there's no need to keep playing. I was looking for the obstacle course where you choose which choice you want to make, but once I installed I see that it's a hoax to get us to install the game. Again it's fun just hate being misled!

I really enjoyed this game initially and spent more money that I care to admit. Now they lowered the jewel pot amount which wasn't much to begin with. Greed has taken over. Bottom line is if a game feels somewhat fair, you overlook its quirks to a point but I can't anymore. Yes, games should be a challenge but I am not having fun and that is the point isn't it?

I hadn't played in a long time, and recently, to kill time was playing, and I don't know what they've done to this game, but they have cut the moves, even on easy levels, down to nothing. I had already left a bad review a long time ago, but had to mention this. So, I'm jus getting rid of this one. Games should b fun, and not so annoying, pushing u to constantly spend $$. It's exhausting, cause most of em are jus like this.

Love Fishdom, BUT Now you earn alot less for playing, and beautification points are more expensive. When you've played all available levels and play for tournament cup you earn almost no money, so can't buy decorations, etc. I now have little motive to play untill new levels are added each week. Also, waiting to be able to start on new aquarium, which is perpetually "coming soon."

why would you put those advertising on other games (like the one you need to take the right decision to escape the shark) if it's not delivered? I used to play Fishdom and then reached a level of boredom of the game and uninstalled it. Now I see the add and think, ok new challenges, but it's not happening. Are you so desperate to trick people into playing it with false ads?

Not as advertised. The gameplay is nothing like the shorts featured in the relentless pop-up ads. Eventually, I downloaded the game just to stop the ads from interrupting my other games. Having said that, this is an enjoyable and very addictive 'swap & match' style game with a cutesy aquarium building feature. I'm only giving it 3 stars as I don't appreciate misleading advertising or being constantly hounded to pay for rewards I've supposedly already earned in gameplay ("fishy bank").

Pay to play, it's disguised in your first few hours of play, but brain power alone, won't allow you to progress. You NEED boost items to complete certain levels. You get free stuff daily, but you will need 3x what you get daily to progress past the level your stuck. Just another pay to play mobile game, but the prices on their IAP are ridiculous. Stay away unless you're OK with pay to play. Response to dev: That's a lie. Levels that are split in half by rock REQUIRE bombs etc, you know that.

No communication on how to earn points. On android, it's non-existent. Nothing. Until this is fixed, I refuse to spend any more money. This game makes money. Not only do they charge for everything if you want to advance.. while you're stuck spending money buying stuff to help you win.. it's rigged, so you won't ever complete a game.. then you have to know where the real money's coming from.. they are mining or selling the rights to your device data. The longer you play, the more they make.

The game is fun.. until it breaks. Support is non-existent. I cannot play the game. As soon as I entered a new fishbowl the game crashed. Now I cannot play. If I hit play, it crashes as soon as the fishbowl starts to load. I followed every step in their article, went through it again with the bot, and am now 36 hours waiting for a response from a live support person.

I downloaded this game thinking I was going to be guiding the little fish through the sewers and such like the ad represented. After playing I thought perhaps once I hit maybe level 100...well, needless to say I am almost at level 300 and still now fish in the sewers to save. I find that decorating thank is pointless and you can only have a certain amount of fish. Please tell me how I get to save and guide the fish like the ad indicated. That's what I really want.

Very frustrated. Last couple months the amount of hard and super hard levels has increased and I spend over a week at a time trying to beat one level just to have the next level be worse. So I can't help on team challenges. Please don't respond by telling me the hard levels are very beatable, because I only win when the game is ready to let me. Please just go back to giving us easier ones or more moves so the game is fun again. Isn't that the point of games is to have fun? Not fun anymore.

They sell the game with a "mini" game in the commercial, but that isn't the game, you have to do a bunch of BS to be able to play the mini game and that stuff is time consuming and very "real" money intensive. I don't appreciate being lied to, all I wanted was to play just the mini game and solve the puzzles involved with that, I didn't want to build a fishtank.

I've played this game for years. It was fun, but recently the developers have gotten greedy. Instead of one purchase every month for enhanced play, they've decided to shrink the advanced play time to a week for the same amount. I'm sorry, this game is definitely NOT worth $20 a month to play. (Yes, the very basic version is still free.)

Played this about 1 1/2-2years. Fun while it lasted. Just uninstalled. It's been my time killer game, and it's been fun. Got to level 3071. And can't win, unless u spend money and use all ur boosters-which at higher levels, ur boosters are used up on regular levels anyway. It's been ok in difficulty as higher levels u go; don't want stuff too easy but not impossible either. Not going to spend weeks to beat a single level. So this went the way of candy crush and is removed.

I've never cared enough to review any game until now. This is 100% misleading. It forces you to play some stupid matching game that is not even shown in any ad. All the ads show scenario puzzles and they look fun but they are in no way related to the majority of this game play. The most frustrating part is, why be so deceiving? Just promote the matching game if that's what you want to make. I'm bombarded by similar ads for the same style game simply with different graphics and characters. Lies.

Don't I wish there were more mini games! Maybe 1 every 2 weeks you get one. This ad makes you think that this game is all about these mini games and it's not. It's a match 3.. And I rarely saw any Mini games.. Just once in a while. The game gets to the point where it's so hard( super hard levels) it's not fun anymore. Who wants to work that hard on a game that's supposed to entertain you? There's no easier level for the people who don't want to work that hard, I was forced to find another game.

The game advertised was not the game I got. The ad was different mazes and challenges to get the fish out of trouble ins tread I got a mix and match game. It's very deceitful and I am mad. The little fish in is only in what they mini games inside the main game and you don't get to chose when you can play it. I am on level 68 and I've only played the mini game 3 times. Can someone explain what's going on.🤨☹😤😭😠

To say there is no concept of time when this game is played doesn't cover it all! The gameplay is fun, challenging, and rewarding in many ways with Fishdom. The aquarium fish say the funniest and encouraging blurbs and you can decorate the aquariums with cool decorations that are updated when levels are won. I see matches in my sleep! Play Fishdom if you want to participate in challenges against other players, have fun and occupy your brain for hours, or just chill out with a cool game.

Played it for several years now, used to like it. Though now it's just putting me under stress instead of relieving it as it used to. Money, money, and money, if you don't spend money on gems, you have to spend two days for one level. It took nearly twenty rounds to make one level. Creators have shortened the number of steps you can make. It is easy to see that you know 🫠 I don't think you got so little money from your franchise, so that you really had to do THIS to the game

absolutley recommend. relaxing game. at first i thought it looked like a game for little kids, but its not just for kids. there are ads but they're not annoying popping up or covering portions of the screen. you can watch an ad when you feel like it and earn diamonds for extra lives. im hooked. its fun and challenging.

Game is not anything like the ads show. Thought this game was more of a puzzle/maze escape game but instead it's a run of the mill "get three in a row candy crush" style game. Boring. Levels are very hard to beat without purchasing "special" items, and you are only given 3 lives before the game suspends you from playing for 20 minutes or so. Played 25 levels, only 1 minigame- developer states minigame every 4 levels. Terrible,boring game that is nothing like it is advertised as. Uninstalled!!

I've enjoyed this game for years. Now approaching level 10,000, it's getting too hard to be enjoyable. I buy the gold pass, buy fishy bank, and instead of giving me an edge, the game is harder! Like you think bcuz I spent some money I'm willing to spend more to keep playing! That is NOT the case! I've reviewed this game a few times now and fishdom loses a star from me each time as my frustration mounts! Stop fishing for more money from me and let me enjoy playing!

Ditto on all the other reviews uninstalled previously because it was nearly impossible to advance without spending real money. I reinstalled because of the cool ads thinking maybe they added some mini-puzzles intermittently, but no. I can tell they have added many of the features I like from homescapes (I know- that should have told me there were no mini-puzzles, because they have the same ads) but I don't have time for another game so similar, so this goes.

Hey playrix, stop apologizing for the misleading advertising. Instead how about you advertise the game as is. Or better yet, make the game match the ads. I love the looks of the "save the fish" version, but hate the actual game. The actual game is exactly like all the others. How nice it would be to have something different. Almost every game of your development that I download, I uninstall almost immediately.

A cute & fun game but is designed to enjoy it fully, you must spend money on diamonds to advance. Otherwise would rate a five. I dropped this game once but was told it was better. BETTER? REALLY?? ( I spent probably $200 this month & even at that, it gives very little help unless you keep spending. For the special fish, you have to wait until you have enough to buy 1st one. Then it is so expensive I need more levels to afford it. I cannot afford this game. Not trying again. Update May, 2020)

I have been playing for a while now. I do like the game. One thing that sometimes is very irritating is that you can get stuck on one level too long. I wish they would give us something we could do towards working out of a level other than play it over and over for several days. I love all the fish and characters. Silver and Gold vouchers for unique fish are far too rare.

Love this game, but unfortunately the mini games advertised let me down. I downloaded the game because I wanted to play the fun mini games. You only get to play one mini game for almost every 25 or more levels you play. Then once you reach a certain level, they are completely gone it seems. I'm on level 795 and I haven't had a mini game in the last two hundred or so levels. It's really the only disappointing thing about this game so far.

I have played Fishdom for 4 years. It was my favorite game. But the developers have taken a fun game and ruined it. It Is impossible to pass levels without spending money to buy boosters. Without boosters, I find myself stuck on the same level for days. I used to spend money on this game, but now they are turning it into another version of GardenScapes and HomeScapes. I quit playing those 2 games years ago because Playrix ruined them also. Save yourself a lot of grief. Do NOT install Fishdom.

Love it...lots of fun. Except that when your tanks are full what the heck do you do with the coins??? I think the makers of this game should allow an occasional purchase of diamonds or game pieces of the games inside this game, like when you have to buy the sidewalk stones and such. Otherwise, the coins are a waste of time, they just sit there. I have well over 200,000.

I loved this game because I love decorating the fish tanks but I don't like that every puzzle is impossible unless you buy help in the higher levels. If I have to pay for help that help should be available as long as I continue to keep the game, but the help only last as long as the "event". These puzzles are not beatable without help, and after losing 3 times the game actually says that this puzzle is harder and tells you to get help by buying it! Make the puzzles beatable!!!! please?!

Dropping my review to three stars because the game has gotten too hard. So obviously a ploy for money. I'm at level 1200 and it's either pay for the perks or a really hard slow slog through levels and very slow to get three stars on aquariums too. I don't mind giving some money to a good game, but they've had enough from me. It's not worth more. I think I'll be finding a new game now.

I have always loved this game. I had the original game on my old desktop computer when it first came out. I was thrilled to see that there was a version you could play on your phone! It's full of challenging puzzles and beautiful items to decorate your aquariums with!! I REALLY like that they started to allow for people to "earn" diamonds by watching ads! Good going guys!

Not as advertised. I clicked on the ad that showed a "save your fish" game where you move the slidey things to get water to the fish before he dies without letting the shark get him. Instead, the game is a "match 3 items to clear them" game. It's not bad. It's just not at all what the ad showed.

2016 - Love the levels and being able to personalise the tanks. 2020 - This WAS a great game. Now it costs you money if you want to play for more than 15 minutes. You only get 5 lives every 3 hours. 5 lives = 15 minutes play. You need extras to beat higher levels which costs money. I dont mind paying for a game but when the cost increases to $50+ per week, its not worth it. I have now deleted the game. Not suitable for children as they will blow out your credit card.

DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY ON THIS GAME! Like an idiot I downloaded this once again. This is the worse game I have played. AFTER 103 levels I got one mini game. Then, got challenge where you have to complete 3 games in a row first time through. I did 1st level, failed second and got thrown back to the first. WITHOUT SPENDING REAL $$$$$ ITS IMPOSSIBLE to complete and find it true even on the regular play.

Enjoyable, but it's not quite as advertised. I was seeing Fishdom ads showing only the mini games, and I was hoping that's primarily what it was gonna be. Turns out it's more of a piece-matching game which I'm assuming is more like Candy Crush or something. I like it, though, so I'm not gonna go suing for false advertising or something, haha!

Overall the game's super fun! I love the gem trail game but if I am in the middle of a level and need to do something else on my phone and I switch apps when I come back it always ends that round. So if I have earned the supercharged lightning I lose it and it's really frustrating. Fix that I'll change it to five stars.

Just another match 3 game. Saw an ad for a "help save the fish" game and decided to download. Turns out that ad was false. You only get to play "match 3" like a 1000 other apps out there. Very disappointed. On a good note, if this is your sort of game, there are no ads n good graphics. Personally, uninstalling.

PAY TO WIN. Its next to impossible complete most levels without buying extra moves. Its cute. the game play is just like every other match 3 game. But unless you just need someplace to put your money, don't bother playing. Also they run ADs for this App that show FALSE game play! Desperate for players much? Game not enjoyable. Uninstalled.

Total clickbait. The advertisement shows awesome puzzles to solve, where you really have to use your brain. When you actually play the game, all you do is stupid "create 3 or more clusters". Plus it's riddled with ingame microtransactions, that aren't as micro as you'd think. Very disappointed of you, Playrix.

Misleading ads. You are shown a puzzle game to save the fish from dangerous situations in the ads, but in reality this is just another candy crush game. The game publisher makes people expect the content shown in ads and then just ask them to play a 3 match game. If I had to pay to play this game, I would have asked for a refund and complained to google afterwards.

very interesting game I like 👍. But I want the bomb 💣 and the other things should be matchable. It will be more interesting and fun 😁. when you press on a fish, in the aquarium they should be possible for you to know all things that particular fish need to have. we prefer to know what they need and buy it into the aquarium for the decorations. Then we can get more stars 🌟 🌟 🌟 quickly. The fishes talk too much. What we need is the stars 🌟 🌟✨️. Thank you.

I played with my former phone and Not fair. Life isn't hard but most levels are and why do I have to pay for somethings it just doesn't make sense! Pls do something bout it. Also you know the aquariums are small so some aquariums look ugly when it crowdy. Then the decorations get costlier 😧😰 can you also help with removing inactive team members, we never get to the top in team tournament.

Really fun game, i love it! Im addicted to the sound the coins make when you collect them from the tank. Just a couple minor annoyances. Vouchers needed to buy special fish are dispersed totally unevenly for wins. I have won many games with 10-20 moves left and have currently won 367 brown vouchers but only 4 gray which makes it impossible to buy any fish. Also on some games it gives you freeby tools which is fun, but sometimes puts them in really inconvenient spots so you're almost worse off.

I love this game. It's more than just a colour matching game. You can buy fish and customize your aquarium. The fish each have their own personalities and interact with one another, often saying cute or funny things. It's a great game, fun to play, and even if you run out of lives for the puzzles, you can still be entertained by the fish.

Not even close to what any of the ads or trailers for this game show. Way more little kiddy than was portrayed. I expected the graphics to be at least at a 10 year old level but really they're more like a 5 year old level. What makes it worse is that this game is too complicated for a five-year-old to play. Double loss there for the developers LOL.

False advertising. The gameplay shown on the add is nothing like the real game. I only downloaded the game because I wanted to play something different than Homescapes. This is basically Homescapes but with fish and you will need to spend money to advance to the harder levels. Overall it's a nice game but I wanted something different.

Some of the levels become impossible to complete without extra bombs and what have you. If you don't spend money on gems to buy them, you won't be able to progress in the game. The customization of the fish tanks and little quips by the fish for every new decoration added are nice.

Fun game. Well developed. Love how it doesn't bombarded you with ads. The levels are pretty unbeatable unless you pay. Your choice is to spend literal days playing the same level (you only get 5 lives) hoping you get a lucky set of matches that lets you win, or you pay for boosts and life replenishes. The extremely limited number of moves each level provides is what kills the game. Even if you paid for boosts and lives, all you're guaranteed is to have to keep paying.

This is a terrific game and I have no complaints at all about the game, I love it!! But sad to say after the September 2019 update I lost EVERYTHING. I was almost to level 900~ over a year of playing! I wrote to Fishdom but only recieved a computer generated reply that helped nothing. I hated the thought of starting over on level 1 so I've uninstalled the game.😞

Updated Review!!! This game is truly a great game. However the help/customer service is not very helpful at all, nor do they try to compensate you for you inconvienence when something is wrong like the customer service on Toon Blast and Candy Crush App, they both have GREAT customer service. Its especially frustrating if you spend a lot of money on the game. That is why I reduced my five stars to three.

i absolutely adore this game but.. the items for the fishtank's get extremely expensive, and u only make about 1,600 from each bubble game. its hard to save up and its hard to move forward after a certain amount of fishtank's have been unlocked. im on the fairytale stage. even tho i play everyday i still struggle to complete tanks. basically what im asking is that u can make the games give more money than just a thousand. or make the items a bit cheaper. 55,000 for one item. is kinda overbearing

been playing for a couple years now. The developers have slowly been making the game harder and harder while increasing the cost of everything. I spent my share of money playing, but they have taken any value of spending money out of the game. this last update was the worst and totally took any fun I had playing and threw it down the toilet. I am really close to just deleting the app. this was my favorite app to play too. thanks a lot Fishdom for taking all the joy out of the game.

A good game with a lot of variety. The Halloween events were great! Unfortunately, if you are not able to spot how to build complex patterns (bomb or better, you'll understand if you play) with random elements, you get stuck around board 660 or so. Most boards now take me 6 - 8 attempts, just trying over and over to get a random assortment that can actually solve the board. I had one board where I made three moves and then was told I lost because there was no solution.

Originally downloaded bthis for the tunnel puzzles advertised and it turned out to be completely different game. It was fun at first but every time I start getting somewhere it glitches out. I've uninstalled it and re-downloaded it twice and almost at the exact same spot it stopped working. It's like the kid version of tune blast accept it doesn't work.

This game update has reduced the number of moves dramatically and made some levels impossible. For example 451used to be 35moves and now it is only 15!! If you fail enough then eventually bombs appear and it kind of lets you through. But since it is probably impossible to do, it's taken the fun and challenge out of it. But certainly was a great game before this. I'll be moving on but it was fun and addictive until now...

Once you've passed a certain "threshold" of the game, you encounter levels that are impossible to beat without upgrades. Fine, I'll use the electricity or bombs that I have, but I've been hoarding. What does the game do? It places your upgrades for you. So in a level I've been at and failed ten times because I need this one challenge on the right to go away, I waste an upgrade when the game places it on the left. Uninstall.

This game is NOT as advertised. I came here for the logic game as advertised on Facebook, and instead got an arcade game, but with the twist of earning aquariums, cute fish & decorations. There was the pressure of time, speed & competitions, thus the massive temptation to SPEND actual money. If one didn't go forward, one would go backwards. I ended up spending about $1,000 in a few short months. It was financially killing me. In the end, I HAD to uninstall. Surely false advertising is ILLEGAL.

why does the yellow coloured levels harder than the purple or red one? i even had to use powerups and diamonds to get through that level. label it correctly, it pisses me off when I play and lose 1000 times before winning just playing the yellow level.

RIP OFF - DON'T DOWNLOAD!!!! Game totally cheats you & steals your diamonds after you purchase. Level kept going once it was beat saying I needed two more to complete level & NOTHING was even there, the level was cleared. DELETING ASAP.

The game has regular, hard, and super hard levels. Some of the super hard levels are the easiest of all, and some regular and even hard levels I've been stuck on for hours. The levels aren't labeled correctly! Also this game likes to use up all my powerups and make it to where I ALMOST win a level. I'm not spending anymore money on this game because I've witnessed how unfair and mislabeled the game is.

The game itself is wonderful..and I honestly love it. But I'm so disappointed with the advertisements that I have to give 1 star. The advertisements arent just misleading, they are very purposefully misleading. Fishdom is a great game; why not make advertisements about the real game? While I think the game is a good one, I cannot give 5 stars to developers who are being deceiving

It seemed fun at first and cute but now it seems just all about getting you to spend money. Love the puzzles, just want to play. For example, the fish bank had 4 hrs left when I last looked, now I log in and I have to wait another 6 days to collect my gems I need for play or pay 2.99! Seriously?! Love the game otherwise.

use to be an entertaining game, but after they nerfed the perks, it became a drag to play... now it's about them milking $$ of their players and giving perks like hours of free time to play even though we have actual jobs and lives to live.. pitiful.. Save your money and buy a Xbox.. cheaper in the long run!!!

🤣I figured this game had nothing to do with the add! It shows fish eating bigger fish to grow in size (on the add),... But instead it's another candy crush matching colors and getting special blocks to get a bigger bonus... But it does have a 1 in 3to5 chance you'll get the mini game of fish eating bigger fish. But it's mostly block matching! Disappointed and misleading!😏Do better!

The game has quirks. It is addicting. The thing I dislike the most is the fact that there is no way to pause the timer after you have won free play time. I think there needs to be a second question for wanting to continue... especially during a timed level, more than once I have lost diamonds because I was about to make a move and my time was up, which caused me to accidentally hit continue play for x amount of diamonds. The developer does a great job keeping new items, and challenging tasks with updates so the play is fun. Graphics can be entertaining.

I've been playing this game off and on for years, and up until recently I would say it's my favorite game. Now the pop ups are ridiculous. I have to close about a dozen windows about special events (which are always going on) before I can get to the actual game. And with the new update itis being very slow and unplayable.

This game is designed so that you have to spend money on it to buy upgrades and things to help you succeed. I dont have money to spend on it so am stuck at a low level and unable to progress. I dont mind a challange, but when it's all but impossible to progress without spending money, it gets very discouraging. I will likely uninstall this game soon.

Been playing for a long time and I'm at the highest levels... overnight costs for diamonds have basically doubled (1.99 for 10 vice .99 or 2.99 now for 30 diamonds vice 50)...VERY DISAPPOINTED, game was fun until a 100 percent increase... I probably won't uninstall game but I'm done spending money for corporate greed...if game becomes frustrating because I can't get past levels, then it'll off my device. 1 star now vice 5.
it is a great game not full of stupid commercials 👍

Edit: dev's condescendence doesn't make them any favours. Strategy can only go so far, levels can be beatable AND unbalanced. The game itself is nice enough, a classic match 3 with fish collection and simple logic minigames. The match 3 levels are totally unbalanced after a while though, way to few moves for the amount of destruction you need to do. The mechanics push to waste resources, pieces too often don't obey gestures and ruin moves, it seems like it's just a money grabbing. Uninstalling.

The ads are very deceptive. I uninstalled because the minigames are so infrequent even though that's what the ads show. If I wanted another version of Candy Crush, I would just stay there. It is sad because the aquariums are fun and the graphics are cute but some the ads are just blatant lies, all the fun is sucked out. I wish I could leave 0 stars.

Where are the tasks gone? Completely boring now. AND ~ £20 for a gold pass a month now, really? AND levels keep getting more difficult. But on top of it: how you DARE to change the decorations I carefully picked to design my older aquariums to the ugly new ones? Every change lately was for the worst! If you want to keep loosing customers just keep on track. I'm out.

Addictive game. Timed levels are really difficult. 9/14/18 UPDATE I'm really disappointed that recent updates have not fix this problem. When playing the videos for gems and coins the video will freeze and I have to completely close the app., receiving no reward. I usually only play and try to view videos when at home and connected to Wi-Fi. It's still a fun game to play but sometimes frustrating.

I was lured in by false advertisement. The ads misrepresented the type of game I was installing. Not enough to keep my attention like what I thought I was installing.. It's like Candy Crush and filling a fishbowl with life if you are into that sort of thing. Not for me. I wouldn't have downloaded it and had to give 1 star if it was advertised accurately and honestly.

Changed game to make money. I've been playing this for quite awhile now. It used to be more fun, with a lot more mini-games after every set of levels. I haven't seen a mini-game in months and I've completed hundreds of levels. The mini games were how you got diamonds to "buy" things in the game. Instead they increased the number of diamonds it takes to pass levels if you're stuck (from 6 to 9), got rid of mini-games and made it nearly impossible to get diamonds without an in-game purchase.

Absolutely fun game! Love talking with my fish! Haven't tired of playing this great fun game and I've been playing for quite a while! Ir's great! The only part I don't like are the squid. They didn't appear for the longest time and I was so happy. I don't enjoy playing when they show up. Also, I recently purchased something that would have made me very close to moving on. Then it disappeared! How could I have gotten it back?

Despite collecting all 3 stars, I have been stuck on Russia for some time now. I have even bought more items for the aquarium, I have logged out and back in and I've uninstalled and reinstalled the app and still I'm not moving on to the next one (USA). This is so annoying and will lead me to completely deleting the app

Fishdom is enjoyable. I have not installed another game, since l found it. The game is challenging, never boring, and always has an element of surprise. It helps me to escape for a few minutes when l find myself waiting on something. My younger grandchildren play, they are 7 and 9. I have them to purchase the decorations and fish for me. Choosing names are always a treat they get so excited. Thank you, for all the fun this great grandmother has discovered with " FISHDOM". Keep up the good fun!

This game was actually fun to play. You took away extra "bombs" to help and the gems are harder to get. I can play the same level of a game for 30 or minutes without winning. It's so frustrating. I WILL NOT buy any gems because it still won't help to win a level. Horrible way to treat players!!! I would of given you zero stars if I could! Bring back the old way of playing!

expensive if you plan to continue...at first it is very enjoyable, but there's a point where levels are nearly impossible to pass. I ended up quitting (taking a year off) and starting over. not all games do this. While cookie jam becomes more and more challenging...each level is in fact passable.

Used to be a 5 star game that was fun to play and sufficiently difficult. Now the levels are harder to clear resulting in quickly losing lives and boosters. I spent almost a week on one level that always ended with me needing just one more move. That is a bit suspect to me. I detest that you can't choose to not do a challenge level because more often than not you end up losing all earned boosters when you fail. You should be able to choose whether or not you want to do the challenge level.

A money manipulation machine. I actually liked their puzzles, and I got all the way to level 45. There is absolutely no way you can progress further than that unless you start putting more money into this little puzzle game, than you would a brand new XBOX XS game. Seriously ridiculous, mobile games and development teams like this should be made illegal because they are meant to be monetarily predatory, not enjoyable.

False Advertising!! The ad for this game shows a style of gameplay that is problem solving based. The actual gameplay is just bejeweled-candy crush-esque and not at all challenging. If you just want to play candy crush with fish instead of candy, this game is for you. Additionally, I don't know how this tripe earned 4.4 stars given that most of the reviews are 1 star. Google Play needs to be notified of this shill!

Love the game and was happy to buy the monthly event pass, but super disappointed with the new update. Only 6 day access to the event for the same price as a month is a ripoff! Not even enough time to finish the event, and I play every day. Considering deleting this and moving on to a new game because of this. Feeling frustrated and ripped off.

The advertisement portrayed a game wherein fishes consume other fishes and augment their capabilities. However, upon downloading this game, it became evident that it was fundamentally distinct from what was depicted in the ads; it turned out to be nothing more than a puzzle game akin to Candy Crush. I would like to kindly request game developers to refrain from exhibiting advertisements that are entirely incongruous with the actual gameplay.

This game takes too long to start, has too many intro screens, spends too much time trying to pick your pocket. Some levels are far too hard with limited number of lives. When given unlimited items for a period of time the games frequently crashes burning up your time. Levels are nothing like ad video, you don't pull keys to save fish from sewage or lava.

Anyone who quit this game a while ago, like I did, try it again. The game makers Finally listened!!! I am on level 463 and I am still having a "blast". The one and only thing I hate, when you are trying to place decorations, the fish get in the way and they never stop talking so the dialogues also get in the way. When you start a level the fish leave the tank... should be easy to program them to do the same in decorating mode.

I logged into the game earlier today and noticed that I was no longer a member of the team I have previously joined. then I noticed the new setup with the teams. so I joined another team. I log back on this evening and noticed I'm no longer a member of the team I just joined earlier today. I don't know if the game has gone through some type of update but I would sure like to know what is going on.

I've been having issues with the app as of lately. When I get on, press play, after that it won't allow me to press or click on anything. Not to play a level, buy decor/fish, nothing. I've tried turning my phone off and back on as well as Uninstalling and reinstalling the app. I've tried to request help from playrix through email but it says I have to request help through the app, which isn't working & I can't press anything on. Can someone from playrix contact me, please?

Bad. Not as advertised. Very false advertising. I was really hurt when I downloaded it and it wasn't the fish eat fish that I expected. Playrix, bad move because I'd make sure I never download any other games from you and would tell other gamers too. The main game is boring and just a candy crush sea fish version. That would be good on its own since it has good graphics but THAT'S NOT WHAT HAD BEEN ADVERTISED!!

Love this game. Haven't had to spend any money which a person shouldn't have to do. Some levels are very tricky but with time and patience they can be completed. Would give it a 10 star rating! Update April 20th 2017, when I logged into the game on the 19th, all my eggs were taken away and replaced with coins. I was really mad as I had 476, and didn't realize when the event was over, that we would lose the eggs. I thought the event ending meant we wouldn't be able to collect eggs anymore, but we could still have a few days to use eggs to get easter things. I think Fishdom should change this policy. I tried sending an email but they responded that they couldn't be reached at that help department anymore. Still a great game, I am at level 602. Fishdom, I want my Eggs Back! Oct 16/2017 can you Please make it so we can move the fish to different tanks like we can with the decorations. That would be Super! I am now on level 1024. Love this game! June 2018. This game just keeps getting better with more awesome surprises. Love the new cool fish. Thanks playdom Oct 21/2018 Not happy with the way you are doing the Halloween event this year. You are making us pass way to many levels to get the Halloween fish. Leading me to think you want us to spend money to help us pass all the levels. Please change back to the old way for the Next event.

When I first started playing this game a couple years ago it was great. But in the past year or so the prices for in app game purchases has increased. But the rewards for different events and for in game purchased events had decreased. And the 2 worst changes have been less time for the Gold Pass AND we don't get the team challenges every weekend like we use to get.And when I contact customer support about these problems, their excuses are MUCH less than satisfactory. I don't recommend this game

ok well I was really enjoying it Playing everyday. so then I get to level 135 and it is practically impossible I never had such a hard time trying to pass a level some levels took me days but never weeks. I feel as if they expect you to purchase coins diamonds etc to pass this level. Because it's literally impossible . I'm not going to continue playing this game anymore . It just seems to me this levels not gonna be passed until I make a purchase . So goodbye Fishsom.

Do not get this game it is bait and switch! The ad for this game kept popping up on a game I play and it was fascinating. Eat or be eaten, beautiful graphics. So I finally fell for it and downloaded it only to find the same STUPID match up game that I HATE!!! I don't know what part is the part that they show in the ad (eat or be eaten) cause I never got there.

Can be fun game, but virtually impossible to finish most puzzles without using boosts, which coincidently ends up being available through purchasing gems. The first 70 levels are used to bait you into enjoying the game, then the $ grab for progress becomes obvious. Im not opposed to supporting dev efforts, but when its blatant like this game, its a turnoff - uninstalled.

Not at all the game that was advertised. Have to keep updating the game, which takes up more and more space each time so you have to delete other games or apps to make room. Some of the levels are insanely difficult. I have played for months now, at level 993. Can't make enough space on my phone to download the new update without deleting all of my other games. So I guess its bye bye fishdom!

Don't get this game! They want you to take out a personal loan to pay for diamonds needed for lives. It's ridiculous. It takes me 50 tries to win 1 game unless I buy 10 diamonds for $1.99. I can't afford to pay that for 1 game/life. You only get 5 leves per session that takes hours to get back. DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY. They obviously don't read their reviews and address the issues or they would change something. I can buy a game like Mario for less than $30.00 and own it forever.

I originally gave Fishdom 5 stars but have now changed that to 3. The game starts out fun, but the further you progress it takes longer and longer to fill the meter until you're spending days trying to decorate a single aquarium. Then they keep adding new elements to the puzzles, which would be cool if they weren't so annoying and the outcome mostly decided by random chance.

This is NOT a brain game where you have to figure out what root to choose to save the fish. Its a candy crush type game that when you win a candy crush-type level, you then play a game of chance. But the choices doing involve any thought. You just chose 1 and its a 50/50 shot whether you're correct or not. The game is NOT like it was advertised. *uninstalled* I gave it 2 stars over 1 because it had nice graphics.

Great game, played it and enjoyed it for years! Unfortunately it has become too "aggressive" in ads, many dialog boxes popping up and I have to go through all of them in order to finaly play a level. Every player should be able to choose what he/she wants to play and see in the game and not be forced. It is such a lovely game, please make it less evasive. I am not giving 5 stars just because of this... :(

Good idea, generic but the theme is slightly different. However, this game will make you want to go beat up the company's owner or throw your phone into the wall. And I am saying that because in some levels number of moves given is DELIBERATELY much lower than what you would need to finish the level. It applies to almost all the levels marked as "hard", "super hard", and sometimes to "challenge" levels (but not as often). They are designed to make you do micro-purchases for diamonds.

There is a "whale bank" that contains 50 diamonds that supposedly opens once a week. Since I kept missing the deadline, i actually set my alarm so I can get it on time and claim my Diamonds. What happened? It disappeared!! Five minutes later, the clock is reset and it demands you pay 35kr if you want the diamonds. I'm calling scam on you. I hate that gaming, casual or otherwise is still pushing people towards micro transactions. I'm thinking of deleting what I considered to be an enjoyable game.

Well I'm the the beginning it was enjoyable hasd the app for a few years. I uninstalled it. 1ove left seem to be happing frequently and you needed to buy booster or spend alot of coins to finish the puzzles. I would reinstall the app if you changed this but, I don't foresee it in the near future. Let us know if you change your program or the programmer so we don't always see 1 move left. This is my experience. I understand puzzles get harder as levels increase but, not I feel it's an unfair.

This game used to be my favorite. But now it is full of impossible to beat levels designed to take your boosters and make you pay to win. The challenge levels are ridiculous. I used to be willing to pay a bit for the enjoyment. But they've taken the cash grab too far. Super disappointed. Shame on you. And... they repeat levels! What a waste of what used to be a great game from a company I once said impressed me with how balanced it was. Now that's a joke.

I started playing this game because I was drawn in by what turned out to be the mini challenges. Sadly there were only a few and the more levels I went to there are none. Also you earn diamond but have to pay to get them from the fishy bank. Not thrilled with that either. I enjoy it but I will probably be uninstallimg it when I reach the point where I have to spend money to advance further.

Used to love this game, didn't need to spend a fortune to play. Seems greed has taken over and turned a fun, engaging game into a rip off. Now players get stuck on levels for days at a time and the only way to pass is to buy stuff constantly. Competitions are no longer fun either. Apart from not being able to pass stages without emptying your wallet, the prizes are not worth participating anymore. I always buy the "Gold Pass" , but this too is now watered down. What a shame.
Every new update is destroying this game. It's nearly impossible to move through more than 1 or two levels without having to spend $. I am over it. RIP fishdom

The game used to be fun and enjoyable until the developers got greedy. One doesn't have to spend money on this game to play, but with gold pass incentives, I didn't have an issue to pay for a pass as the benefits of the pass were worth it. Now they've changed the passes dramatically. Charging the same price for a weekly pass as they would for a monthly pass and reducing the prizes while also making it harder to obtain those prizes by removing tasks. No thanks...keep your pass...not my money.

Scammed by the offer and the game is terrible too! I installed this game as part of an offer in Wordscape. When I go to my offers, it shows it ongoing. I completed my end of the bargain installing and playing it. But they are not sending the promised rewards because they claim not to have been notified of the new installation. Beyond this the game itself is terrible. It is a candy crush variation. But with confusing challenges and poor playability. I am uninstalling it.

FALSE ADVERTISING! I was shown multiple ads for this game where one had to choose which lever to pull to keep a fish safe. This is simply a shoddy version of candycrush where you also need to feed fish and can/must create a tank. That would be great on it's own, but I liked their ad idea SO MUCH MORE than the actual game. I wish it was even close to what was depicted. Simply FALSE ADVERTISING. Could have done well with honest representation.

what would be helpful is when the fish think of an item, to touch item and automatically go to appropriate table. I feel more interaction with the fish. maybe to be able to ask what they would like. I don't like it when I decide to switch tanks or play a level one of the fish asks for a decoration and I miss it. other than that I really enjoy the game

Great game if you don't mind paying money to level up. I got to over level 200 without paying for anything, but the games get so difficult you can't finish them without boosters or extra moves. No thanks. I would rather pay for a game at the beginning then have to keep giving money to be able to play. I've uninstalled it.

And here we have another product of false advertising and misrepresentation. If you found this game because of an intriguing ad with fish, lava, water, movable pins and a chance to save your fishy friend? Well, sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but this is not that game. It is but another candy crush knock off that we have seen time and time again. Only difference is you have an aquarium that you can decorate yourself.

I edited my rating.. Love this game but so frustrating as it is trying to force me to buy diamonds. I am at level 3475 and have been here for a while. There is absolutely no way to complete this level without extra diamonds because even though I have opened up all blocks, with moves to spare, no more characters appear so I can complete the challenge. So I end up wasting my last moves without characters appearing. It is now a principle issue for me not to buy diamonds as it feels like a hoax.

Downloaded for the minigames- it's just a match 3 game. I was really looking forward to the free form fish eating game that I saw in the ads but you don't get to do any of that- there were a few levels that were structured versions of it, but the only minigame I've been given for hundreds of levels is the one where you pull the pins. One star for false advertising. Why program a playable version of a completely different game just for the ads?

A Candy Crush clone with false difficulty. This app is nice because it's free and ad free. But it's Candy Crush with an underwater skin. The "mini games" are impossible to lose due to tutorial UI. After a certain point the levels become rigged, unless you use power ups, which you have to either earn by beating levels (which can be rigged) or by spending money (what they want you to do).

Love this game but can no longer play it. I don't mind a good challenge but when the level is so hard to beat that even using every extra tool I have doesn't work and you have to put up a video supposedly showing how to beat it, it just takes the fun and any enjoyment out of the game. I am currently just playing to use up all my extras and spend out all gems.

Was a great game but with this last update, you don't get your money's worth anymore. I used to buy Golden tickets but know they are impossible to obtain them all in a week. I have noticed I can't get through levels unless I use power ups, even easy levels. Don't waste your money. I'm am looking for a new game to play.

I also watched a lot of my rewards like 1 hr of infinite life, multiple power ups, etc used to beat levels all go to waste. I have played a few of the levels for weeks before winning.
