Their side quest is getting difficult as well, in the sense that they require a lot of energy to destroy an obstacle. Fun game, no doubt, but seems the difficulty and such are leaning toward having to purchase all the time.

This is one of my favorite new games. It would be exceptional if it was geared more towards game players rather than for those that advance by spending money to get ahead instead of winning it. It takes alot of thrill out of the game to know there is little to no possibility to earn enough vouchers to trade for special fish, so Im not sure the thrill will last too long before loosing interest.

"Play mini games" really means "after you've gone through a couple of match-three games, then we'll randomly give you a mini game, which may not be the one you want to play." If you like matching tiles to clear boards, this is your game. If you're here only for the fish version of the tower game, this is not the app you're looking for.

Levels become impossible to beat and require purchases to get the tools you need. Otherwise super fun and smart game, until you can't get past a level. Help is not helpful enough in explaining why block colors change but are not removed during play. If it takes two hits to remove them, then there should be a higher number of plays. Sad, but I'm uninstalling and feeling stupid after SO many tries.

I really like the game, but have been plagued with issues for October, and can not contact support. I only get error messages. My name and profile pic changed to a friend of mine, who doesn't even play the game. I have lost my friends and extra lives, but still have all my fish and aquariums. I won a tournament and didn't receive the rewards. When I try to invite my friends I am told to choose which app, ex: a printer, pininterest or something unrelated. Am I haunted?

Enjoy the concept of feeding fish and building aquariums. Do not like the timed games - too much pressure. The other games provide me some much-needed relaxing focus. I do NOT need more stress in my life. UPDATE: I am DONE with this app. It is FAR too difficult to be relaxing. The few relaxing levels do not come close to making up for the total frustration of the difficult levels, especially combined with the totally insufficient power ups to combat the ridiculously constrained board!

Quite like this game, has some very hard levels, but eventually you're able to pass them without spending gems. My big complaint though is that after the most recent update the decorations in my completed fishtanks have updated. Many look different, some aren't even the same decoration. I had my tanks set up how I liked, now they look awful. If you need to update decorations, maybe don't turn them into something completely different?

After 3years of playing and reaching 7500+ levels the app decided to start freezing and no options worked. Help suggested to reinstall after save progress. But after reinstall all data lost! Asking me to start again at Level 1. Pathetic! Restore does not work and there is no response from support. Please help me restore my data and all the progress!

The only reason I didn't award more stars is because the creators are [apparantly] greedy little bastards. (Not meant as an insult.) When the "Fishy Bank" is full with the diamonds I collected as my rewards for completing certain tasks, I have to pay real money to receive the diamonds. Guess I won't be using the diamonds any time soon. Let us use what we've earned, and I'll give more stars. Other than that, I've really enjoyed the game so far.

The worst part of this game is the 'bank' scam during the first five days. The game forces you to 'store' the diamonds (in-game-currency) that you earn, and doesn't allow you to use them unless you purchase the 'bank'. Put simply, every time you beat a level and earn diamonds, you still have to buy a bank for $2.99. What's the point? In real life breathing is free, but imagine if you had to buy a tree in order to use the air you already own? Really manipulative.

I will never understand why devs make ads for a game that doesn't reflect the gameplay at all. Ads depict a puzzle game involving moving rods to open the pathway for a fish. The gameplay is actually just a simple tile match game (candy crush style). Please have ads that reflect your actual product. It feels dishonest Im sure many others feel the same.

This game is very fun and addictive. But, it takes my money so much. Games should be fun because we want to release our stress. Fishdom accomodate that feature, but the weak point is I need to buy more diamonds to pass to the next level. This will be a minus point and make me upset. Maybe the developer should think other mechanism to earn from this game.

I loved this game and have spent more money than I care to admit on in app purchases, but after this latest update, I will be uninstalling. I HATE the new graphics. The pieces now look like the fluffy, super plush toys meant for toddlers, and I can't stand to look at them. If I can't look, I can't play. Aside from how expensive diamond/booster packages are, the game WAS 5 stars from me. I don't know why they switched to blurry, cartoony pieces, but it cost them a customer.

New update is very frustrating. I used to get stuck on levels now and then, but now it is every other level! And there aren't as many helps, so I will get stuck on levels for days. Does not make for very enjoyable game play. Paying for the gold pass is NOT worth the money. $4.99 for 6..maybe 13 days when it used to be a month...? Come on...the helps aren't even that great anymore. Very greedy indeed.

MISREPRESENTED GAMEPLAY. This game is just another match-3 game, like the hundreds of other games out there. But the images posted make it appear to be a completely different type of game. The images posted are of EXTREMELY short mini games (as in less than a minute). I uninstalled after less than 10 minutes. BEWARE of misleading ads.

Love the game! Not crazy about the cartoonish fish in costumes. I prefer the more realistic fish. I could care less about the vouchers since I rarely spend them, unless you could purchase other things with them like turtles, crabs, octopuses, etc. I would love to buy more sea creatures for my aquariums!

The game is not for me, but isn't actually terrible. To me, the game is very mind-numbing and has a lot of the match 3 bs. Although this is the case, there is a somewhat interesting mini game randomly sprinkled in sometimes. I will also say that energy is present in this game, and the match 3 nature makes it so you sometimes just lose because "screw you". Overall, not good, not awful, would not recommend unless you like match 3. TL;DR: Match 3, kinda mind-numbing, mediocre game, not recommended.

I LOVE THIS GAME!!! I have played this game for YEARS, ever since it came out on computer and it's only getting better! I'm very happy they chose to make a version for the phone. Great match 3 & decorating game!!! You even get to personalize your fish tanks! They have boosters to help you pass tough levels and you can win them for completing tasks. Awesome game... give it a try, you won't regret it.

I absolutely loved this game until today. Today I was on level 15 out of 18 in order to get an array of prizes. Somehow someway the game glitched and I lost everything. I know this was not a fault of my phone as it is a brand new phone! I paid over $150 diamonds and used all of my bonuses to get as far as I did hoping and knowing that I would receive the grand prize that is now eradicated, there's no way I can undo it. I am so frustrated by this that I am uninstalling the entire game.

I had bought a diamond just so I could play for quite a while because I had to wait a long time for something. There were 2 glitches in one of their new games where two things overlapped (energy and TNT). I took the diamonds for the explosion that I did not want to use. I contacted customer support and "Sean" not only wanted screenshots (you don't really expect that to happen so I didn't take one), he refused to help saying it was my fault and completely closed the discussion.

Been playing this game for ten years. I used to love it now it seems impossible to beat levels without spending money . Side games are ok but have become agitating as well. I liked the game how it was before the massive changes and updates , especially when u throw in hard levels and super hard levels every two levels you finish , ok rant done change the game back to original ! It was better years ago. 🤦🤷🫩

As someone who has ADHD and poor impulsive control this game was really fun and had me addicted for awhile and had me spending a lot of money however, around the 2080 level it began to be very apparent that I was going to have to continue to spend a lot more money just to beat regular levels. I'm not saying I'm stupid but spending hours trying to beat 1 level WITHOUT needing extra moves quickly discouraged me and had me questioning my knowledge and my enjoyment. Not for someone like me. 😔

When I first got the game, it was good. It was the right style for me, and it was satisfying. For a while. After that, I realized that there is false advertising. The fishes CONSTANTLY want you to buy a deal. And the #1 reason why I'm rating this 1 star: THEY RANDOMLY BLOCKED ME FOR "USING 3RD PARTY APPS TO HACK THE GAME" It is so annoying, and I will uninstall this game. >:(

This used to be a great game but now you can't get enough coins or jewels to decorate your aquariums which was fun. They have added too many mini games that don't even give you decent prizes and the cards are just annoying, they don't add any value to the game at all, so now the game is so full of junk that it takes 1.5G on my phone, whereas CC only takes 650MB, so this one sadly will have to go.

First, I really like the many aquariums, adventures and match 3 puzzles. I have spent much effort to get energy for the adventures when I get stuck on a hard puzzle. Second, I am disappointed that new updates are upto date because some error like fishdom doesn't responding is seen. It's making so Irritated😖😫. In short not able to play very easily as before. Team fix my problem.

I was really enjoying this game despite it having a different gameplay than what was shown in an ad but after a while the puzzles have became extremely hard with very limited moves, which makes it impossible to win unless you spend money for the dimes. The slowness of energy loading is also very frustrating. Addicting in the beginning but gets unnecessary frustrating as you level up. They just want you to spend your real money. Its designed unrealistically for harder levels to have such low move

The game is really nice and fun to play. I enjoy the levels and overall design. However, the lives and boosters feel too limited, which makes it hard to continue playing for longer. It would be great if there were more ways to earn lives and boosters. Also, adding a night mode would be amazing and easier on the eyes. Overall, it’s a good game with a lot of potential!

Bright, colorful, and full of fish. Where can you go wrong in a match-3 game? Playrix Games are some of, at least in my humble opinion anyhow, the best mobile match-3 games that are available to play. Fishdom is not only one of their first games available but also first in ratings out of all of them. I'll even go so far to say this is the game made by Playrix that I find most enjoyable. It is most definitely the one by them that I've invested most my time in and played more often than any other.

I like the game, have had it for a while and would stop playing for a couple months and then come back. I'm level 1,500. Whenever there is an update my app refuses to acknowledge it, I end up missing most or entire events! I have even uninstalled and reinstalled many times, the app still says I have the latest version and I don't. I like the game concept, but the levels are definitely more annoying now that the power ups have been reduced on top of already having a super hard level all the time!

This used to be a great game to play..until some very recent changes were made to the award system. You used to be able to win power ups which are a vital part of clearing a puzzle. Now the power ups you get are daily lucky guesses but you only get on or two. Not nearly what you need. Oh sure, you'll win some puzzles but those are one's you'd win without any power ups. I'm an old bird here and disabled vet...this game awarded me a way to escape some of the pain and just have fun.

I was excited to play this game after seeing the advertisements everywhere, only to find that upon download, it is like countless other ridiculous match 3 games whose ads do not depict that they are a match 3 game. If you are here based on the advertisements of solving puzzles to help the fish survive, you will be disappointed. I just don't understand why you would advertise gameplay that does not depict your actual game.

Nothing more than swap and match! The game promises to be many things (save your fish from poison gas, save your fish from rudders etc.) Refer to picture 1 under "About the game". However, there is nothing of that sort when you download the game. Plain vanilla swap and match! And some things you can buy. Big disappointment. Don't promise things you don't offer! Uninstalled the game after trying hard to find the other games promised.

I had no idea I would be taking care of a fish tank. The advertisements showed games that required saving a fish. I was thinking that was what the app was all about but unfortunately the games came once in a blue moon after you did all of this maintenance to your fish tank. Sadly, I was very disappointed and ended up uninstalling the app.

Last update destroyed my ability to play. I usually bought at least the gold pass and one fish full of damonds each month. Game keeps resetting, or runs extremely slow and this month's gold pass is worthless. I uninstalled game. All other games work perfectly. Fishdom Game used to be fun. I guess I can spend my money elsewhere now.

I got this game because it was advertised as a physics-style puzzle game, however it's basically a knock-off of a candy switching game inside of an aquarium building theme. I'm not sure why they'd advertise this as a puzzle game to attract people who are looking for a puzzle game and then not offer any puzzles.

OK so probably my favorite game having played close to 2500 levels. However, it is utterly AMAZING/ANNOYING how they configured this game to somehow always make you end a level with one more needed move, jack up the cost of supplies (from 6 to 9 stones) and make things so absolutely difficult so that you exhaust all your supplies and force you to spend money...well, I will find something else to do. I was happy to pay 5 dollars a month for added features, but this is beyond greedy. KMA

I love playing this game! However just now I won 10💎s which could have given me additional lives & other items in the game but I couldn't claim them because there's so many ads & different pop-ups that it just bypassed me "grabbing" them out of my "fish tank". I know this sounds silly but when you actually pay for 💎s & then you're givin' them because you signed in on another social media platform then they don't let you take them... torques my twinkie!

Could be fun if it wasn't an immediate money grab. The tasks are difficult pretty quickly and if you can't complete them before you run out of time or moves, you need to buy more time or moves. I had this game for a couple days, and got sick of not being able to do anything without being hounded for money to power up or get help. Also, those little pull the pin and save the fish games they advertise hardly ever come up. It's all match three. Passing on it.

update after 2 yrs I've quit playing. it's just not fun being stuck on a level for a week because no power ups or coins. just not fun like it used to be. I know they are beatable without pos but who wants to spend days on one level? not me. I get how these games work. You have to play the level so many times and wait for your lives to refill so many times before it let's you beat it without them. Every dev knows this.

As others have stated....once you get past level 500 nearly every single level is HARD, SUPER HARD, or a challenge level. You can't get past these levels without the tools to help so you wind up buying the tools to keep playing. The game was fun at first, but no longer fun when it takes dollars and or days to beat a level. Developer notes you can bet all levels without tools. HA of course THEY can because they developed the game and know the secretes.

Good game and a bit tasking. Snag is, it feeds much on data; game too tough till u get massive bombing therefore, it is not really based on strategy. Your physche of compelling to buy won't work. If I can't win a level, I quit. But I guess u know that so u eventually give massive bombing to keep us on the game. So if u can't get us buying, u consume data for your benefit. Not so smart!

"We'll pass this on to our development team". Yeah. I see that does nothing. The fact it is $7 to buy the season bonus thing is absolutely ridiculous. I remember when it was $5 and even then I thought it was pricey but still bought it probably every other time. I refuse to buy it now which is unfortunate but not spending that much on something that is so temporary. Very tempting to delete the game if nothing changes. Way better games out there for cheaper.l 🤷🏻‍♀️

Not as advertised. As a match 3 game, it's not even as much fun as others I've played - the power-ups are different than in most games of this type and levels are sometimes so hard that you can only pray you'll get a good power-up by chance. You also cannot replay older levels while you're stuck. Extreme cash grab, don't recommend

The game is super rigged on levels it want you to win you can win so easy and on other levels no matter what you do or how many bombs you use if it doesn't want you to win you won't until it wants you to. On some levels I have used all three of my boosters and ended up with the same exact ending I have when I used none. I edited my review because while everything I said is true, I still play it. but updates for holiday themes being forced is another issue for me.

I'm addicted to this game😀but some features are annoying,like u should not have to pay for the diamonds after u worked to earn them,and when u get unlimited lives it should not be hours of play that you have to use right then, if you won it, it should be used when you want to play! plus I have noticed that the games are different, when you have unlimited life, they are not the same as when you dont. but over all love the game.

Too many updates which need lots of space. Again today on 13 may same thing. Again not happy as I had to uninstall other apps but still game not getting updated. It's better to uninstall the game as its getting really very irritating

Was in the game less than a couple of hours when I ran into a frantic timed segment that is impossible to get past without buying stuff. You have to wait until the next day when you get a couple of things to help. You can get close, but can't finish in time and when you've used your one or two and you would need to wait another day. This is basically a prettifed Candy Crush. No sign of the puzzles you see in the ads.

This is how Fishdom treats their Paying customers!! No matter what kind of level I'm on , it takes all my boosters and a dozen lives or days to just pass a level. They hardly give out diamonds any more . Only one free video a day to watch and then I only get coins . They have made this game so hard I can't get anywhere on my aquarium . I can't get far in any of the mini games because I can't pass a level . When I do get a free hour, it takes most of that hour to just pass one level ! Fix PLZE

Newly disappointed. I used to love this game... but the changes have made it impossible to advance. I'm in the 2000 levels and suddenly I need 2 more stars to open the next aquarium. Yet ALL my aquariums are at 3 stars so its impossible. I can keep playing levels but never open new aquariums? Thats half the game!!! Apparently there is no fix for this issue? So I dont think I'll be playing much longer

Started out fun. Now it's super annoying. It's impossible to pass hard levels with small amt of moves given. Which is the ploy to get you to drop money on boosters & diamonds. Now I can't play at all unless I install a ridiculously large update, which, for whatever reason, won't install. I got a notification saying to come back and play with no update required. Lies. It's sad that a game with so much potential relies on total extortion. Pay to play & install the updates, or else! Haha hard pass

Have been frozen despite Uninstalled and installing the game. Can't push any buttons. Can't feed fish, can't play any level, can't give lives. Can't communicate with my team, can't contact support for help. Next will be deleting the game for good, this all started when that race game was inputed and the most recent update, I need this fixed!

This game used to be fun but they now make it ridiculously hard, and it's obvious it's the ai just not allowing to pass a level. This is no longer a game of skill, it's simply a see if you get lucky and it lets you pass. Unfortunately it seems the greed of the game makers has changed this game for the worse. I hope this changes at some point but for now I do not recommend this game unless you want to waste a bunch of money.

Since new update, lost the ability to earn diamonds watching videos. They want you to spend real money, not happening. New update doesn't work. Now made it worse, too much like royal kingdom, a game I hate. Bring back our seasonal tanks and boosters.
Definitely becoming more or a money grab now...where you stay on levels for days or get the super triangle and lose it immediately.
great..until now. keeps telling me to free up space but only 51% of my tablet memory is used. states I need to free up 105mb of space and I have 31gb of storage free! very frustrating.
I feel like I've been scammed ive spent tons of money on this app I just recently switched devices and they are telling me that they can't find my account and there's nothing that can be done 🙃
Wonderful Aquariums. I am playing Greece. I like the fish in Level 8,000+ :). Level 40 is Collections and Teams Level 36 - ALL PERFECT; so much FUN!

It's really just another case of blatant misadvertising. Advertised as a game where you eat smaller fish, yet it's just another candy crush clone when you get into it. It might have mini games that sort of resemble the ads, but unless you want to be matching shells for 30 minutes just to play the advertised fish eating game for all of 23.624 seconds, I really wouldn't bother with a download. Hope this helps someone save some money and time

I got an ad for this app and it did not let me turn the volume off so I could continue to listen to my podcast. I had to wait until the ad was over to go back to my podcast. This angered me and then I went to the app to air my grievances and then I discovered that the game also has nothing to do with what they advertise. It's just another candy crush but worse

Graphics are good and the fish interacts with you as they said. However what video brought me to download it was very misleading. This is my least favorite style id game so was very confused and disappointed when I kept going through the levels and it didn't change. Thought it'd have a bonus game of what I saw

This game was great when I started. Don't start unless you plan to pay to play. The higher the levels get, you can't win without buying diamonds. In the last few updates, they've lessened the ways to get free diamonds and decreased the amount of diamonds that you get when purchasing, yet increased the prices. Tournaments are rigged so your team can't win free diamonds. 1 level takes 3-5 days to beat. I'm at a very high level (10,000+), but giving up the game due to the greed of the company.

Great game . Light fun good puzzle play . absolutely one of the Best games out there !! 2 years later I am happy to say I am still loving it ! Love the seahorse , love the events , team play helps with extra items , buying the goldpass once in a while is a really nice option . And the discounts for bought packages is nice , but could come with higher discount options . More than one commercial at a time would also be a nice option. For the chance at extra gems. Still my favorite game 😊

This is the only game I have not uninstalled and kept over the years. I love the game play, however there are many updates needed. I keep waiting for Fishdom to catch up with all the other match 3 games... For example you should get a booster for matching 4 (in a square) and after making several boosters you should have a mega booster. If the necessary upgrades were made this game would be perfect!!

False advertising. Images shown DO NOT REPRESENT ACTUAL GAMEPLAY. There are no puzzles where you can save the fish like in the ads. It is just another stupid match three game & after few easy rounds you have to buy 💩 in order to get more moves to get explosives inorder to finish rounds. Its a total load of fish💩 that suckers you in and then becomes a complete money pit. DO NOT DOWNLOAD. DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY. THIS IS A TOTAL LIE & RIPOFF. Wrote this in 2020. Same 💩 stil applies in 2024.

I agree with other reviewers who are disappointed because the game is not the obstacle puzzle as advertised. There are a million matching games like this one and I have no interest in starting at the ground level with another one just because the graphics are different. Design a game like the advertisement and I will download again. For now I uninstalled it.

Huge ripoff! I spent over $200 playing this game, because of in-app purchases. I should have known better! I thought I was getting a game to help a fish escape from situations. Instead it is a candy crush type swap sea shells instead of candy game, with limited lives unless you pay for them with diamonds. The games are difficult without boosters, which cost diamonds too. The aquariums are cute, but everything costs something. After a while, the fish just repeat the same stuff. Don't download!

First day of playing is great when you get unlimited lives. This should always be a thing. Otherwise you are on each level, only get 3 goes at it and your lives run out. No point playing. Im not going to sit around waiting for my lives every 20 mins. Game was also NOTHING like the ad I clicked on. 100% FALSE ADVERTISING. If you didn't have to wait for lives this game would be sooo much better.

False advertising! I downloaded this as the advert showed a problem solving game where you help the fish through obstacles. The game is actually a basic match 3. As a match 3 it seems okay. A bit like Homescapes/Gardenscapes. But either way, the advertising is misleading and I would never have downloaded it if I knew it was match 3. Uninstalling.

Really wanted to like this game. Fish are cute and it's fun decorating their tanks. But I downloaded Fishdom cause the ads ALWAYS show math games (even this download page shows TONS of them!). You rarely EVER get to play them. The last level I played was level 40: I payed to open ONE gem bank. I had to use ALL 50 gems, AND all my lives, to beat that level. Let that sink in: at level 40, the game was already impossible. When my OWN FISH started urging me to get the "gold pass," I gave up. :(

After seeing hundreds of ads for this game I finally decided to download it. You know that ad you see where the fish is eating other fish? You do that on the 1st level and that's it. Then it has you do a bunch of other puzzles. That's not why downloaded the game. Uninstalled. I would say that you should make your ads represent what the game really is but of course then nobody would download it.

They have went crazy with the pricing. You used to get 50 gems for $2.99 now you only get 30 gems. For $5.99 you used to get 55 gems and 2 of all the bombs and lightning. For .99¢ you used to get 10 gems; they doubled the price on it. They are going to start losing players if the keep gouging people for money like they are doing. I've been playing for years but I'm not sure if I'll be playing it much longer.

it's a great game ! I love it!! I think that u should give out more of those gold , silver, and bronze tickets though. Or lower how much they cost for the unique fish.. it's takes to .any of them and then it takes for ever to be able to purchase them I think. oh and you shouldn't have to buy the piggy bank only using cash you should be able to purchase it with coins to I think but other then that it's an awesome game and I love it I will recommend it to all my video game playing Friends

Ads, as expected, are nothing like the game. I've played this game back when it was a silly flash game and even then it was a boring, yet standard match 3 tile puzzle game. Don't really reccomend if you base your games off the ads. Fish designs are fine. The item designs are fine. Progress is a bit slow however.

I love this game it's super addictive however the developers have gotten rather greedy considering all the success the game has had and the further you are in the game the more you have to pay to play. I've gotten the gold pass just about every single time and it's starting to get worse and worse it seems like you get a few things less then the time before.

I love this game, the fish give me a daily dose of self-esteem. With their praise after every winning game. Decorating the aquariums for the fish is so much fun and rewarding. I love the mini games, but there are too few and far in between. That's why I gave 4 stars instead 5. I believe fans of Fishdom would be delighted to see a separate app of just mini games. Without losing your fan base of Fishdom.

The game is a trap to make you spend money. The levels hold back needed pieces for completion and make it impossible to win without paying. It is planned that you will only need one or two more moves to win so you have to use diamonds. The rewards are a joke. You have to be able to go through 15-20 levels before "winning" some weak offering. They are very greedy and very stingy with minimal payout. The races are a joke. You win and then get 2 or 3 boosters=practically nothing. I was done when I had accumulated rewards and when the time for that offer was expired, they wanted me to pay 45 diamonds to collect it after I had gone through 20 levels paying diamonds in order to finish on t he first try. HATE THOSE GREEDY BASTARDS!!

Blatant lies. Game advertises as a puzzle game with levels in which you must guide a character through and around obstacles, and even allows a "trial" run through a basic level. Once downloaded, this is not even remotely what the game entails. 100% false advertising. Developer is nothing more than a liar.
Fun and whimsical, but be careful it's easy to get caught up and end up spending! Not for OCD players you will spend entire days on quests.

Have played this game for quite some time now with no issues. Since the last update(s) the game will not load. I play on 64bit pc with the latest Bluestacks platform. Blustacks support was quick to respond but to no avail. Suggesting switching this 64bit to a 32 bit is not an option. On that note. I bid you farewell Fishdom. It was fun while it lasted.

Have always enjoyed this game but with the new version, when I switch from data to WiFi, all my game play status is lost. I had 9 hours of unlimited lives from completing the submarine challenge and opening all the chests. I got home, logged onto WiFi and all 9 hours GONE! I messaged the help centre who then accused me of changing the date and time on my phone (why would I even do that to reduce my 9 hours of unlimited gameplay??!!). So nothing can be done. Very disappointed.

I think that it's wrong to update to have to update or not being able to play the game if we don't. This is the 4th, or 5th time That I was promised 5 diamonds if I would update the game, & still no diamonds either time. Also, why can't I get a new aquarium? I already have 3 stars? What's going on with this? It's March 19th, 2019. I've been trying to get a new aquarium since sometime in 2018. I'm still trying, & it keeps saying need 1 more star. It still won't let me go go the next aquarium.

It's fun, but I don't like the life limit. I want a pattern game when I have time to play it, not something I have to log in to each hour so I can use my 5 lives, or something that I can only play for 20 minutes because I have used my 5 lives. Most of the levels are easy, but every once on a while you hit a hard level. That's fine, I Iike the challenge, don't like taking a week to pass it because I can only try 5 times at a time. I'll probably replace it with something else soon.

April 17, 2023... After the merging game update, I started having problems with the game connecting to Facebook.! I've been playing this game since day one, and never had a problem.. Can't Play.! Fantastic game.. Quick, Respectful, Honest and Wonderful Support.! I've been playing it since it 1st came out March 2, 2016.. without neighbors, and totally Free .. Woohoo.!!!

I've always liked this game but haven't played it for a while as the last device I was playing it on died and I couldn't get another one. Stay away from this game. It is all about getting your money. If you have plenty of money to throw away. Addictive. Few options to play the mini games that are displayed in the adds. You will have to spend money to play eventually. Goes from normal to hard to super hard to normal. Love the game. This is primarily a colorful matching game. The mini-game puzzles are infrequent. The puzzles are challenging, and I enjoy it. They paint it like a fun aquarium game for all ages but it quickly becomes too hard. Used to be very fun and chilling game to play. Now the game is just ridiculous with so little move to complete so many mission. It is beatable but imagine spend 1-2 weeks just to pass one hard level. Lots of fun, and I am addicted. Just got new update for Valentine's day. I hope the pieces, boosters, etc., are going to return to their old look when Valentine's is over. Average gaming experience. Obviously Rigged. No one can be this unlucky. Pay to win as always. Can be stuck on levels for some time. It's at this point you can see it's not random. I can't explain it. But I only want to play this game anymore. I like that the little squid that shows up when I loose a level smiles when I have unlimited lives for a while. Nice. For the most part I enjoy the game but there are a couple of things I think can be improved upon. First, timed levels. The puzzle game that is advertised as what this game is is only available to play twice in the first 1200 levels I've cleared so far. NPCs are constantly getting in the way & can't be moved or shut up.

Was enjoying this game until the levels became so difficult that you really can't beat them without making purchases. The items you work for like a bank full of jewels you charge $2.99 for. The items in the store are high compared to earning opportunities. Its a nice time killer but cant advance or add anything because everything is too expensive or you have to pay real money and that is too expensive too!!!

I'm new to Fishdom but so far I really enjoy the game. When you start a new game, there's lots of things to learn. I'm hoping the more I play the more I'll learn. I really really hate the timed levels, especially when you have no diamonds and your down to one or two blocks and must start all over again. I love Fishdom. I played everyday, for years. It was fun and entertaining but now they changed the pricing and the way the game is played and it is down to a zero star game now. This is the only game I willingly watch ads for - they are non-intrusive and offer the incentive of currency for the game. I'm level 750 and loving it. Best match 3 ever! There are a few things that I'd change about the way the game is organized, but the issues are not enough to subtract a star.

This game has one of the most annoying user experiences of any games I encountered. I mean the game itself is fine, but the amount of extra challenges that have been introduced, and forced on the users is ridiculous. Sometimes I have to close 7-8 windows before I can even get to play the game. Also the forced version upgrades, without any warnings first? Come on now! Probably needs to come with a free anger management course.

Fun distracting game. I have to admit though, what originally drew me to this game was the mini-game of where you navigate a fish through multiple traps in the video advertisement. The same thing with Homescapes and Garden scapes. It seems theres a number of games with these Video's that are misleading about the nature of the game play. For this I dock two stars due to the fact that I wasnt getting what I thought I would be playing because of the Advertisement Video.

Yet another game that advertises itself with gameplay that it doesn't deliver. This one is honestly baffling because they actually implemented what they did just fine. They clearly have the ability to deliver what their ads promise. It wouldn't be harder or more expensive. They just pointlessly lie in their ads. It feels pathological.

So, the game concept is pretty fun. But I am pretty sure that the levels are AI generated; some levels give you such few moves and make it virtually impossible to beat it without spending money. Which is fine I guess, if that's your intention on creating a game. Kind of a bummer, though. Edit: alright, you get 1 star. I had 5 boosters, couldn't beat an "easy" level. Sheisty business model.

This game is pathetic. As you progress, the levels are absolutely impossible to clear without using paid boosters. They tried to ride the coattails of Candy Crush, but failed miserably. Candy Crush earned over 1 billion because it is challenging while still being able to clear levels without buying stuff. This encourages people to spend money because they realize that buying stuff will help them progress. With this game you'd have to buy stuff every few games. All the reviews say the exact same

Very interesting and fun game. I have unlocked 2 aquariums and really enjoy decorating them. I feel a sense of peace while viewing the aquariums; the way the decorations sway as if in real water. Love the fun discriptions and vibrant colors of the decorations and fish as well. Althouhgh, they are a bit too exspenvive. Just started playing so I havent run into any glitches. Support was very helpful when I did reach out with an inquiry.

Fishdom ads are twice as long as most other ads. They open Google Play Store without your permission and if you use Android there is nothing you can do to stop it. It's VERY AGGRAVATING when you're using another app that's time sensitive and a 60 second Fishdom ad shows up followed by Google Play Store opening... every single time!!! I finally gave in and downloaded it but it's a game suited for children. The ads are intrusive and the game is pointless and boring for an adult!!!

Later levels are a lot tougher than expected. Lots of fun! My only criticism is you could get a cpl more lives each round and maybe make it a little easier to aquire the the explosive tools for the puzzles, because without them you'll be stuck at higher levels for days to weeks. lol enjoy

I only played because of the promise of multiple games to play. It's mostly a match three game with random bs added to make it seem unique. I got bored with the repetition. I did not like the challenge mode. It was more get this or destroy that. A lot of effort for little reward. The stamina system takes out the fun. Might as well play another game. That gets tired quickly. Power ups run out quickly. I'm just so done.

You don't have to wait forever to win a level. Having the extra challenges gives you incentive to play more. Great decorations, I love the moves they do. I'm changing my rating to a 2 star. As I have played this game for a while now, it has gotten like Candy Crush, you don't win unless it gives you what you need. You use all your boost and still don't win.

Only downloaded the game because EVERY_SINGLE_AD regarding this game were advertising it to be a game with different minigames for the levels. Played the game for over an hour going through several (~15+) levels. Not a single ad which I had seen regarding this game showed the game as it really was... another one of those annoying match-3 games!! VERY DISAPPOINTED!! Complete MISREPRESENTATION!!! This is an addictive game and used to be fun to play. A short time back then made some major changes make him exceptionally difficult to be some levels without paying. it's a fun game but I think it'd be more welcoming if when you win the infinity lives thing you have a choice on if you activate it immediately or later. as is, say you're playing a couple games at 2am and then unlock infinite lives for an hour and your competitive spirit says to just stay up until 3am? could be a niche complaint, could be people are just quiet at 2-3am edit: the fish in game wants me to rate again

The game point is not all that bad. Collecting fish and making habitats for them can be fun. The thing is, the reason I downloaded the app is because of the ads. Best game ever! One year and I'm still addicted. But please when you guys update it again, solve these two problems: even when I move a piece the oil start spreading; and when when you need to catch a specific kind of piece and this kind is the only on that never appears so you lose time/lives trying and it's not your fault.

If you get into the higher levels they make it so you have to buy stuff just to pass the levels. You can't win any of the challenges to get any awards because you will be on the same super hard level for almost a month. Fun game until you have to buy perks just to pass a level.

This is the only game I play. You beat levels to collect coins and power ups. You collect diamonds for lives. You clean and decorate aquariums. You buy fish with coins or tickets. You can choose to be on a team and compete with other teams on the weekends. There is an option to buy packages or diamonds to help beat levels but you don't have to. If you are patient, you can beat any level as I have not purchased anything (other than 10 free diamonds from play store) and I am on level 9000+.

The worst thing about this game is that you can spend a fortune playing it. There should be more opportunities to win diamonds and it should tqke fewer diamonds to continue a play on a level. I hate the fishy bank because i earned those diamonds but in order to use them I have to pay $3. The game is fun but if you don't have a big game budget, you don't want this game.

I am in agreement with several others....some of the levels are near impossible and if I earn something (like the diamonds), that I'm supposed to be able to use in the game, then why do I have to pay for them??? I won't! You need to fix that, and the levels...I don't mind a challenging level, however, I don't want to be playing that level for days on end...and then STILL not beat it....*sigh*

Cute ,characters , fun mini games , and mostly everything is great until you experience writing at least 3 times smaller than news print !! It was ILLEGABLE unless I used combination of BOTH my GLASSES AND MAGNEFYING GLASS !! Now that's seriously small writing !! Other than that the game is great for one and all . EVERYONE will love it as soon as they play it !! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND you play at least once . After that .... you'll be as hooked as a fish on the line of a fishing rod . :)

Not at all like advertised. Basically a money making machine for the company - I don't have a problem with a company getting fair recompense, but this game... it's not. - You have to play *dozens* of 'match 3' games to get to a mini-game like on the ads. - You earn gems while playing, which can be used to make in-game purchases, but the gems go into a piggybank which you have to pay actual money to open and access. *This is probably my biggest gripe with the game.* Cute game, but don't get it.

It is a cute game and engaging, I really like the fishes as well how the steps difficulty is leveled! Smart!! thanks after having playing this game for same time now and enjoy myself! the level gets more difficults, the cost of it is high on the pocket for just a game to pass the time while on the train. the design is still nice and entrertaining, im not sure it will appeal to me for much longer, sorry for that but im willing to support the efforts to entrertainment but this is over by far! sorry

this game is engaging enough to keep you playing, only problem I have with it is that the "hints" are very persistant and can be more hinderance than help, because they aren't always very good and it's better to make your own moves, or else they'll actually lead you to lose! obviously... that's by design, so you'll have to spend money if you want to keep playing... it kinda sucks, because even though it's a good game, it's also undeniably a total cash cow, it's developers are greedy!

Before you download, this is a match 3 game. The mini games in the ads rarely pop up for you to play. The game isn't bad, but if you are going to advertise the mini games then just let us play them. The match three is the same as any other with power ups that are less useful then ones in most other match 3 games. Focus more on the fun mini games, that's where the actual strength of this game is and yet you rarely get to play them

I love this game! It's a great match game with a twist. It's not too hard but it is challenging. Their are mini contest, that happen on a regular basis, and side goals that give you the opportunity to receive bonuses to help with game play. AND you get to design aquariums and fill them with fish with your winnings. I don't know who did the graphics but they are awesome. Decorating is easy and it includes perspectives. I don't give out 5 stars. This is a first for me.

Disappointed! I kept getting ads showing pipes and levers. I finally decided to give it a try and downloaded it. I played many levels, three different aquariums and there are no games that look anything like the ads! I'm disappointed and decided it wasn't something I wanted to keep playing.

Its very addictive. Can't stop! Get it. A therapeutic game! There is a lot of free play, you don't have to be buying and buying just to play. But for goodness sake, buy something these guys are putting all their life work on it., it's a few bucks, literally a few bucks. The only thing that I don't like are the new fishes, ugly little things!!! UPDATE... after about a year Still very good!!!

Its a really fun game. But I wish they would make it easier to earn the purple diamonds so that way you can get more bombs to help you beat levels. And if theres a really hard level that you cant beat without some help and you dont have purple diamonds to get help with the bombs, then you have to purchase more diamonds and bombs with your own money. Other than that its a good game. I cant stop playing it lol.

This was an entertaining game. I had trouble, some time ago: if I didn't rate, the game locked up. So I uninstalled. Just installed again, after several months. I'll just Uninstall.... again

Highly Addictive!!!! Fishdom makes you wanna sit for hours, playing the game. I see all the figures in my mind's eye at times. I love all of the Perks like the stately old Penguin, always inviting me to eat his non÷existent food or his "rewards"! I also am amused by the Electric eel and his antics. Great!!

This has really soured me on the game...I'm considering deleting it all together as there are plenty of other games to play. Just an update...I contacted support and within a couple of days my game has been restored fully. Thank you!!!

0 Stars. I was duped by the puzzle strategy style ad. Very disappointed in the game makers for the bait and switch and Google play to allow this.

While I truly enjoy this game, the way it looks, and the way you can play without pressure, some levels definitely are so frustrating, it feels they are on purposely keeping you from beating it. So even though you don't have to spend money on the game, they definitely found a way to hook me. The way that we earned our fishy bank, but then have to pay to empty it is ridiculous

So I saw the add for this game over 300 times while playing another game. So I finally gave in and installed it Well let me tell this is freaking bejeweled with fish. I have been playing this for over a week and reached pretty high levels and I have still yet to see the cool puzzles in the GD add I saw 300 times. This game is straight garbage. I wish the ads weren't lies.

It's a fun game, at first I didn't know what to do, but since I've had this game on my phone for 3 years I really love it and play it as much as I can. This game provides you with so many objects and fish you can buy and decorate for your aquariums. What's special is that each aquarium has its own theme or unique genre. And depending on the time of year or special dates of the year there are special games or competitions dedicated to that holiday or theme.

This game has been around for a long time but has recently started showing false advertisements. All you do is decorate an aquarium. You need coins to buy the decor so you have to play mini games that are similar to candy crush. But they become practically impossible to beat and then you cant get any coins to decorate your aquarium. That's it. No eating smaller leveled fish, no moving pins to solve a puzzle. Just playing candy crush to earn coins and buy fish decorations.

The advertised puzzles of "save the fish" were far and few in between. Its mostly design your fish tank and jewel match game. I wanted to play the "save the fish" and I only got to play that 3 times after playing almost 30 jewel match games. And those 3 were lame at best and took 30 seconds to solve. They were "mini games." I uninstalled.

Enjoyable but frustrating .... I usually play at least an hour a day and I find that if I buy a ticket I barely make it halfway so or if there's a special event I find they are so time limited that I haven't been able to complete them which makes me frustrated. I like playing match 3 games but I find other games rewards are achievable. Things I like are the personality of the game and how the fish cheer you on. Being able to get the special fish when you buy the ticket.

Not as advertised. The previews are a very small part of a the game which is very disappointing. The actual game isn't bad, basically matching puzzles(another version of bejeweled) so you can gain coins to decorate the fish tank, which is adorable. But I wish they had more of the mini games as they are fun and cute, I enjoy those games more but they are the lease used. It does require you to spend money but you can avoid if you are patient and willing to redo the puzzles multiple times

There`s a lot of whiners leaving bad reviews about paying to play. Stop it. Maybe you're just not good at it. I am somewhere over the 6700th level and I've not spent a single cent. Continue to pay or choose to quit, but don't blame the game for your lack of skill and patience.

Kept requiring more and more data. I uninstalled 1 app to play it, and then it wanted me to uninstall 2 more... I did since I wasnt using them. I will never spend a penny on the game. Be better.

Used to love the game but losing interest fast. Levels tough to beat without spending money. "Costs" too high and get stuck in the same 3 aquariums for way too long. The game is mildly entertaining but if you got to this page by clicking on the ad, you will be disappointed like I was. The interesting logic type puzzles in the ad are a complete lie. This is just a match 3 game. If you wanted that, then you will probably have fun. But that was definitely not what I thought I was downloading...

Dangerously addictive...Seriously! It's not that at a certain point levels are impossible to complete without purchased power ups, you can wait for the daily bonus and try difficult levels until you eventually win. It's that the game is so addictive, such that when you face a stumbling block it's hard to be patient and spend a few days attempting to complete a level when you can just buy powerups and continue getting your daily dopamine dose from all the prizes that come from completing levels.

I'm on level 777. I still enjoy the game. Each level is a challenge some harder than others. Now, they have ways to earn diamonds and decorations, even a seasonal fish. The game has had very little glitches on my Galaxy S6. When I have earned a bomb, on the game, it will not give you one. Which becomes frustrating but it does not happen all the time. I will keep on playing as long as they keep adding more levels. It would be nice to move fish to different aquariums. /

hands down the best game app out there. simple to use and yet there is a lot of strategy that can be learned which makes rhis better than candy crush. my only suggestion is that in order to complete an aquarium you have to crowd it with too much stuff. this is a minor issue otherwise my all time favorite game. Update: 10/21/2019 Still my number 1 game a great game all around.

The game is catchy and most of the time good. But it has a bug and I can't finish the events except I start all over again. Because the game is good but has a bug and because the support doesn't message back I'll give it only three stars. Not worth to pay any money though. Uninstalled.

Love this game! The only thing I don't like is that when I chose to spend one of my extra start ups at the beginning of the game, I do not get to place them. I have been playing this game a long time. I like the way I have to plan out strategies to win, but there are some puzzles that seem so nearly impossible that I lose interest. Then, the timer games.... for those of us who play this game as stress relief, this just adds stress.

I'm doing the "Film Festival" challenge right now and I'm stuck. I can't earn new items to earn fish for rewards. It keeps telling me that those items are available in the "Store." Fun but expensive game. The levels are hard to pass and they rely on you purchasing stuff to help you out. If you persist without help, you will always pass the level after a while. Really fun game with lots to do...the fish and animals u have to keep alive are super cute and the puzzles and games unhave honest are fun and somewhat addicting but not too much 2 where u can T ever stop... Good game. Love the different fish bowls to decorate. Could use more lives tho. But one things needs to be fixed for sure are the controls. Seems like the game intentionally moves the opposite way of what i choose at times. Manly when Im close to beating the level with only a couple of moves left.

Scale not low enough. The ad is totally misleading. The game doesn’t even remotely resemble what’s advertised. fun game, they've changed it a lot over the years. It used to be a lot better. Takes way to long for life refills, makes levels difficult but not giving you the needed pieces when you should be able to pass and making you stay on the same "normal/easy level" for days. limited supply of help aids not giving many and making the timed tasks to difficult unless you live playing this games. if you want to go anywhere in this game either live on the computer playing it or skip playing altogether.

This game cheats, and is designed to simply take your money. Cute game, great graphics and easy play. I am only giving 3 stars due to false advertising. I have seen ads for this game showing you trying to help get this fish through a tunnel, away from an octopus or shark, and you pick which items will help you get the fish to safety or fail. The game is good. Very nice animation and gfx design, but excessive greed($100 packs Really?!) and poor gameplay design(timed levels especially) ruins most of the fun for me, same with the items/fish you aquire, while there are a lot of them, they don't really interact in any interesting fashion at all. Rigged. I used to enjoy the gold pass months. Now there are so many hard and super hard levels in a row I haven't come close to finishing this months gold pass. No more, not a penny will be spent. This app was a lot of fun at first, esp. populating and decorating your aquarium(s). I have 9 fish tanks. All the fishes have names that I could pick out and with their different personalities it fun to see them interact and one can create the tank to your liking. I love this game! I haven't spent any money at all. I am at level 1654. This is a very well done, visually appealing free app with no ads. I will add two significant caveats: 1) The ads for this game have virtually nothing to do with actual gameplay. 2) There are a few problems with game structure. The good: There is a good balance of free boosters and gems that make the game very playable, though binging the game for hours and hours is unlikely, even if you are a very skilled player or happen to luck into a series of boosters that allow for it. (That does happen sometimes, but is the exception, not the rule.) The bad: In addition to the game being different than advertised, there are two critiques I have about actual gameplay, neither of which are deal breakers, but both of which are incredibly frustrating when you regularly play the game. 1) The time bombs on some levels are so anxiety-provoking that they negate every ounce of enjoyment the game otherwise brings. 2) You cannot clear what is not on the board! Sometimes goals include clear frozen pieces or "rescuing" squids... and that's fine. However, I can only clear what's on the board. I have frequently played an "extra hard"-rated level and cleared every square of oil, compound coral, triple-boarded blocks, etc.... but I can't clear the level because the squids I'm supposed to "rescue" aren't on the stinking board or there are no more frozen pieces. Obviously, the way to get more frozen pieces or squids to appear is to make matches in strategic places... but sometimes by the time the other [significant] obstacles are cleared, there are only one or two more moves allotted, and making matches to call squid or let pieces freeze puts the player beyond the allotted moves. It's frustrating because it's already a puzzle, which is the point. But, again, I can make strategic moves and be mindful of my move count, but I can only play what's actually on the board. These are just a few points I hope the developers see. Other than that, I would strongly recommend this game. Again, very visually appealing, very good reward ratio, challenges/races, ability to link to Facebook, etc. But, those caveats do matter, so they just a few suggestions for improvement to an otherwise very fulfilling game.

This is my favorite game. There's no other game out there that I know of where you can build your own little kingdom like this one does. You get to build your own little Aquarium with many many things in it and make it look gorgeous. The only thing I'm not fond of timing events. However, you do get past them, and there are ways to win a lot of rewards. I highly recommend this game. :-)
